title: MRI radiomics-based machine learning model for complete response classification after chemoradiotherapy in advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center retrospective Gachon LARC series; population representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Post-NCRT T2 MRI radiomics with surgery/path CR labels fit WW classification aim.
rationale_c3: CR/Non-CR outcomes reported for train CV and independent test set.
rationale_c4: Sixteen feature-selection×classifier combinations without key clinical confounder lock.
rationale_c5: Post-NCRT MRI and radical-surgery pathway applied as described.
probast_rationale: Single-center post-NCRT CR radiomics; predictors available at restaging; no external validation and multi-model mining drive high analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Authors flag exploratory single-center design without external validation; planned multicenter WW integration.
applicability_v2_rationale: Se autodeclara exploratorio y no listo como soporte de decisión, en resumen, discusión y conclusión: H4(a). Contexto post-NCRT para watch-and-wait es adecuado; sin otra regla previa.

title: Metabolic dynamic score and machine learning: a novel approach to predicting pathological complete response in rectal cancer after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Two tertiary Chinese LARC centers (n=1300); not shown as population-representative.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-nCRT metabolic labs plus clinicopathologic factors and pathology pCR fit the decision question.
rationale_c3: pCR status reported for train/internal/external cohorts as described.
rationale_c4: MDS derived on train then XGBoost with early stopping; independent Center-2 external limits residual confounding.
rationale_c5: Uniform MDT nCRT/surgery pathways described across both centers.
probast_rationale: Dual-center retrospective MDS+XGBoost with genuine external AUC 0.92; MDS uses pre/post-nCRT labs so targets restaging/WW after CRT; residual ROB from retrospective selection and multi-algorithm screen.
appraisal_note: MDS dynamic score requires post-nCRT labs; GitHub panzhen1998/MDS.git supports transparency.
applicability_v2_rationale: El paper se autodeclara herramienta exploratoria en la conclusión (H4a). Además mezcla decisión pre-tratamiento (TNT) y post-nCRT (W&W) con predictores post-nCRT; no se desempata por H3.

title: Prediction of Pathological Complete Response after Chemoradiation for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Using Machine Learning with Clinical Features, the INTERCEPTOR Study Preliminary Model.
rationale_c1: Single tertiary Dutch LARC CRT series 2004–2018; not shown population-representative.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment clinical staging/features with pathology pCR after CRT fit the decision question.
rationale_c3: pCR (ypT0N0/Mandard TRG1) reported for n=238 with clear eligibility.
rationale_c4: XGBoost on limited clinical covariates; SHAP highlights LN count without high-dim mining.
rationale_c5: Standard long-course CRT then TME ≥6 weeks per Dutch guideline as described.
probast_rationale: Preliminary INTERCEPTOR clinical XGBoost for pCR; 5-fold CV only, no external lock, modest AUROC ~0.65.
appraisal_note: Authors note external validation pending; clinical-only features underperform imaging/path models.
applicability_v2_rationale: Variables clínicas pretratamiento en LARC para predecir pCR y decidir CRT/preservación de órgano; predictores disponibles al decidir. cM1 minoritario (8-10 %) no cambia la decisión.

title: Tumour cell density quantified by artificial intelligence is associated with differential benefit from irinotecan-based chemo-radiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: a post-hoc study of the phase 3 ARISTOTLE trial.
rationale_c1: Post-hoc of multicenter phase 3 ARISTOTLE; trial population reasonably targets LARC nCRT.
rationale_c2: AI biopsy TCD with randomized CRT vs IrCRT and DFS/OS/pCR endpoints fit predictive aim.
rationale_c3: DFS/OS for n=414; pCR available in 355 with evaluable resection pathology.
rationale_c4: Exploratory 0.5 TCD cut-off and treatment interaction without locked external validation.
rationale_c5: Trial CRT/IrCRT delivered under ARISTOTLE protocol as intended.
criteria_note: MMAT non-randomized (Hong 2018); post-hoc RCT biomarker analysis.
probast_rationale: Trial participants/outcome strong; AI TCD pretreatment OK; post-hoc cut-off and unvalidated predictive interaction drive analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Hypothesis-generating IrCRT benefit in TCD-high; authors call for independent TCD validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Biopsia pretratamiento en LARC de ensayo ARISTOTLE; interacción TCD-tratamiento (IrCRT vs CRT) informa quimiorradioterapia neoadyuvante. Sin regla H cumplida. | NOTA: H4 por autodeclaración (criterio único)

title: MRI-Based Radiomics to Predict Response to Neoadjuvant Therapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Retrospective Study.
rationale_c1: Single tertiary Pisa LARC series n=86; not shown as population-representative.
rationale_c2: Baseline MRI radiomics with mrTRG response endpoint fit neoadjuvant prediction aim.
rationale_c3: mrTRG outcomes reported for included patients under repeated CV.
rationale_c4: LASSO over 107 features then elastic-net without key clinical confounder lock.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy and MRI protocols applied as institutional practice described.
probast_rationale: Single-center convenience; baseline MRI OK; mrTRG not pathology; CV-only LASSO without external validation.
appraisal_note: Outcome is mrTRG at restaging, not pathologic pCR; authors note no external validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiomica basal de RM para anticipar no respuesta a neoadyuvancia en LARC; decision explicita (individualizar tratamiento). Regimenes mixtos pero la decision es la misma. Sin autodeclaracion piloto; falta de validacion externa no cuenta.

title: Development and evaluation of an explainable machine learning selection pipeline for predicting neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy response in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center retrospective LARC n=128; not shown as population-representative.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment tumor markers with pathology pCR/TRG fit the nCRT-response question.
rationale_c3: pCR and TRG outcomes reported for train/test splits after exclusions.
rationale_c4: Four-algorithm pool on small n with feature screening risks residual confounding/overfitting.
rationale_c5: nCRT and surgery delivered per institutional protocol as described.
probast_rationale: Single-center convenience; lab predictors pretreatment; pCR/TRG clear; internal split/CV only with algorithm shopping.
appraisal_note: Explainable ML selection pipeline (DT preferred); authors stress non-deployable sanity check; no external validation.

title: Development and validation of an interpretable machine learning model for predicting postoperative complications after transanal total mesorectal excision: a multicenter study.
rationale_c1: Three Chinese high-volume centers; not shown as population-representative.
rationale_c2: Clinical variables plus 30-day Clavien–Dindo complications fit periop risk question.
rationale_c3: Complication grades and rates reported in development and external sets.
rationale_c4: 11 ML algorithms after LASSO; residual confounding and algorithm shopping risk.
rationale_c5: taTME perioperative pathways applied as described across centers.
probast_rationale: Multicenter external AUC 0.87; ROB from postop day-1 CRP timing and multi-algorithm selection.
appraisal_note: Top SHAP predictor is postoperative CRP—usable for early postop triage more than preop counseling.
applicability_v2_rationale: NOTA: sensibilidad: autodeclaración de piloto/PoC; bajo criterio único sería high H4 (no se cambia: muestra fijada)

title: Photoacoustic-ultrasound endoscopy for assessment of rectal cancer treatment response: A prospective study with T2-weighted MRI radiomics comparison.
rationale_c1: Prospective ARPAM-US n=25 and retrospective MRI n=119 from one center; generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: ARPAM-US ResNet50 and T2 MRI radiomics vs pathology pCR address WW restaging.
rationale_c3: Limited complete responders preclude robust outcome completeness/head-to-head claims.
rationale_c4: Small-n DL with 5-fold CV and separate radiomics development risk optimism/confounding.
rationale_c5: Prospective endoscopy protocol and surgical pathology ground truth as described.
probast_rationale: Tiny prospective ARPAM cohort; novel photoacoustic predictors and CV-only DL yield high analysis ROB despite path pCR.
appraisal_note: GitHub ArpamGui noted; MRI radiomics failed prospective generalization; larger prospective validation needed.
applicability_v2_rationale: Imagen ARPAM-US adquirida en quirófano bajo anestesia, tras decidir cirugía: no disponible al decidir watch-and-wait (H3). Además se autodeclara prueba de concepto (H4).

title: Radiomics analysis of restaging MRI for detection of pathological complete response in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single tertiary referral series 2017–2022 after large exclusions (86/400); generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: Restaging T2 MRI radiomics with pathology pCR appropriate for post-NAT WW triage.
rationale_c3: pCR/non-pCR labels complete for final 86 patients.
rationale_c4: LASSO over 107 features with repeated CV only; no clinical confounder model.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy plus staging/restaging MRI and surgery applied as inclusion required.
probast_rationale: Single-center restaging MRI radiomics; no external validation; high-dim LASSO CV optimism.
appraisal_note: Internal repeated 5-fold CV only (mean AUC 0.74); authors note need for multicenter external validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC, MRI de reestadificación tras neoadyuvancia para identificar pCR; decisión explícita de preservación de órgano/watch-and-wait. Predictores disponibles en el momento de decisión. Ninguna H cumplida.

title: KRAS<sup>G12V/A146T</sup> mutations are associated with nCRT resistance via enhanced DNA double-strand break repair and support a deep learning prediction framework in LARC.
rationale_c1: Single-center National Cancer Center LARC WES/WSI cohort; representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment WES+WSI multimodal DL with pathology nCRT response endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Responder/NR labels and splits reported for internal/external genomic sets.
rationale_c4: Rare KRAS codon events preclude multivariable adjustment; authors flag exploratory signal.
rationale_c5: nCRT then TME protocol applied as specified for included LARC.
probast_rationale: Fusion model AUC 0.88 internal; external WES-only n=22 without WSI for full model; KRAS findings exploratory.
appraisal_note: Mechanistic KRAS assays secondary; prediction appraisal on genome–pathology fusion for nCRT response.
applicability_v2_rationale: Núcleo de descubrimiento y mecanismo (KRAS G12V/A146T, reparación de DSB); nexo terapéutico apoyado sobre todo en líneas celulares y xenoinjertos; modelo declarado orientado a investigación (H4 a, b, c).

title: Personalized neoadjuvant treatment regimen selection in locally advanced rectal cancer based on regimen-specific response modeling.
rationale_c1: Multicenter Chinese LARC NAT cohorts plus prospective test; population representativeness beyond tertiary care unclear.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment mpMRI MoE with regimen-specific pCR for TNT/nCRT/nCT matches selection aim.
rationale_c3: pCR labeled across retrospective train/val and prospective test (ChiCTR2400085797).
rationale_c4: Hard-gated MoE with prospective locked test limits optimism vs pure retrospective mining.
rationale_c5: Real-world MDT-assigned regimens applied as documented; not randomized allocation.
probast_rationale: Prospective multicenter regimen-selection MoE (AUC 0.79–0.83); residual ROB from nonrandomized regimen allocation and DL complexity.
appraisal_note: Personalized escalation/de-escalation DSS; article-in-press extract; no clear public code/data found.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pretratamiento y variables clínicas; probabilidades de pCR por régimen neoadyuvante en LARC; apoya selección de régimen (cohorte prospectiva). Sin regla H ni U.

title: Integrating CT-Based Radiomics Analysis With Serum CEA Level to Predict Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy Response in Colorectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center Taiwan CRC NACRT n=92; colon+rectum mix limits representativeness.
rationale_c2: Planning CT radiomics plus CEA with pathology pCR/TRG are appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR labels complete for derivation n=65 and internal validation n=27.
rationale_c4: LASSO on 111 radiomic features with random 7:3 split; residual overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: NACRT and surgery delivered per institutional protocol as stated.
probast_rationale: Single-center CRC (not rectum-only); pretreatment CT+CEA OK; pathology pCR clear; internal split only.
appraisal_note: Includes colon and rectum NACRT; Rad-score+CEA AUC validation 0.818 on n=27 holdout.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC de planificación pre-NACRT más CEA para predecir pCR y "guiar la modificación oportuna del tratamiento"; predictores rutinarios y previos a la decisión; CCR estadio II-III sin metástasis.

title: Automated deep learning model for predicting pathological complete response in rectal cancer: A tool to organ-preserving strategies.
rationale_c1: Retrospective single-center tertiary LARC series n=195; transportability unclear.
rationale_c2: Paired pre/post T2w MRI siamese CNN with Ryan/pCR endpoints appropriate for WW triage.
rationale_c3: Independent test n=49 with complete pathology-derived pCR labels reported.
rationale_c4: Deep multitask CNN on modest events without clinical confounder model; optimism risk.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery pathway applied as intended for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center selection; longitudinal MRI available post-nCRT for response assessment; pathology pCR; internal test only AUC 0.71.
appraisal_note: High-NPV screening profile for organ preservation; external multicenter validation explicitly required.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM pre/post nCRT para pCR y seleccion de W&W, momento de decision coherente. La etiqueta proof-of-concept aparece solo en Discusion al interpretar IC amplios; no se toma como naturaleza del trabajo. | NOTA: H4 por autodeclaración (criterio único)

title: MRI Based Radiomics as an Imaging Biomarker for Locally Advanced Carcinoma Rectum: Predicting Tumor Response Following Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy as an Organ Preservation Strategy.
rationale_c1: Single-center Indian LARC series; representativeness beyond tertiary care unclear.
rationale_c2: Baseline/post-NACTRT TexRAD features with CR vs PR/pCR endpoint match aims.
rationale_c3: Response classifications reported for n=100 with surgery/WW outcomes.
rationale_c4: RFE over 124 features with only 10-fold internal CV; residual confounding.
rationale_c5: NACTRT and MRI protocols applied as institutionally described.
probast_rationale: Single-center internal CV only; mixed CR definition (radiologic/clinical/pCR) and high-dim RFE.
appraisal_note: Authors note need for multicentric validation; includes post-treatment MRI features.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica MRI basal y post-NACTRT en LARC para predecir respuesta como 'organ preservation strategy'; predictores disponibles al momento de decidir preservación vs TME.

title: Use of artificial intelligence in analysis of endoscopic images to detect residual disease or regrowth in rectal patients with complete clinical response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Single tertiary WW endoscopy cohort (n=97); broader surveillance populations unclear.
rationale_c2: Wide ResNet-101-2 on proctosigmoidoscopy frames with histopathology-confirmed residual/regrowth.
rationale_c3: Patient-level 90/10 split outcomes fully reported (accuracy/AUROC).
rationale_c4: Frame-level DL without external site or clinical confounder adjustment beyond split.
rationale_c5: WW surveillance endoscopy pathway applied as intended.
probast_rationale: Single-center W&W residual/regrowth CNN; internal holdout only with class-imbalanced frames.
appraisal_note: First endoscopy DL tool for post-cCR residual detection; no external validation stated.
applicability_v2_rationale: IA endoscópica para detectar residuo/recrecimiento en cCR bajo watch and wait; informa rescate quirúrgico en el momento de vigilancia. Sin regla H.

title: Prediction of tumor regression grading in rectal cancer neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: a habitat radiomics analysis of imaging biomarker.
rationale_c1: Single-center retrospective CT habitat series (train n=85/test n=36); transportability unknown.
rationale_c2: Habitat/conventional CT radiomics with pathology TRG/pCR endpoints fit nCRT response prediction.
rationale_c3: Postoperative TRG available for included patients in train/test splits.
rationale_c4: High-dim habitat features with ExtraTrees/SVM/RF screen and internal 70/30 only.
rationale_c5: nCRT and resection pathway described for enrolled LARC patients.
probast_rationale: Internal split habitat radiomics for TRG/pCR; no independent external cohort; massive feature mining.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept per input; content is preoperative CT habitat TRG/pCR prediction after nCRT.
applicability_v2_rationale: TRG/pCR predicho con TC basal antes de nCRT en cáncer rectal localmente avanzado; nexo con estrategia neoadyuvante/preservación de órgano. No hay H1-H7 ni autodeclaración de piloto; falta de validación externa va a análisis.

title: Macro Habitat-Based T2-Weighted MRI Radiomics and Deep Learning Fusion for Predicting Treatment Response and Prognosis After Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Three tertiary Chinese hospitals; convenience LARC Stage II–III mix.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment T2 MRI habitat radiomics/DL with TRG and PFS endpoints match aims.
rationale_c3: TRG and PFS outcomes summarized across train/internal/external cohorts (n=434).
rationale_c4: LASSO over high-dim habitat+DL features without full clinical confounder lock.
rationale_c5: NACRT regimens delivered per institutional protocols as described.
probast_rationale: Multicenter habitat fusion with external AUCs 0.81–0.83; high-dim LASSO mining drives analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Secondary PFS association of risk score; primary appraisal is TRG response prediction.

title: Transformer-based Siamese multimodal imaging model for predicting pathological complete response after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Three-center Chinese LARC nCRT series; tertiary convenience sample.
rationale_c2: Pre/post MRI radiomics+Med3D DL Siamese transformer for pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR reported for train n=305 and internal validation n=135.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics/DL with LASSO/PCA fusion without external site lock.
rationale_c5: nCRT and MRI protocols applied as described across centers.
probast_rationale: Uses pre+post-nCRT MRI (restaging/WW context); internal-only validation and massive feature screen inflate analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Independent validation is within multicenter pool (135/440), not new external site; data/code on request.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predicción de pCR con RM pre y post nCRT para preservación de órgano/intensificación; predictores disponibles en la decisión; sin autodeclaración de prueba de concepto. Limitaciones genéricas (validación prospectiva) no cuentan.

title: Variant-to-Biomarker Integration and Mechanistic Validation Identify CES1 as a Copy Number-Linked Predictor of Radiotherapy Response in Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Public GEO rectal RT cohorts plus TCGA-READ; clinical case-mix representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Multi-algorithm gene model with CES1 functional assays and RT response labels fit aims.
rationale_c3: Responder/non-responder labels and assay endpoints reported across stated datasets.
rationale_c4: LASSO/RF/XGBoost consensus mining over transcriptomes without locked clinical covariates.
rationale_c5: GEO efficacy labels standardized; irradiation assays applied as described.
probast_rationale: GEO selection; pretreatment expression predictors; heterogeneous responder labels; high-dim nested ML despite external GEO.
appraisal_note: Strong mechanistic CES1 validation; clinical deployability still transcriptomic/GEO-bound.

title: Exploring Machine Learning Approaches for Decision Support in Neoadjuvant Therapy of Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Three Taiwan hospitals but still regional specialty mix; broader representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Clinical/lab features with response under nCCRT±CT match DSS neoadjuvant decision aims.
rationale_c3: Combined improved cohort n≈217 with performance metrics reported per regimen arm.
rationale_c4: Multiple ML classifiers and feature-rankers without locked external cohort inflate confounding risk.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant regimens as recorded in EMR applied per treated cohorts.
probast_rationale: Multi-hospital Taiwan EMR; pretreatment labs OK; response definition regimen-stratified; 10-fold internal only.
appraisal_note: Axis llm_dss; classical ML DSS for nCCRT±CT rather than LLM; data unavailable for ethics reasons.

title: Interpretable machine learning models based on CT radiomics for predicting chemoradiotherapy response in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Two Chongqing hospitals; tertiary LARC mix not population-sampled.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT radiomics plus CEA/CA19-9 with nCRT response fit aims.
rationale_c3: Responder rates and AUCs reported for train/internal/external sets.
rationale_c4: LASSO of 88 features then multi-algorithm pick; limited confounder control.
rationale_c5: Standardized long-course nCRT described and applied across cohorts.
probast_rationale: External n=49 helpful but LASSO mining and response definition (pCR mix) inflate analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: External pCR rate 40.8% vs ~21% train—cohort shift; data on request.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC pretratamiento + CEA/CA19-9 en LARC para predecir respuesta a nCRT y 'individualized treatment planning'; predictores de rutina, nexo terapéutico presente.

title: Interpretable Artificial Intelligence in Assisting Treatment Response Prediction for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer After Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy: A Prospective, Multicenter, Human-Model Interaction Study.
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
rationale_c1: LARC cohorts from tertiary Chinese centers; not shown as population-representative.
rationale_c2: Post-NAT MRI radiomics plus pathology pCR fit the decision question.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes reported in large train/test and prospective n=207 cohort.
rationale_c4: Clinicopathologic factors plus Radscore; prospective locked validation limits confounding.
rationale_c5: Imaging/path protocols and SPIRIT-AI prospective interaction followed as described.
probast_rationale: Prospective multicenter pCR DSS; residual ROB from retrospective development and train Youden cutoff.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept per pilot; content is post-nCRT pCR/organ-preservation DSS (NCT04278274).
applicability_v2_rationale: Cohorte LARC M0 uniforme; RM post-NAT/pre-TME (mediana 6 dias tras NAT) mas CEA/cT/cN, disponibles en el momento de decidir organo-preservacion vs cirugia; validacion prospectiva multicentrica y estudio de interaccion con radiologos. No se cumple ninguna regla H ni U.

title: Integrative analysis of transcriptomic data reveals a predictive gene signature for chemoradiotherapy response in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Six GEO transcriptomic LARC sets with heterogeneous platforms/metadata; representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: 186-gene ML signature for nCRT response with CMS/iCMS and spatial transcriptomics context.
rationale_c3: Response labels and cross-dataset performance (CV AUC ~0.80) reported.
rationale_c4: Integrative high-dim gene mining across public sets without locked prospective confounder control.
rationale_c5: nCRT exposure in source cohorts treated as intended for signature derivation.
probast_rationale: Exploratory multi-GEO 186-gene nCRT signature; response definitions and analysis optimism remain key ROB drivers.
appraisal_note: Zenodo data/code availability; authors call results hypothesis-generating pending prospective validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Firma transcriptomica de 186 genes integrando GEO, con enfoque biologico y generador de hipotesis; se autodeclara exploratorio. Ademas requiere transcriptoma no rutinario.

title: A noninvasive AI model based on multi-dimensional MRI features for predicting tertiary lymphoid structures, immunotherapy response, and prognosis in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Four specialty-center cohorts; representativeness beyond tertiary RC unclear.
rationale_c2: MRI multi-dim features with path TLS and immuno/DFS endpoints match aims.
rationale_c3: TLS labels and immuno/DFS outcomes reported across development and test sets.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics/habitat features with multi-algorithm screen risk residual confounding.
rationale_c5: MRI acquisition, TLS scoring, and model pipeline applied as specified.
probast_rationale: External/prospective TLS model strong; high-dim mining and secondary immuno n=94 inflate analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Immunotherapy pCR AUROC 0.74 is secondary on smaller cohort than TLS classification.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice TLS por RM y lo extrapola a respuesta a inmunoterapia (pCR, cohorte de 94); la introducción liga ICI a MSI-H, pero el estado MSI/dMMR no se reporta ni ajusta en esa cohorte.

title: Integrating single-cell and bulk transcriptomes identifies B cell features associated with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy sensitivity in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Public GEO bulk/scRNA cohorts plus single-hospital external n=64; representativeness beyond omics repositories unclear.
rationale_c2: B-cell signature genes with nCRT pCR labels address radiosensitivity prediction.
rationale_c3: pCR and survival endpoints reported for train/GEO and hospital external sets.
rationale_c4: Scissor/multi-ML gene mining with limited clinical confounder adjustment.
rationale_c5: nCRT+surgery inclusion for hospital cohort as described.
probast_rationale: Transcriptomic B-cell signature→pCR; GEO performance mixed (GSE45404 AUC 0.65) vs hospital external 0.819; high-dim ML analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Primarily single-cell discovery with secondary ML pCR model; prediction appraisal applied to pCR classifier.
applicability_v2_rationale: Núcleo es descubrimiento bioinformático de subpoblaciones de células B con mecanismos inferidos in silico; el modelo de pCR es secundario. H4(b) y (c).

title: MR-DELTAnet: A Longitudinal MRI-Transformer Model Predicting Pathological Complete Response and Revealing Immune Microenvironment via scRNA-seq in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Four Chinese centers n=1026; tertiary referral mix not population-framed.
rationale_c2: Longitudinal pre/post-NCRT MRI Transformer with pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR and survival outcomes reported for train/internal/external cohorts.
rationale_c4: Large locked external validation and standardized NCRT/TME limit residual confounding.
rationale_c5: Standardized neoadjuvant regimens and TME criteria applied across centers.
probast_rationale: MR-DELTAnet AUCs 0.88–0.90 in validation; residual ROB from retrospective DL development despite external lock.
appraisal_note: Code at github.com/WuLei-MedIA/mr_deltanet; scRNA-seq is mechanistic adjunct not primary endpoint.
applicability_v2_rationale: Cohorte LARC M0 con RM pre/post NCRT (momento de decision correcto) y validacion interna/externa para pCR. BORDERLINE: el analisis scRNA-seq es un anadido mecanistico (H4 considerado) pero el nucleo es un modelo predictivo validado.

title: A comprehensive feature importance analysis of surgical site infection following colorectal cancer surgery.
rationale_c1: Single-center Mashhad CRC surgery registry; generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: Preoperative labs/clinical factors with 30-day SSI CDC categories fit risk modeling.
rationale_c3: SSI status ascertained for 528 included after exclusions.
rationale_c4: RF/XGBoost feature importance with LOOCV; limited multivariable confounding control.
rationale_c5: Curative CRC resections and SSI surveillance applied per registry protocol.
probast_rationale: Single-center SSI risk ML; no external validation; LOOCV optimism and unclear outcome blinding.
appraisal_note: Primarily feature-importance SSI risk rather than locked clinical DSS; still predictive ML appraisal.
applicability_v2_rationale: Análisis de factores de riesgo de ISQ para decisiones de prevención con predictores intra y posoperatorios (duración de cirugía, técnica, estoma, TNM patológico) no disponibles en la decisión preoperatoria que dice informar.

title: Exploring radiomic and topological features to evaluate treatment response in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: INNATE trial imaging subset n=21 (Arm1/2); tiny selected sample.
rationale_c2: Delta radiomics/TDA from paired MRI with MR/pCR response categories are fit-for-purpose.
rationale_c3: Response labels available for 21 analyzed patients after imaging exclusions.
rationale_c4: Exploratory classifiers on n=21 with integrated AUC 0.944; overfitting acknowledged.
rationale_c5: Trial SCRT±anti-CD40 and MRI protocol delivered as INNATE specified.
probast_rationale: Very small trial subset; delta features need post-NAT MRI; clear MR/PR labels; no external lock.
appraisal_note: Axis other; exploratory TDA+radiomics on INNATE NCT04130854; authors warn against overclaiming.
applicability_v2_rationale: n=21, analisis de caracteristicas topologicas y diferencias entre brazos con inmunoterapia anti-CD40; nucleo exploratorio y de mecanismo mas que prediccion aplicable.

title: Development and validation of machine-learning model based on dynamic tumor markers in predicting pathological complete response after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer: a multicenter cohort study.
rationale_c1: Multicenter Fujian LARC NCRT series with two external hospitals addresses pCR prediction population.
rationale_c2: Dynamic CEA/CA19-9 DTMS plus clinicopathologic factors and pathology pCR are fit-for-purpose.
rationale_c3: Development n=892 plus two external cohorts with AUCs 0.80/0.82 fully reported.
rationale_c4: Ten-algorithm bake-off after multivariable screening; residual selection optimism despite external hold.
rationale_c5: NCRT and TME pathways applied as described across centers.
probast_rationale: Tertiary Chinese multicenter; dynamic markers available peri-NCRT; pathology pCR; XGB external AUCs good but multi-algo development.
appraisal_note: Website DSS for DTMS-XGB; some data available on request; among stronger batch neoadj designs.
applicability_v2_rationale: Marcadores CEA/CA19-9 pre y post NCRT (disponibles antes de cirugía) predicen pCR en LARC; 'practical tool for treatment decision-making'. Sin regla H.

title: Deep Learning-Based Multimodal Prediction of NAC Response in LARC by Integrating MRI and Proteomics.
rationale_c1: Single Chinese cancer hospital LARC NAC cohort; referral bias likely.
rationale_c2: MRI DL plus proteomics GNN with RECIST OR vs NR endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response labels and metrics reported for train/val/test partitions.
rationale_c4: High-dim multimodal DL with tiny held-out test n=16; overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: NAC regimens and imaging/proteomics pipelines applied as described.
probast_rationale: Test AUC 0.828 on n=16 multimodal; proteomics availability limits bedside use.
appraisal_note: Axis other (NAC not CRT); RECIST radiologic response rather than pCR.
applicability_v2_rationale: El modelo integrado exige proteomica 4D-DIA (timsTOF) de FFPE pretratamiento, no obtenible en la practica de rutina; el test set es de 16 pacientes. BORDERLINE: los autores diseñaron imputacion cero para uso solo-RM, pero el modelo principal depende de proteomica.

title: Interpretable machine learning model for predicting perioperative Clavien-Dindo III/IV complications of rectal cancer anterior resection after neoadjuvant therapy: a real-world study.
rationale_c1: Large single-center Xijing NAT+AR series (n=3255); transportability beyond tertiary China unclear.
rationale_c2: Pre/postop hematologic ratios with Clavien-Dindo III/IV after anterior resection are appropriate.
rationale_c3: Complication labels and test-set metrics (GBM AUC 0.94) fully reported.
rationale_c4: Ten competing ML algorithms on dynamic lab ratios without strong clinical confounder lock.
rationale_c5: NAT then anterior resection peri-op pathway delivered as described.
probast_rationale: Very large single-center complication model; postop ratio timing and multi-algorithm mining inflate predictor/analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: SHAP highlights Hb/RBC/Ca ratios; internal random split only.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice complicaciones Clavien-Dindo III/IV con razones de hemoglobina/calcio pre y postoperatorias (24 h); el paper solo dice 'guia para la practica clinica' sin nombrar la decision terapeutica. GAP: las reglas no cubren prediccion de complicaciones quirurgicas; U3 es la regla literal mas cercana (H3/H6 considerados). BORDERLINE.

title: Comparative analysis of tumor and mesorectum radiomics in predicting neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy response in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-institution LARC MRI series n=101; not population sampling.
rationale_c2: Tumor and mesorectum multiparametric MRI radiomics with modified Ryan response grades appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response labels complete for 101 included patients.
rationale_c4: LASSO top-5 features plus SMOTE and multi-classifier CV without key clinical confounders.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant CRT and MRI protocols applied as stated for included cases.
probast_rationale: 10-fold CV only; SMOTE in training folds; combined tumor+mesorectum AUC 0.837 without external lock.
appraisal_note: No independent external validation; METRICS quality discussed but does not replace external testing.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pre-CRT de tumor y mesorrecto para predecir respuesta patológica en CCR localmente avanzado, cohorte homogénea. Sin autodeclaración exploratoria; validación multicéntrica pendiente no cuenta.

title: Development and Cross-Institutional Validation of a Comprehensive Machine Learning Model Predicting Response to Neoadjuvant Therapy for Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Beijing Cancer Hospital development plus small Guowen external n=26.
rationale_c2: Clinical+CT/MRI radiomics+dosiomics for pCR after nCRT fit aims.
rationale_c3: pCR labels and AUCs reported for CV, internal and external tests (n=183+26).
rationale_c4: Multi-modality radiomics/dosiomics feature mining without locked confounder set.
rationale_c5: Preoperative nCRT then surgery delivered as institutional standard.
probast_rationale: F_model external AUC 0.74; small incomplete external set and high-dim fusion inflate analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Clinical-only C_model competitive; imaging modalities add modest incremental value.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice pCR antes de cirugía con clínica, RM/TC basal, dosimetría y variables post-nCRT para preservación de órgano; predictores disponibles en el punto de decisión post-nCRT; sin autodeclaración exploratoria.

title: Predicting near-complete pathological response to (chemo)radiotherapy in patients with rectal cancer: A federated learning study.
rationale_c1: Federated Maastro+Gemelli rectal RT cohorts; two European centers only.
rationale_c2: Clinical/planning variables with near-complete response for boost/WW triage appropriate.
rationale_c3: Substantial missingness handled in BN; completeness of NCR labels uneven across sites.
rationale_c4: Structure learning maximizes train fit; CV/holdout within same centers; single-clinic models fail cross-site.
rationale_c5: (Chemo)radiotherapy delivered per institutional practice as modeled.
probast_rationale: Federated BN AUC 0.77 for NCR; no true external clinic beyond the two training sites; missing-data/structure overfitting risks.
appraisal_note: Federated learning strength is privacy-preserving pooling; authors note need for further external clinics.
applicability_v2_rationale: Cohorte de Maastro+Gemelli mezcla cirugia con 5x5Gy (81% en Maastro) y quimiorradioterapia larga, e incluye M1/Mx (9%/12% en Maastro); la decision (boost para evitar cirugia) no es la misma y no hay resultados por contexto. BORDERLINE: el uso declarado (boost de radioterapia) si es terapeutico.

title: Immunophenotype-guided interpretable radiomics model for predicting neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 response in stage III-IV d-MMR/MSI-H colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Multicenter stage III–IV dMMR/MSI-H CRC anti-PD-1 cohorts from specialty centers.
rationale_c2: Immunophenotype-guided radiomics with neoadjuvant IO response endpoints match aims.
rationale_c3: Response and immunophenotype labels reported for training and validation sets.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics plus decision-tree mining; train AUC 0.965 suggests optimism.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 and imaging/path protocols applied as described.
probast_rationale: Selected MSI-H IO centers; pretreatment imaging predictors; IO response defined; analysis optimism despite multicenter claims.
appraisal_note: Data available upon reasonable request; immunotherapy pCR/response is primary therapeutic endpoint.
applicability_v2_rationale: d-MMR/MSI-H estadio III-IV con anti-PD-1 neoadyuvante: elegibilidad medida; TC pretratamiento (lesiones metastásicas excluidas de la segmentación); decisión y desenlace pCR claros.

title: Radiation enteritis associated with temporal sequencing of total neoadjuvant therapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: a preliminary study.
rationale_c1: Single-center TNT LARC n=92 preliminary series; generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-RT T2 MRI delta-radiomics plus CTCAE-based SARE score address toxicity prediction.
rationale_c3: SARE labels and independent test metrics (AUC 0.711) reported after exclusions.
rationale_c4: LASSO over multi-strategy delta features on small n without key toxicity confounders (dose/volume).
rationale_c5: TNT radiotherapy delivered per protocol for included patients.
probast_rationale: SARE defined in first 2 weeks of RT yet best model uses post-RT delta fusion—predictors not available for claimed early risk; composite toxicity scoring.
appraisal_note: Critical timing mismatch: post-RT MRI informing early-RT SARE; applicability high concern for pretreatment toxicity DSS.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI 'during the second week of radiotherapy' y desenlace SARE 'within the first 2 weeks of radiotherapy': predictor concurrente con el desenlace, no disponible al decidir la secuencia de TNT.

title: Baseline MRI habitat imaging for predicting treatment response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single Fujian Provincial Hospital LARC series; not population-based.
rationale_c2: Baseline MRI habitat/radiomics with TRG good vs poor response fit aims.
rationale_c3: TRG outcomes reported for train n=127 and test n=54.
rationale_c4: LASSO multi-model building with large train–test AUC drop suggests overfitting.
rationale_c5: nCRT variants described; delivered as per institutional pathways.
probast_rationale: Random split single-center; Clinic+Habitat test AUC 0.71 with clear optimism in training.
appraisal_note: Best test model Clinic+Habitat AUC 0.710; radiomics-alone test AUC 0.619.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM basal y clínicos para predecir buena respuesta a nCRT en LARC; decisión terapéutica explícita ("personalized treatment decision-making"). Falta de validación externa va a análisis (H5).

title: A comparative study of machine learning models for predicting neoadjuvant chemoradiotheraphy response in rectal cancer patients using radiomics and clinical features.
rationale_c1: Turkish LARC convenience cohorts with small external n=40; population sampling unclear.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT radiomics plus clinical labs vs Ryan TRG responder/nonresponder fit aims.
rationale_c3: Train/internal/external performance fully reported for top Extra Trees model.
rationale_c4: Fifteen ML models over radiomics+clinical features risk residual confounding/optimism.
rationale_c5: Long-course nCRT before surgery administered per stated pathway.
probast_rationale: External ETC AUC 0.79; clinical features dominated radiomics; multi-model screen keeps analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: External validation present but modest n; tumor grade most influential.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC contrastada pre-tratamiento y datos clínicos basales para predecir no respuesta a nCRT en cáncer de recto localmente avanzado; "unlikely to benefit" evitar toxicidad; predictores disponibles antes de decidir.

title: Rectal-RadioSAM: Large model-assisted multi-parametric magnetic resonance imaging pipeline for predicting response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in rectal cancer without human intervention.
rationale_c1: Single-center consecutive LARC MRI series (~378); further multicenter validation needed.
rationale_c2: MedSAM segmentation plus XGBoost radiomics for pathology pCR fit automated response assessment.
rationale_c3: pCR labels available for train and independent internal test (112).
rationale_c4: Large-model radiomics pipeline with high-dim features; single-center holdout only.
rationale_c5: Standard nCRT and MRI acquisition described for included patients.
probast_rationale: Fully automated pre/post-nCRT MRI pipeline AUC ~0.83 on internal test; single-center without true external site.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept per input; content is automated pCR prediction (Rectal-RadioSAM; GitHub Post-nCRT/Rectal-RadioSAM).
applicability_v2_rationale: Pipeline MedSAM+XGBoost para pCR tras nCRT, con RM pre y post-nCRT disponibles antes de cirugia; decision (manejo quirurgico/no quirurgico) enunciada. Sin autodeclaracion piloto.

title: Predicting acute diarrhoea in rectal cancer chemoradiotherapy: Secondary analysis of the phase III ARISTOTLE trial.
rationale_c1: Secondary analysis of phase III ARISTOTLE across 73 institutions (n=500 analyzable).
rationale_c2: AI small-bowel V10Gy plus age/ECOG/arm predicting CTCAE diarrhoea ΔG≥2 appropriate.
rationale_c3: Acute diarrhoea grades recorded weekly; exclusions for missing RT/toxicity documented.
rationale_c4: Parsimonious logistic model with trial-arm and DVH covariate; bootstrap institution splits.
rationale_c5: CRT delivered per ARISTOTLE protocol (capecitabine±irinotecan).
probast_rationale: Trial multicentre diarrhoea predictor AUROC ~0.71; residual ROB from post-hoc design and symptom-grade outcome.
appraisal_note: Prediction appraisal on logistic toxicity model using AI-segmented bowel V10; not an RCT efficacy analysis.
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelo logístico con edad, ECOG, V10Gy de intestino delgado y brazo para predecir diarrea aguda y guiar reducción de dosis o adición de irinotecán; datos disponibles en planificación.

title: RCMIX model based on pre-treatment MRI imaging predicts T-downstage in MRI-cT4 stage rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Three Chinese hospitals MRI-cT4 NAT series; specialty-center selection.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI radiomics+clinical MLP for pathology T-downstage appropriate to resection planning.
rationale_c3: T-downstage and DFS reported for train and two external test centers.
rationale_c4: Radiomics selection to 19 features then MLP; high-dim mining with train AUC 0.90 vs external ~0.78.
rationale_c5: NAT and TME applied as intended across centers.
probast_rationale: Genuine two-center external tests help; residual analysis ROB from radiomics selection optimism.
appraisal_note: Axis other (T-downstage surgery plane) kept; therapeutic NAT decision support relevant to AICRC_TX.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pretratamiento en cT4 sin metástasis predice T-downstage; 'prompting clinicians to intensify treatment' y guiar plano de resección. Sin regla H.

title: Machine learning prediction model of prolonged delay to loop ileostomy closure after rectal cancer surgery: a retrospective study.
rationale_c1: Single large Chinese oncology hospital ileostomy series n=442; generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: Clinical/pathologic predictors with delayed loop ileostomy closure endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: Closure delay status reported for all 442 analyzed patients (69% delayed).
rationale_c4: LASSO then XGBoost on 75/25 split without independent external cohort.
rationale_c5: Surgical pathway and stoma management applied as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Single-center convenience; perioperative predictors available; delay definition clear; internal validation only.
appraisal_note: No datasets generated statement; tox_surg axis (ileostomy closure timing).
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice retraso del cierre de ileostomía con datos postoperatorios; decisión quirúrgica de momento de cierre declarada explícitamente. No cumple H1-H7; no es U3 porque el uso es explícito. Duda sobre relevancia oncológica.

title: MRI radiomics combined with delta-radiomics model for predicting pathological complete response in locally advanced rectal cancer patients after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: A multi-institutional study.
rationale_c1: Multi-institutional LARC n=198 with external validation sets address multicenter pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Pre/post DWI/T2 delta-radiomics plus clinical features and pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: Internal and external validation AUCs reported across model variants.
rationale_c4: LASSO/PCA with four classifiers and many modality combinations opens overfitting without locked pipeline.
rationale_c5: nCRT and imaging protocols applied across centers as described.
probast_rationale: Multi-site Chinese cohorts; pre/post MRI available for post-nCRT decision; pCR clear; external AUC drop (~0.73) with feature/classifier shopping.
appraisal_note: Data available on request; multi-modal fusion best internally but external performance modest.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica pre/post nCRT y delta para predecir pCR y elegir preservación de órgano frente a TME; imágenes post-nCRT disponibles al decidir; sin autodeclaración de prueba de concepto.

title: Inclusion of tumor periphery in radiomics analysis of magnetic resonance images does not improve predictions of preoperative therapy response in patients with rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-cohort n=106 pretreatment MRI; sampling frame limited.
rationale_c2: T2w/DWI radiomics comparing ROI strategies with pCR/NAR/recurrence endpoints.
rationale_c3: pCR and NAR outcomes summarized with bootstrap AUC comparisons.
rationale_c4: Multiple segmentation/sequence strategies and ML without locked external test.
rationale_c5: Preoperative radio(chemo)therapy delivered as described for eligible patients.
probast_rationale: Methodologic ROI comparison with internal bootstrap; high-dim radiomics ROB remains.
appraisal_note: Primary finding negative for periphery inclusion; still predictive model appraisal.
applicability_v2_rationale: Comparacion de ROI (periferia tumoral) para predecir pCR/NAR tras terapia preoperatoria con RM basal; nexo terapeutico explicito (respuesta). Duda leve: regimenes mixtos y decision poco declarada; no cumple H1 ni U3 con claridad.

title: Integration of Deep Learning and Sub-regional Radiomics Improves the Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Patients.
rationale_c1: Three-hospital LARC nCRT+TME cohort (n=768) with two external tests addresses pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment T2 MRI sub-regional radiomics plus 3D ResNet50 features with AJCC/CAP pCR.
rationale_c3: pCR labels and AUCs reported in train and two external tests (~0.90–0.92).
rationale_c4: Combined SRADL held externally; survival separation by predicted pCR supports limited residual confounding.
rationale_c5: Standard nCRT then radical surgery applied across centers as described.
probast_rationale: Strong multicenter external AUCs for pretreatment pCR; residual ROB from retrospective selection and high-dim DL/radiomics fusion.
appraisal_note: SRADL standout external performance; no public code/data statement found in extracted text.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC M0, MRI T2 pretratamiento, pCR para personalizar el tratamiento perioperatorio; tres centros con test externo. Ninguna H ni U se cumple.

title: A Machine Learning Model Based on MRI Radiomics to Predict Response to Chemoradiation Among Patients with Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Prospective-substudy single-center MRI cohort n=102 plus small external n=30; limited transportability.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI radiomics with TME pathology pCR are appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR/non-pCR reported in train/validation/external sets (external only 4 pCR events).
rationale_c4: Multi-classifier radiomics ensembles without strong clinical confounder control; tiny external events.
rationale_c5: pCRT and TME pathway applied per prospective parent study.
probast_rationale: Internal AUC ~0.73; external n=30 with only 4 pCR makes performance unstable despite reported accuracy 80%.
appraisal_note: STARD-framed prospective substudy; external validation underpowered for pCR.
applicability_v2_rationale: NOTA: sensibilidad: autodeclaración de piloto/PoC; bajo criterio único sería high H4 (no se cambia: muestra fijada)

title: Combined transrectal ultrasound and radiomics model for evaluating the therapeutic effects of neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center LARC TRUS series n=190; population sampling not shown.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-NCRT TRUS parameters±radiomics with TRG good/poor response appropriate.
rationale_c3: GRG/PRG (53/137) and model AUCs reported for internal validation.
rationale_c4: Radiomics feature selection/LR-Lasso without external lock or key clinical confounders.
rationale_c5: NCRT then surgery pathway applied as stated for eligible cases.
probast_rationale: Combined TRUS-radiomics AUC ~0.85 internal only; post-treatment predictors and no external validation.
appraisal_note: Post-NCRT TRUS features limit pretreatment decision use; authors call for multicenter verification.
applicability_v2_rationale: TRUS y radiómica pre/post nCRT en LARC antes de cirugía para predecir TRG; vinculado a vigilancia y espera. Predictores disponibles antes de la decisión.

title: Computed Tomography Scan and Clinical-based Complete Response Prediction in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer after Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy: A Machine Learning Approach.
rationale_c1: Single-center n=50 LARC CT radiomics; far from population-representative.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT radiomics plus clinicopathology for pCR/response appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response labels available for included 50 patients.
rationale_c4: 851 features with RF on tiny sample and internal split only; severe overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: nCRT and surgery delivered as stated for candidates.
probast_rationale: Very small single-center development; high-dim RF without external validation.
appraisal_note: JMSS methods paper; performance claims likely optimistic given n=50.
applicability_v2_rationale: Lectura low: predictores "initial T and N", grado, edad y radiómica de TC pre-tratamiento. Lectura high (H3): el resumen dice que T/N, LVI y PNI provienen del "surgical pathology report", posterior a resección. Contradictorio.

title: Pathomics-based machine learning models for predicting pathological complete response and prognosis in locally advanced rectal cancer patients post-neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: insights from two independent institutional studies.
rationale_c1: Two Chinese institutions LARC n=294 (244 internal/50 external); referral mix.
rationale_c2: Pre-NCRT pathomics WSIs with pCR and DFS/OS endpoints are appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR and survival outcomes reported across internal and external cohorts.
rationale_c4: LASSO 47 features then XGB with internal AUC 1.000 indicates severe overfitting.
rationale_c5: NCRT and TME pathways applied as stated at both centers.
probast_rationale: Dual-center selection; pretreatment pathomics OK; pathology pCR clear; train AUC 1.0 drives high analysis ROB despite external AUC 0.95.
appraisal_note: External n=50 from second institution; perfect train AUC is a major analysis red flag.
applicability_v2_rationale: H&E de biopsia pre-NCRT para pCR (y DFS secundaria) en cT3/4 o N+; predictores disponibles antes de decidir. Sin H4; validación externa pequeña es asunto de análisis.

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Volumetric Analysis of Muscle Mass as a Predictor of Tumor Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Patients with Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center rectal nCRT n=86 convenience series; representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: AI volumetric SMI with logistic nCRT response and Cox survival endpoints fit stated aims.
rationale_c3: Response and survival outcomes reported for all 86 included after exclusions.
rationale_c4: Binary sarcopenia logistic/Cox with limited multivariable clinical adjustment.
rationale_c5: nCRT then curative resection administered as intended for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center; pretreatment volumetric SMI available; response/survival defined; association model without discrimination validation cohort.
appraisal_note: AI mainly for muscle segmentation (U-Net); prediction appraisal on sarcopenia→response/survival association akin to pilot 000160.
applicability_v2_rationale: Sarcopenia volumétrica pre-nCRT predice mala respuesta, pero el paper no dice qué decisión informa ('physicians should pay attention'); parte pronóstica secundaria. Uso terapéutico solo implícito.

title: Prediction of T Stage of Rectal Cancer After Neoadjuvant Therapy by Multi-Parameter Magnetic Resonance Radiomics Based on Machine Learning Algorithms.
rationale_c1: Single-center consecutive RC n=171; tertiary convenience sample.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment multiparametric MRI radiomics targeting post-NAT ypT stage.
rationale_c3: ypT labels and train/test AUCs reported across clinical/radiomics/fusion models.
rationale_c4: LASSO plus multi-classifier shopping with very high train AUCs (≈0.97).
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy and TME pathway applied as eligibility required.
probast_rationale: Internal split only; fusion LR test AUC 0.932 with optimistic training metrics.
appraisal_note: Predicts ypT rather than pCR; still therapy-response relevant.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pretratamiento (<2 semanas) predice pT tras neoadyuvancia 'to guide clinical decision-making'; LARC homogéneo. Sin regla H.

title: CLIP-based multimodal endorectal ultrasound enhances prediction of neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy response in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center Sixth Affiliated Hospital LARC ERUS series (n=577); external transportability unclear.
rationale_c2: CLIP image-text ERUS features with TRG0 vs TRG1–3 good/poor response are appropriate.
rationale_c3: AUROC/calibration/DCA and radiomics comparator subset reported.
rationale_c4: High-dim CLIP embeddings into LightGBM without external locked validation.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery pathway and ERUS acquisition as specified.
probast_rationale: Single-center multimodal ERUS CLIP model; internal performance strong but analysis optimism high.
appraisal_note: Images not shareable (IRB); Chinese-CLIP RN50/VB16 compared with manual radiomics.
applicability_v2_rationale: Cohorte LARC uT3-4 con ERUS pre-nCRT mas informe de texto, disponibles antes del tratamiento; el paper nombra el uso (identificar malos respondedores para intervencion temprana/ajuste del plan). BORDERLINE: la decision especifica es vaga (U3 considerado).

title: ResNet-Vision Transformer based MRI-endoscopy fusion model for predicting treatment response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: A multicenter study.
rationale_c1: Eight Chinese tertiary hospitals with independent external test address multicenter LARC nCRT response.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI+endoscopy ResNet-ViT fusion with TRG good vs non-good response is fit-for-purpose.
rationale_c3: Response labels complete across train/internal/external (n=366 total).
rationale_c4: Deep multimodal fusion may leave residual optimism despite temporal internal split and external test.
rationale_c5: nCRT then radical surgery pathways consistent with inclusion criteria.
probast_rationale: Genuine multicenter external AUC 0.769 for fusion model; residual analysis uncertainty from DL architecture competition without locked classic EPV analysis.
appraisal_note: Stronger batch-02 design (8-center external); code/data sharing not clearly public beyond supplement links.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM y endoscopia pretratamiento para predecir respuesta a nCRT e informar intensificación (TNT) o cirugía directa; predictores disponibles antes de tratar; sin H1-H7.

title: Exploring Intratumoral Budding in Colorectal Cancer Using Computational Pathology: A Biopsy-Based Evaluation.
rationale_c1: Test cohort single-center CRC; NAT validation multi-center but still referral/trial mix.
rationale_c2: AI TB on biopsy/resection with OS and neoadjuvant response endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: OS follow-up and pCR/TRG/downstaging reported in stated cohorts.
rationale_c4: Multivariable Cox for OS and logistic models for pCR adjust key pathologic factors.
rationale_c5: Budding algorithm and response grading applied uniformly as described.
probast_rationale: AI biopsy TB predicts neoadjuvant pCR (OR 0.3); more biomarker association than full TRIPOD model.
appraisal_note: Prediction appraisal applied to AI-derived biopsy TB→pCR/OS; detector architecture largely via prior citation.

title: Predicting pathological complete response following neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer using merged model integrating MRI-based radiomics and deep learning data.
rationale_c1: Two institutional LARC cohorts (197+52); convenience referral series.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-nCRT MRI radiomics+DL merged model for pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes and AUCs reported for test and validation cohorts.
rationale_c4: LASSO radiomics plus DL feature fusion without locked clinical confounder set.
rationale_c5: nCRT then resection delivered uniformly as described.
probast_rationale: Merged pre-nCRT model AUC 0.74 on cohort-2 validation; high-dim mining and same-system validation.
appraisal_note: Authors note lack of fully independent external cohort as limitation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelo fusionado con RM pre-nCRT para pCR y seleccion de candidatos a preservacion de organo; cohorte homogenea (quimiorradioterapia larga) y validacion externa. Sin H aplicable.

title: Is an Electronic Nose Able to Predict Clinical Response following Neoadjuvant Treatment of Rectal Cancer? A Prospective Pilot Study.
rationale_c1: Prospective two-Dutch-hospital eNose pilot; selected WW/nCRT pathway patients.
rationale_c2: Breath VOCs with clinical complete response after neoadjuvant therapy fit pilot predictive aim.
rationale_c3: Train/test partitions with response labels reported (eligible pools n=66/106 after exclusions).
rationale_c4: No overfitting correction/internal validation of training; train AUC 0.86 collapses to test 0.63.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant scRT/CRT pathways delivered per institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Prospective pilot positives on design; analysis ROB high from failed generalization and no locked model.
appraisal_note: Authors explicitly note lack of internal validation of training set.
applicability_v2_rationale: Se autodeclara estudio piloto en título y resumen; el modelo no logra discriminar respuesta (AUC 0,63). H4(a).

title: Computed Tomography-Based Radiomics with Machine Learning Outperforms Radiologist Assessment in Estimating Colorectal Liver Metastases Pathologic Response After Chemotherapy.
rationale_c1: Single-institution CRLM resection after chemo n=95 tumors; selected operable metastases.
rationale_c2: Post-chemo CT radiomics vs RECIST/morphology with pathologic response are fit.
rationale_c3: Pathologic response labels reported for train 68 and validation 27 tumors.
rationale_c4: Random forest on radiomic features with internal 70/30 split only.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant chemo and hepatectomy pathway as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Single-center; post-treatment CT predictors (not pretreatment selection); pathology response clear; no external validation.
appraisal_note: Post-chemo CT radiomics estimates path response better than RECIST (AUC 0.87 vs 0.53); informs surgery timing not baseline regimen choice.
applicability_v2_rationale: CRLM resecadas tras quimioterapia; TC postratamiento disponible antes de decidir cirugía/cambio de terapia; respuesta patológica informa manejo. Sin H ni U.

title: Prediction of pathological response and lymph node metastasis after neoadjuvant therapy in rectal cancer through tumor and mesorectal MRI radiomic features.
rationale_c1: Single-center Peking University Third Hospital LARC n=209; no external site.
rationale_c2: Tumor and mesorectal MRI radiomics with pCR/pGR/LNM endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Train/test 146/63 with complete pathology endpoints reported.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics with correlation filter then LASSO across 30 logistic models; overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: IMRT nCRT and TME applied per protocol as described.
probast_rationale: Single-center; pre/delta MRI predictors; pathology endpoints clear; internal 7:3 only.
appraisal_note: Combined tumor+MC pre/delta models AUC ~0.80–0.87; authors note lack of external validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica RM pre y delta (post-nCRT, previa a cirugía) de tumor y mesorrecto para pCR/pGR/LNM en LARC; nexo con decisión watch-and-wait explícito.

title: Predictive value of circulating lymphocyte subsets and inflammatory indexes for neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy response in rectal mucinous adenocarcinoma patients: A machine learning approach.
rationale_c1: Single Fujian Union Hospital rectal MAC series; niche histology limits representativeness.
rationale_c2: Circulating lymphocyte/inflammatory indexes with pathologic NCRT response fit aims.
rationale_c3: Good vs poor pathologic response labeled for n=283 with model metrics.
rationale_c4: Nomogram plus XGB/SHAP; confounder control incompletely described.
rationale_c5: NCRT and curative resection administered per institutional protocol.
probast_rationale: Single-center MAC-only; data not publicly available; analysis ROB from ML without external lock.
appraisal_note: Mucinous adenocarcinoma subset; authors state data should not be publicly available.
applicability_v2_rationale: Linfocitos circulantes/índices inflamatorios, estadio cT y tipo macroscópico, "accessible prior to NCRT", para predecir respuesta a NCRT en adenocarcinoma mucinoso rectal sin metástasis; decisión de NCRT coherente.

title: Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based radiomics model explained by the Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) method for predicting complete response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: a multicenter retrospective study.
rationale_c1: Three-center LARC MRI cohort (n=285) with external set (n=44) addresses cCR/pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment T1/T2 PyRadiomics+LASSO MLP with SHAP and pathology/clinical CR endpoints.
rationale_c3: cCR/pCR AUCs and calibration/DCA reported across train and external sets.
rationale_c4: LASSO over multiparametric radiomics without full clinical confounder lock despite SHAP.
rationale_c5: nCRT protocols across centers applied as described.
probast_rationale: Multicenter with small external n=44; LASSO radiomics mining keeps analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Clinical-radiomic models best for pCR (mean AUC ~0.81); SHAP interpretability emphasized.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM y clínica pretratamiento para predecir cCR y pCR dentro de cCR, informando intensificación y espera-vigilancia; predictores disponibles en la decisión; sin autodeclaración exploratoria.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging radiomics-based prediction of severe inflammatory response in locally advanced rectal cancer patients after neoadjuvant radiochemotherapy.
rationale_c1: Single-hospital LARC series 2017–2019 (n=86; 65/21 split); no external site.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-nCRT MRI delta radiomics with severe pathologic inflammatory response and operative difficulty fit tox/surgery aims.
rationale_c3: Inflammation grades and operative outcomes reported for train/test.
rationale_c4: LASSO on 960 features; pre-nCRT model test AUC collapsed to 0.54 showing optimism risk.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant radiochemotherapy and radical surgery delivered as described.
probast_rationale: Delta features need post-nCRT MRI; outcome is pathologic inflammation (surrogate for surgical difficulty) with unclear blinding; internal-only high-dim analysis.
appraisal_note: Authors explicitly note no external verification; delta-RF test AUC 0.85 but pre-only model fails externally to holdout.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica delta-MRI pre-cirugía predice inflamación severa tras RT neoadyuvante para guiar manejo quirúrgico ('optimize the operation'); predictores disponibles antes de cirugía; LARC homogéneo.

title: Identification and validation of a machine learning model of complete response to radiation in rectal cancer reveals immune infiltrate and TGFβ as key predictors.
rationale_c1: SCORT/Aristotle-linked biopsy cohorts total N=249 plus GSE87211; trial/referral mix.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment transcriptome ML for pCR after neoadjuvant RT+fluoropyrimidine appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR labels and independent validation set (n=107) performance reported.
rationale_c4: Multivariable analysis retains immune/TGFβ features with stated covariates.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant RT 45 Gy/25 + fluoropyrimidine per trial protocols.
probast_rationale: Immune/TGFβ ML signature with independent validation; residual ROB from gene-selection discovery pipeline.
appraisal_note: Code on GitHub SCORT-ML-Pipeline; axis other kept (radiation-response biology focus).
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelo de 33 genes derivado de microarray transcriptómico (Almac Xcel, ComBat) en biopsias; requiere 'a certified test' aún inexistente; no obtenible en rutina.

title: Deep learning model based on endoscopic images predicting treatment response in locally advanced rectal cancer undergo neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: a multicenter study.
rationale_c1: Two Chinese centers endoscopic DL for nCRT response; tertiary convenience.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment endoscopy CNN with good-response/TRG endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Labels for train/internal/external splits among 296 patients (3485 images).
rationale_c4: Deep learning on modest patient n with multicenter but limited confounder adjustment.
rationale_c5: nCRT administered per centers' standards as described.
probast_rationale: External test AUC 0.758 helpful; DL overfitting and retrospective selection keep analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Endoscopy-only DSS for nCRT response selection.
applicability_v2_rationale: Aprendizaje profundo sobre endoscopia pretratamiento para respuesta a nCRT, decision explicita (seleccion de candidatos a neoadyuvancia o cirugia directa). Cohorte homogenea y validacion externa.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging-based radiomics analysis for prediction of treatment response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy and clinical outcome in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer: A large multicentric and validated study.
rationale_c1: Large multicenter LARC nCRT with two external cohorts plus prospective validation.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI radiomics/clinical models with pathologic good response fit aims.
rationale_c3: Outcomes reported for TD n=508, EVD1/2, and prospective PVD n=149.
rationale_c4: Clinical+radiomics models with multi-algorithm comparison held on external/prospective sets.
rationale_c5: nCRT and MRI/path protocols applied across centers as described.
probast_rationale: Multicenter+prospective LARC; pretreatment MRI; pathology GR/pCR pathway; performance held externally/PVD.
appraisal_note: Standout design: EVD1/EVD2 plus NCT03415763 prospective validation; data on reasonable request.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI basal pre-nCRT en cohorte multicéntrica no metastásica para predecir buena respuesta; decisión neoadyuvante coherente. Excluir cCR en watch-and-wait es limitación declarada, no H1-H7.

title: Evaluation of Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy Response in Rectal Cancer Using MR Images and Deep Learning Neural Networks.
rationale_c1: Single-center/regional Turkish series n=59 stage II–III rectal cancer; small convenience sample.
rationale_c2: T2 MRI intensity histograms with Dworak TRG labels fit response-evaluation aim.
rationale_c3: Pathology Dw-TRG available for all 59 tumors; metrics vs MR-TRG reported.
rationale_c4: LSTM DNN with repeated stratified splits on n=59; high overfitting and no external lock.
rationale_c5: nCRT delivered and surgery/pathology obtained as intended for included cases.
probast_rationale: Small single-center; MRI signatures pretreatment/post; Dw-TRG clear; internal resampling only.
appraisal_note: DNN-TRG vs MERCURY MR-TRG comparison; very small n limits deployability.
applicability_v2_rationale: T2 pre y postnCRT en estadio 2-3 para predecir TRG de Dworak; decisión explícita (W&W vs cirugía de menor morbilidad). Predictores disponibles al decidir.

title: Machine learning-based response assessment in patients with rectal cancer after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: radiomics analysis for assessing tumor regression grade using T2-weighted magnetic resonance images.
rationale_c1: Single-institution LARC MRI series 2010–2021; referral population unclear.
rationale_c2: Baseline T2 radiomics targeting mrTRG/pTRG after NCRT appropriate.
rationale_c3: mrTRG available n=148; pTRG subset n=104 with AUCs reported.
rationale_c4: 116 radiomics features with PCA and eight learners; incomplete surgical pTRG.
rationale_c5: NCRT delivered as described; not all patients underwent resection.
probast_rationale: Internal CV; primary endpoint mrTRG (imaging) with incomplete pathology gold standard.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept per input; content is post-NCRT response/TRG prediction.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC T2-4/N+ sin metástasis, MRI T2 basal para predecir TRG tras NCRT (candidatos a W&W). Contexto y momento adecuados; sin H ni U.

title: Preoperative MRI radiomic analysis for predicting local tumor progression in colorectal liver metastases before microwave ablation.
rationale_c1: Single-institution CLM MWA series (43 patients/76 lesions); generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: Pre-MWA gadoxetic MRI radiomics plus clinical factors for LTPFS are measurable endpoints.
rationale_c3: LTP events (19/76) and model AUCs reported with dual-observer ICC filtering.
rationale_c4: Combined models include post-ablation margins; small events and RF/Cox mining risk confounding.
rationale_c5: MWA and follow-up imaging pathway applied per institutional protocol.
probast_rationale: Small single-center LTP radiomics; best models mix pretreatment RFs with post-ablation MAMs, blurring prediction-time predictors.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg; informs ablation risk rather than systemic therapy selection.
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelos combinados incluyen márgenes de ablación mínimos, TRG histológico y progresión intrasegmento ("observed during follow-up"), posteriores a la decisión de ablar; desenlace LTPFS pronóstico sin nexo terapéutico analizado.

title: Assessing Endoscopic Response in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Treated with Total Neoadjuvant Therapy: Development and Validation of a Highly Accurate Convolutional Neural Network.
rationale_c1: Single-institution TNT endoscopy image bank (288 patients); not population-representative.
rationale_c2: ResNet-50 CNN on endoscopic images vs surgeon survey for residual tumor/regrowth matches WW assessment question.
rationale_c3: Image-level tumor labels and surgeon comparison fully reported for main and regrowth test sets.
rationale_c4: Deep CNN on single-center images without clinical confounder framework; possible image leakage across timepoints.
rationale_c5: TNT and endoscopic assessment pathway as institutional protocol.
probast_rationale: Image-level CNN (AUC 0.98 main test) informs endoscopic WW assessment; outcome is tumor-present labels rather than locked pathologic pCR; single-center DL ROB high.
appraisal_note: Surgeon-matched performance on main test; weaker on local-regrowth detection as authors note.
applicability_v2_rationale: CNN sobre endoscopia de reestadificación tras TNT para detectar tumor residual y seleccionar watch-and-wait vs TME; imagen disponible en el momento de decisión; LARC estadio II/III.

title: Evaluating complete response prediction rates in locally advanced rectal cancer with different radiomics segmentation approaches.
rationale_c1: Single Turkish institution n=93 LARC 2012–2019; not population-sampled.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI radiomics under alternate segmentations predicting CR appropriate.
rationale_c3: CR (pathologic/clinical) in 25/93 with train/test metrics reported.
rationale_c4: 15 ML models on radiomics without external validation or confounder adjustment.
rationale_c5: CRT then surgery pathway applied as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Segmentation-comparison study; authors explicitly deprioritized external validation; mixed CR definition.
appraisal_note: Primary contribution is ROI-method comparison rather than a locked clinical DSS.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica pretratamiento para predecir respuesta completa; el propósito es comparar segmentaciones, pero la autodeclaración está en Discusión y no cumple H4. Duda: decisión solo genérica (W&W/régimen), sin H1-H7 ni U claro.

title: Unraveling variations and enhancing prediction of successful sphincter-preserving resection for low rectal cancer: a post hoc analysis of the multicentre LASRE randomized clinical trial.
rationale_c1: Post-hoc of 22-hospital LASRE RCT (NCT01899547); strong multicenter low-rectal cohort.
rationale_c2: Clinical/MRI features with successful sphincter-preserving resection endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: SSPR outcome available for trial analytic cohort after stated exclusions.
rationale_c4: Multiple ML classifiers with CV; residual confounding of surgical decision factors possible.
rationale_c5: Trial surgical/oncologic protocols followed for included LASRE patients.
criteria_note: MMAT non-randomized (Hong 2018); post-hoc RCT prediction models.
probast_rationale: Strong trial source for SSPR prediction; analysis residual uncertainty from multi-algorithm mining without fully independent external trial.
appraisal_note: Axis other kept; SSPR prediction is surgical decision support adjacent to organ preservation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Cohorte de ensayo LASRE (CRT neoadyuvante + cirugia de recto bajo); predictores (distancia al margen anal pre/post-CRT, downstaging cT, peso, cN) disponibles antes de operar; informa eleccion preservacion de esfinter vs APR y consejeria. GAP: el desenlace SSPR es compuesto y parte depende de la decision del cirujano y de patologia; las reglas no cubren decisiones quirurgicas tecnicas. BORDERLINE.

title: Image-based consensus molecular subtyping in rectal cancer biopsies and response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Multi-cohort RC biopsy CMS with ARISTOTLE and SALZBURG outcome sets.
rationale_c2: DL imCMS on biopsy WSIs with nCRT pathologic response is appropriate.
rationale_c3: CMS classification and pCR/regression outcomes reported in stated test cohorts.
rationale_c4: Deep ensembles on WSIs; residual confounding and optimism vs transcriptomic CMS.
rationale_c5: Trial/real-world nCRT regimens applied as cohort protocols describe.
probast_rationale: Multi-cohort biopsies; pretreatment histology predictors; pathology response linked; DL analysis ROB remains high.
appraisal_note: Image-based CMS associates with nCRT response; not a classical locked clinical nomogram.
applicability_v2_rationale: imCMS desde H&E de biopsias pretratamiento asociado a pCR tras quimiorradioterapia larga en cáncer rectal; decisión (quién se beneficia de LCRT) explícita y predictor disponible basal.

title: Development and validation of a multi-modal ultrasomics model to predict response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-hospital LARC ultrasomics n=106; external transportability unknown.
rationale_c2: BUS/CEUS PyRadiomics with good vs poor nCRT response labels appropriate.
rationale_c3: Train/validation 74/32 with response labels complete for included patients.
rationale_c4: LASSO feature reduction then MLP on modest validation n; clinical confounders limited.
rationale_c5: nCRT then TME pathway followed for included cohort.
probast_rationale: Single-center; pretreatment ultrasound predictors; pathology response; internal 7:3 only (Combined_2 AUC 0.893).
appraisal_note: Ultrasound modality may limit comparison to MRI-dominant literature; data said included in article/supplement.

title: Artificial intelligence measured 3D body composition to predict pathological response in rectal cancer patients.
rationale_c1: Australian ACCORD registry LARC NAT cohort; registry coverage not fully characterized.
rationale_c2: AI L3 body-composition volumes with histologic pCR after NAT fit aims.
rationale_c3: pCR in 22.4% of 214; multivariate associations reported.
rationale_c4: Multivariable models adjust age/sex/BC components for pCR.
rationale_c5: NAT then surgery pathways as captured in ACCORD registry.
probast_rationale: Association/multivariable rather than locked discrimination/calibration model; no external validation.
appraisal_note: AI used for BC measurement; prognostic association of SM volume with pCR.
applicability_v2_rationale: El objetivo declarado es determinar si variables de composicion corporal (CT) se asocian a pCR; la conclusion lista predictores (masa muscular, edad) y el modelo final tiene AUC 0.60 en validacion; nucleo asociativo/exploratorio, no herramienta aplicable. BORDERLINE: se menciona seleccion para preservacion de organo.

title: A deep neural network predictor to predict the sensitivity of neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: In-house LARC transcriptome plus public GEO validations; sampling frame beyond specialty centers unclear.
rationale_c2: 18-gene DNN predictor of NCRT sensitivity/pCR with pathway and immune context.
rationale_c3: AUC 0.706 and 0.897 in two independent validation cohorts reported.
rationale_c4: Multi-algorithm gene screen into DNN; residual optimism despite external GEO tests.
rationale_c5: Long-course NCRT exposure in development cohorts as described.
probast_rationale: Transcriptomic DNN with two GEO validations; high-dim feature discovery keeps analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Web-based program developed; Wnt/β-catenin and linoleic acid pathways highlighted.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predictor DNN de 18 genes sobre RNA-seq; limitación: 'high cost for RNA sequencing... necessary to develop faster and more cost-effective detection assays'; no rutinario.
