title: Digitally assessed lymphocyte infiltration in rectal cancer biopsies is associated with pathological response to neoadjuvant therapy.
rationale_c1: Two Danish hospitals; final analytic n=50 biopsies after exclusions—representativeness limited.
rationale_c2: Digitally quantified CD3/CD8 infiltration on pretreatment biopsies with Mandard TRG response is appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG and lymphocyte metrics reported for included patients.
rationale_c4: Small sample logistic models; limited multivariable clinical adjustment.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy and surgery delivered per institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Association/biomarker study with DL cell counters rather than locked TRIPOD development; n=50 and no external predictive validation drive high analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Prediction appraisal applied to digitally assessed lymphocyte infiltration→neoadjuvant TRG; detector trained on separate WSIs.
applicability_v2_rationale: Cohorte mezcla cM1 (16/50) y regímenes distintos (quimio sola, RT sola, curso corto); "metastatic/advanced disease" justifica regímenes modificados. Sin resultados separados por contexto de enfermedad; subanálisis solo por CRT.

title: Feasibility of delta radiomics-based pCR prediction for rectal cancer patients treated with magnetic resonance-guided adaptive radiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Single-center MRgART feasibility cohort n=28 only.
rationale_c2: Delta radiomics on serial MRI during adaptive RT for pCR/cCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR/cCR outcomes stated for the small series with LOOCV metrics.
rationale_c4: LASSO over 581 features with LOOCV on n=28 risks severe overfitting.
rationale_c5: MR-guided adaptive CRT then TME delivered per protocol.
probast_rationale: Feasibility delta-radiomics; tiny n and LOOCV preclude low analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Raw data statement present; no usable external validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Estudio de factibilidad con 28 pacientes (5 pCR) en MR-Linac, autodeclarado como feasibility en titulo, objetivo y conclusion: prueba de concepto. Duda: 'feasibility' no es literal de H4.

title: Radiomics of skeletal muscle helps to predict gastrointestinal toxicity in locally advanced rectal cancer patients receiving neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Single-institution LARC series; temporal holdout not population sampling.
rationale_c2: Baseline L3 CT radiomics/SMI and CTCAE grade 3–4 GI toxicity fit aims.
rationale_c3: Toxicity during CRT summarized for train/internal/external sets.
rationale_c4: LASSO over 253 features without key molecular confounders (e.g., UGT1A1).
rationale_c5: Uniform capecitabine/irinotecan CRT delivered per protocol as stated.
probast_rationale: Same-center temporal external n=50; high-dim LASSO and unclear toxicity blinding drive high ROB.
appraisal_note: External validation is temporal single-center; no data/code availability statement found.

title: Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy Response in Rectal Cancer Patients Using Harmonized Radiomics of Multcenter <sup>18</sup>F-FDG-PET Image.
rationale_c1: Korean PET radiomics train n=116 plus external n=40; referral oncology centers.
rationale_c2: Harmonized 18F-FDG PET radiomics with pCR after nCRT appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR rates reported in internal and external datasets.
rationale_c4: Radiomics ML with harmonization; still high-dim and small external events (6 pCR).
rationale_c5: nCRT for tumors >2 cm delivered as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: External institution test present but small; analysis ROB from radiomics selection and few events.
appraisal_note: ComBat-style harmonization improves first-order model external AUC to 0.771.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice 'chemoradiotherapy response' con PET sin decir qué decisión informa ('responses in cancer treatment'); texto confuso (menciona páncreas e infertilidad). Uso terapéutico solo implícito.

title: Lipid metabolism-associated genes serve as potential predictive biomarkers in neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy combined with immunotherapy in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: GEO rectal nCRT/immuno transcriptomic cohorts; clinical representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: LMAG selection with response and OS endpoints matches biomarker aims.
rationale_c3: Differential response labels and survival metrics reported for analyzed GEO sets.
rationale_c4: SVM-RFE/RF/LASSO intersection mining without independent clinical lock.
rationale_c5: Treatment exposure in public cohorts incompletely characterized for adherence.
probast_rationale: GEO convenience; expression predictors; response labeling heterogeneous; high-dim bioinformatics ROB.
appraisal_note: Lipid-metabolism genes proposed for nCRT±immunotherapy stratification; mostly in silico.
applicability_v2_rationale: Núcleo bioinformático de descubrimiento de genes lipídicos (SREBF2) en GEO/TCGA; respuesta a inmunoterapia solo inferida in silico (TIDE). H4(b) y (c).

title: Prediction of Pathologic Complete Response for Rectal Cancer Based on Pretreatment Factors Using Machine Learning.
rationale_c1: NCDB 2010–2019 national multi-institution LARC n=53684 addresses pretreatment pCR prediction population.
rationale_c2: Registry pretreatment factors with ypT0/x N0/x pCR definition are measurable and relevant.
rationale_c3: Train/validation/temporal test splits with complete pCR labels for included cases.
rationale_c4: LVI/PNI source ambiguity and registry missingness; ML vs LR comparison without non-NCDB external.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy then proctectomy as captured in NCDB for included patients.
probast_rationale: National CoC coverage; some predictors may be post-biopsy ambiguous; pathology pCR; temporal NCDB test but authors note no true external dataset.
appraisal_note: XGB AUROC 0.777; code at github.com/gomezlab/colorectal_predictors; no imaging features.
applicability_v2_rationale: Lectura low: el modelo usa variables 'potencialmente disponibles en la toma de decision pretratamiento' en NCDB para seleccionar candidatos a watch-and-wait. Lectura high (H3): los autores admiten que LVI/PNI pueden provenir de la patologia quirurgica final, son los predictores mas fuertes, y sin ellos el AUC cae a 0.66. BORDERLINE.

title: Radiomics Signature Based on Support Vector Machines for the Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single Zhejiang University hospital consecutive LARC; not population-based.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment planning CT radiomics with pathology pCR after CRT fit aims.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes in train 148 / val 63 random split reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO/RF/SVM feature mining without geographic external lock.
rationale_c5: Long-course CRT then TME administered per inclusion criteria.
probast_rationale: 7:3 internal split; SVM Radscore AUCs ~0.83–0.88 with high-dim CT radiomics.
appraisal_note: MDPI supplement available; no public patient-level data/code stated.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC de planificación pretratamiento y clínicos para predecir pCR tras nCRT en LARC; uso para decisión clínica personalizada/watch-and-wait declarado.

title: Multiphase and multiparameter MRI-based radiomics for prediction of tumor response to neoadjuvant therapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Two-center LARC series (n=563) with independent external center (n=110) for NAT response.
rationale_c2: Pre-NAT and pre+post-NAT mpMRI radiomics for non-response and pCR are fit-for-purpose.
rationale_c3: AUCs ~0.79–0.87 reported in train/test/external cohorts.
rationale_c4: Multiphase high-dim radiomics ML; residual confounding despite external hold.
rationale_c5: NAT and mpMRI timing protocols applied across centers as described.
probast_rationale: External validation strong; post-NAT features for pCR are restaging predictors (not pretreatment-only); radiomics mining drives analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Separate pre-NAT non-response and multiphase pCR models; both externally validated.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM pre-NAT para predecir no respuesta y RM pre+post-NAT antes de la cirugía para identificar pCR (watch-and-wait); ambas disponibles al decidir. Cohorte LARC con NAT; estadio IV minoritario (8,6 %/1,8 %).

title: Attention mechanism based multi-sequence MRI fusion improves prediction of response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Two-hospital consecutive LARC nCRT series (n=422) with dedicated external hospital cohort.
rationale_c2: Multiparametric MRI attention-fusion DL/radiomics with TRG good vs poor response appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG-based response complete for included patients across train/internal/external.
rationale_c4: High-dim DL and radiomics channel-fusion without comprehensive clinical confounder control.
rationale_c5: Standard nCRT before surgery applied as eligibility required.
probast_rationale: External AUC 0.873 for attention DL is strong, but high-dim multiparametric mining without locked low-dim analysis keeps analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Developed at one hospital and validated at the other; supplementary material available.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI multiparamétrica pre-nCRT en LARC predice mala respuesta (TRG 2-3) para "devising appropriate personalized treatment plans"; momento y contexto coherentes.

title: Treatment response prediction of neoadjuvant chemotherapy for rectal cancer by deep learning of colonoscopy images.
rationale_c1: Single Japanese center colonoscopy DL; 53 patients / image-level splits.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment colonoscopy images predicting NAC pathologic response appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response labels and independent image validation (84 images/10 pts) reported.
rationale_c4: DL on small patient N with image-level holdout; clinical confounders not modeled.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy regimens administered as stated.
probast_rationale: Colonoscopy CNN AUC 0.71; patient-level independence of validation set unclear.
appraisal_note: NAC (not CRT) response; still therapeutic decision-relevant for rectal cancer.
applicability_v2_rationale: Imagenes de colonoscopia pre-NAC para predecir respuesta RECIST (por RM) a quimioterapia neoadyuvante; el paper dice que hay que predecir 'antes de administrar el tratamiento' pero no indica que decision informa. No se cumple ninguna H con claridad (n=53, validacion 10 pacientes va a RoB/analisis).

title: A multiple-time-scale comparative study for the added value of magnetic resonance imaging-based radiomics in predicting pathological complete response after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single Chinese cancer-hospital consecutive LARC MRI series.
rationale_c2: Multi-time-scale MRI radiomics (pre/post/delta) for pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes for train/test splits after exclusions.
rationale_c4: 1409 features with 10-fold CV then internal test; high overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: nCRT and surgery completed as required for inclusion.
probast_rationale: Single-center; post-nCRT features limit pure pretreatment selection; no external validation.
appraisal_note: Comparative time-scale study; combined signatures AUC ~0.73–0.82 on internal test.

title: Predictors of Clostridium difficile infection after stoma reversal following TaTME surgery.
rationale_c1: Single high-volume TaTME stoma-reversal series; CDI incidence cohort limited.
rationale_c2: Clinical predictors with in-hospital CDI after reversal are measurable endpoints.
rationale_c3: CDI toxin testing and diarrhea outcomes reported for included patients.
rationale_c4: RF on small sample 80/20 split; limited multivariable confounder control.
rationale_c5: TaTME and stoma reversal pathway applied as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Single-center; perioperative predictors OK; CDI definition clear; no external validation.
appraisal_note: Classical clinical RF for post-reversal CDI; ML detail thinner than radiomics papers.
applicability_v2_rationale: Factores de riesgo de ICD tras cierre de estoma post-TaTME; el paper no dice qué decisión terapéutica informa (solo asocia retraso del cierre). No cumple H6 con claridad: la complicación no es resultado oncológico.

title: Predicting Rectal Cancer Response to Total Neoadjuvant Treatment Using an Artificial Intelligence Model Based on Magnetic Resonance Imaging and Clinical Data.
rationale_c1: Single-center West China LARC TNT n=118; representativeness beyond tertiary center unclear.
rationale_c2: Baseline T2 radiomics/clinical features with pCR and TRG-based sensitivity groups appropriate.
rationale_c3: Train/test 89/29 with pathology response labels reported.
rationale_c4: Radiomics plus DL on small test set; limited confounder control and likely optimism.
rationale_c5: TNT regimens delivered as recorded; mixed chemo/CRT components noted by authors.
probast_rationale: Single-center TNT; baseline MRI available pretreatment; pCR/TRG defined; internal test only.
appraisal_note: LR ≈ DL AUCs ~0.83–0.87; mixed TNT components may blur regimen-specific applicability but kept low concern.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI basal T2WI y clínica en LARC predicen respuesta a TNT; informa terapia adaptativa. Sin regla H.

title: A Comprehensive Prediction Model Based on MRI Radiomics and Clinical Factors to Predict Tumor Response After Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: LARC train n=100 / val n=27; sampling limited and likely single-center.
rationale_c2: Multisequence MRI radiomics plus clinical factors predicting Mandard TRG.
rationale_c3: Good vs poor TRG groups and AUCs reported for train/test.
rationale_c4: Train AUC 0.99 suggests severe overfitting; small validation n=27.
rationale_c5: nCRT delivered before assessment as required for TRG labeling.
probast_rationale: Near-perfect training AUC with tiny holdout—classic analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Input marks multicenter axis metadata absent in methods excerpt; treat as small split study.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM pretratamiento más clínica para predecir TRG tras nCRT, estadio II/III, "preliminary prediction of therapeutic effect before nCRT". Sin H1-H7; EPV y falta de validación externa son H5.

title: Radiomics from Mesorectal Blood Vessels and Lymph Nodes: A Novel Prognostic Predictor for Rectal Cancer with Neoadjuvant Therapy.
rationale_c1: Single-center PKU Third Hospital LARC 2013–2021 (n=209); representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Intratumoral plus mesorectal vessel/LN radiomics for pathologic good response after nCRT.
rationale_c3: pGR labels and train/validation AUCs (0.94/0.86) for best ROI combination reported.
rationale_c4: Twelve logistic models over many ROI combinations with internal 4:1 split only.
rationale_c5: Uniform nCRT and pretreatment MRI protocol as described.
probast_rationale: Novel mesorectal BVLN radiomics; internal validation only with extensive ROI model shopping.
appraisal_note: Best model integrates tumor + mesorectal blood vessels/lymph nodes ROIs.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiomica pre-nCRT (intra y peritumoral) para buena respuesta patologica, con uso terapeutico declarado (cirugia oportuna en malos respondedores). DFS es secundario. Sin autodeclaracion piloto.

title: Delta Radiomic Analysis of Mesorectum to Predict Treatment Response and Prognosis in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-institution consecutive LARC 2008–2016; generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-nCRT MRI delta radiomics with pCR and 2yDFS are appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR and long-term DFS (median FU 95 mo) reported for 203 patients.
rationale_c4: 565 variables with univariate filter then logistic; high overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: nCRT and MRI/ROI protocols described and applied as intended.
probast_rationale: Internal 66/33 split only; authors note no external validation; massive feature screen.
appraisal_note: Axis adjuvant_risk kept per pilot; models target post-nCRT pCR and 2yDFS.

title: Radiomics for the Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiation in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Prospective Observational Trial.
rationale_c1: Retrospective development n=147 plus prospective two-institution test n=77 addresses generalizability.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment multiparametric MRI radiomics with pathology pCR and physician-aid evaluation fit WW selection.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes and prospective test performance (AUC 0.84) fully reported.
rationale_c4: Radiomics feature selection with Youden cutpoint on training may leave residual optimism despite prospective lock.
rationale_c5: nCRT+TME pathway and MRI protocols applied as stated.
probast_rationale: Prospective multicenter testing strengthens validation; residual ROB from retrospective development and train Youden threshold.
appraisal_note: Among stronger neoadj designs in batch-02 (prospective test AUC 0.84; radiomics aided junior readers).
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pretratamiento en LARC sin metástasis a distancia para predecir pCR; menciona 'wait-and-watch' como alternativa; validación prospectiva. Nexo terapéutico explícito.

title: A multi-class classification algorithm based on hematoxylin-eosin staining for neoadjuvant therapy in rectal cancer: a retrospective study.
rationale_c1: Single-center CUCH H&E WSI series; multi-center validation absent.
rationale_c2: ResNet multi-class TRG0–3 on post-NAT resection slides matches stated aim.
rationale_c3: TRG labels by dual pathologists; train/test WSI split (113/20) metrics reported.
rationale_c4: Deep classifier without clinical confounders; slide-level leakage risk unclear.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy then surgery pathway as institutional standard.
probast_rationale: Post-resection H&E TRG classifier (AUC 0.89–0.97); limited pretreatment decision applicability.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept; content is post-NAT TRG multi-class pathology AI, not toxicity.

title: Development and Validation of a Radiomics Model Based on Lymph-Node Regression Grading After Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
rationale_c1: Single-center Sichuan LARC LN-level radiomics; institutional series.
rationale_c2: Pre-nCRT MRI LN radiomics for pathology LN regression/pCR relevant to WW.
rationale_c3: LN-level pCR labels in train and validation cohorts reported.
rationale_c4: 3641 features/LN with LASSO nomogram; node-level clustering and optimism risks.
rationale_c5: nCRT and surgery per institutional protocols.
probast_rationale: Internal validation AUC ~0.86–0.92; high-dim LN radiomics without multi-center external lock.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept per batch; content is LN regression for WW after nCRT.
applicability_v2_rationale: T3-4 N1-2 M0 con MRI pre-nCRT de ganglios, desenlace LRG para guiar watch-and-wait; momento y contexto adecuados. Sin H ni U.

title: Develop and validate a radiomics space-time model to predict the pathological complete response in patients undergoing neoadjuvant treatment of rectal cancer: an artificial intelligence model study based on machine learning.
rationale_c1: Single-center rectal NAT series final n=83 after large exclusions from 2332.
rationale_c2: Multi-timepoint MRI radiomics space-time model with pathology pCR fit aims.
rationale_c3: pCR vs non-pCR labels reported for the analyzed 83-patient set.
rationale_c4: 930 features with RF/SVM/KNN; no external validation; RSTM AUC 0.94 optimistic.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy and MRI acquisition applied as described.
probast_rationale: Heavy exclusion from 2332→83; multi-timepoint predictors may need on-treatment MRI; pathology pCR clear; analysis high ROB.
appraisal_note: Space-time/delta features span NAT course; authors request larger external cohorts.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM antes y después de neoadyuvancia (previa a cirugía) para predecir pCR; motivación explícita de estrategia wait-and-see. Muestra pequeña y sin validación externa van a análisis.

title: Deep learning of endoscopic features for the assessment of neoadjuvant therapy response in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Two Chinese centers (Changzheng train n=160; Zhejiang external n=54) address endoscopic NAT-response assessment.
rationale_c2: Post-NAT white-light endoscopy DL vs manual with pathology pCR endpoint appropriate for WW triage.
rationale_c3: pCR labels complete; external hospital validation metrics reported.
rationale_c4: ResNet/DenseNet on small image sets without clinical confounder adjustment; modest AUC ~0.72.
rationale_c5: NAT then TME applied as intended for included patients.
probast_rationale: Dual-center endoscopy; post-NAT images available at response assessment; pathology pCR; small external n and DL optimism.
appraisal_note: Pilot-scale endoscopy DL; comparable/slightly better than manual for pCR screening.
applicability_v2_rationale: Aprendizaje profundo sobre endoscopia post-NAT para identificar respuesta completa y orientar watch-and-wait; imagen disponible en el momento de decisión; recto primario con NAT. Rendimiento modesto no es aplicabilidad. | NOTA: H4 por autodeclaración (criterio único)

title: MRI-based radiomic score increased mrTRG accuracy in predicting rectal cancer response to neoadjuvant therapy.
rationale_c1: MSKCC consecutive LARC 2011–2015; specialty-center case-mix.
rationale_c2: Restaging T2 radiomics rad-score and ymrTRG predicting pathology pCR.
rationale_c3: pCR in 33/180 with AUCs for rad-score and combined score.
rationale_c4: LASSO radiomics with Youden cutoffs; no external geographic validation.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant CRT then surgery standardized in institutional pathway.
probast_rationale: Restaging (post-CRT) features for pCR—available for WW decision but not pretreatment triage.
appraisal_note: Combined high rad-score + ymrTRG 1–2 improved AUC vs either alone.
applicability_v2_rationale: Rad-score de MRI de reestadificación más mrTRG para pCR en LARC, para seleccionar manejo no operatorio; MRI disponible antes de cirugía.

title: MRI-based pre-Radiomics and delta-Radiomics models accurately predict the post-treatment response of rectal adenocarcinoma to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Small multi-site Chinese LARC series (n=84 after exclusions); generalizability unclear.
rationale_c2: Pre- and delta-MRI radiomics for NCRT response classification are appropriate endpoints.
rationale_c3: Response labels and CV/validation AUCs reported for T1/T2 models.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics on small n with internal splits; high overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: Long-course NCRT delivered per protocol for included patients.
probast_rationale: Delta models need post-NCRT MRI; small n and internal-only validation drive high ROB; applicability mixed pretreatment vs restaging.
appraisal_note: Pre-radiomics and delta-radiomics both reported; external multicenter data still needed.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica MRI pre y delta en LARC para predecir respuesta patológica (TRG) a NCRT; predictores basales o previos a TME, disponibles antes de la cirugía; cohorte homogénea.

title: Automatic treatment outcome prediction with DeepInteg based on multimodal radiological images in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: FOWARC RCT-derived LARC cohort (n=99) with clear trial eligibility.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT+MRI DeepInteg segmentation/classification for pCR is appropriate.
rationale_c3: Pathology pCR after surgery available for included trial patients.
rationale_c4: Small DL sample with class imbalance; internal random train/validation only.
rationale_c5: Trial neoadjuvant regimens and surgery administered per FOWARC protocol.
probast_rationale: RCT-sourced imaging helps participants; small n and internal-only DL fusion (best AUC 0.833) drive high analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Code and trained DeepInteg available on request; authors note small sample and imbalance.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI y TC pretratamiento (<1 semana) del ensayo FOWARC predicen pCR para evitar tratamiento inapropiado/preservación de órgano. Sin regla H.

title: MRI-Based Radiomic Models Outperform Radiologists in Predicting Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center LARC n=126 random 84/42 split; not population-framed.
rationale_c2: Pre/post/delta T2 radiomics vs radiologists for pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes and DeLong-compared AUCs reported for train/validation.
rationale_c4: 250-feature radiomics selection without external lock; confounding residual.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery applied as described.
probast_rationale: Internal-only radiomics outperforming readers; no true external validation.
appraisal_note: Delta and post-nCRT models use on-treatment imaging; pretreatment model also reported.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica T2 pre/post-nCRT para pCR en LARC cT3-4M0; objetivo: seleccionar candidatos a preservación de órgano. Post-nCRT RM disponible antes de cirugía; sin H1-H7.

title: Interpretable machine learning for predicting pathologic complete response in patients treated with chemoradiation therapy for rectal adenocarcinoma.
rationale_c1: Penn train n=180 plus RTOG 0822 external n=37; still selected trial/academic mix.
rationale_c2: GTV radiomics/dosiomics with pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR labels complete for institutional and RTOG testing sets.
rationale_c4: Boruta+multi-ML on high-dim R/D features; small external events limit stability.
rationale_c5: Chemoradiation per institutional/RTOG protocols as described.
probast_rationale: Independent RTOG 0822 test is a plus; analysis ROB from high-dim selection and small external n.
appraisal_note: Interpretable EBM competitive with XGB/RF (AUC ~0.82) on external set.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice pCR con clínicos, DVH y radiómica de TC pre-tratamiento para selección de watchful waiting; validación independiente de ensayo RTOG. Pocos M1 en entrenamiento no alcanzan H1; sin H4.

title: MRI-based radiomics to predict neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy outcomes in locally advanced rectal cancer: A multicenter study.
rationale_c1: Multicenter cT3-4 LARC n=634 with prospective n=34 cohort.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI radiomics with ypT0-2 downstaging endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: ypT outcomes reported for train 426, test 174, and prospective 34.
rationale_c4: Eight filter-classifier combinations; residual optimism despite held test/prospective AUC.
rationale_c5: nCRT±consolidation chemo pathways applied per centers' protocols.
probast_rationale: Multicenter+small prospective; pretreatment MRI; ypT0-2 clear; multi-pipeline mining leaves analysis unclear.
appraisal_note: Nomogram AUC 0.809 test / 0.727 prospective; intended to guide consolidation chemo.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica pretratamiento en cT3-4 LARC para predecir ypT0-2: 'facilitate individualised treatment decision-making for organ-preservation strategies and consolidation chemotherapy'; interacción con quimioterapia analizada.

title: Performance of Machine Learning and Texture Analysis for Predicting Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer with 3T MRI.
rationale_c1: Prospective single-center Sapienza LARC n=40; too small for population inference.
rationale_c2: Pre/post 3T T2 texture parameters with pathology response after TME are appropriate.
rationale_c3: Complete surgical pathology reference for all included; ROC/ML tree metrics reported.
rationale_c4: Few texture features plus decision tree on n=40; no independent external cohort.
rationale_c5: Prospective nChRT and resection administered as protocolized.
probast_rationale: Tiny prospective single-center; MRI TA predictors; pathology pCR; internal ROC/tree only.
appraisal_note: Prospective design strength offset by n=40; data archived locally only.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC M0 prospectivo, textura T2 pre-nChRT para predecir pCR antes del tratamiento. Muestra pequeña (40) es asunto de análisis (H5), no de aplicabilidad.

title: CT radiomics identifying non-responders to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy among patients with locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Xiangya Hospital LARC 2009–2019; single tertiary center.
rationale_c2: Planning CT radiomics identifying nCRT non-responders vs responders.
rationale_c3: Train 151 / val 64 with non-response labels and model metrics.
rationale_c4: LASSO ensemble over high-dim CT features without external center.
rationale_c5: nCRT with concurrent 5-FU-based CRT as protocol described.
probast_rationale: Internal validation; non-response definition blends response/downstaging constructs.
appraisal_note: Data available on request; modest sample noted by authors.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC de planificación pretratamiento para identificar no respondedores a nCRT en LARC; implica estrategias personalizadas de tratamiento. Sin regla H ni U.

title: Are We There Yet? The Value of Deep Learning in a Multicenter Setting for Response Prediction of Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Multicenter LARC nCRT+TME cohorts with pathologic TRG address DL pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Pre/post T2w±DWI/ADC and Dworak TRG with Siamese multitask U-Net are fit-for-purpose.
rationale_c3: Small n (~83 train; 46 external); marked train–test differences in staging, timing, and MRI parameters.
rationale_c4: DL on small samples with imaging heterogeneity and DWI–T2 misalignment; limited confounder control.
rationale_c5: Pathologic TRG after TME available for all included patients.
criteria_note: MMAT v2018 quantitative non-randomized (multicenter DL diagnostic cohort).
probast_rationale: Retrospective trial/routine MRI with small events; DL overfitting and failed external AUC (0.54–0.60); outcome standard pathologic TRG.
appraisal_note: Negative generalizability study of Jin-like Siamese DL; uses pre+post-nCRT MRI so informs restaging/WW after CRT, not pretreatment selection.

title: Deep Learning Model for Predicting the Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy of Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Three-center LARC biopsy DL cohort (n=842) with Yunnan external set addresses pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: H&E biopsy DeepPCR vs pathology pCR after nCRT+TME are appropriate.
rationale_c3: Test and external AUC-ROC ~0.71–0.72 with sensitivity/specificity reported.
rationale_c4: DL on WSIs with modest discrimination; residual confounding vs clinicopathologic factors unclear.
rationale_c5: Standard nCRT then resection across centers as described.
probast_rationale: Genuine external validation but modest AUC (~0.72) and retrospective biopsy DL leave analysis residual uncertainty.
appraisal_note: Pretreatment biopsy-only DeepPCR; Tencent AI Lab collaboration; specificity limited.
applicability_v2_rationale: Aprendizaje profundo en H&E de biopsia pre-nCRT para predecir pCR "to assist clinical treatment decision making before surgery"; biopsia rutinaria, LARC sin metástasis a distancia.

title: Ability of Delta Radiomics to Predict a Complete Pathological Response in Patients with Loco-Regional Rectal Cancer Addressed to Neoadjuvant Chemo-Radiation and Surgery.
rationale_c1: Three-center retrospective LARC delta-texture series with few pCR events per split.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-CRT MRI delta texture (ADC GLCM) with Mandard/TRG pCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR rates reported for training and two validation datasets.
rationale_c4: Univariate/Bonferroni feature screen then logistic cutoffs on small event counts risk overfitting despite multi-center checks.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant CHT-RT and surgery pathways described across centers.
probast_rationale: Delta radiomics requires post-CRT MRI; high reported AUCs (0.87–0.92) on small validation sets with few events inflate analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Authors call for larger prospective external validation; delta timing informs restaging not pretreatment-only selection.
applicability_v2_rationale: El paper se autodeclara estudio piloto en el resumen (H4a); cohortes pequeñas (37/33/30) y un solo parámetro de textura.

title: Analysis of MRI and CT-based radiomics features for personalized treatment in locally advanced rectal cancer and external validation of published radiomics models.
rationale_c1: DKTK-ROG multicentre MRI/CT (train 122 / val 68); still consortium convenience.
rationale_c2: Radiomics for nCRT response and FFDM plus external test of published signatures appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response and FFDM endpoints with AUCs/C-indices reported across institutions.
rationale_c4: Feature-class comparisons with some clinical covariates; residual confounding unclear.
rationale_c5: nCRT pathways within DKTK-ROG delivered as trial/consortium standards.
probast_rationale: Independent validation of published radiomics mostly failed; own signatures modest (FFDM AUC~0.70).
appraisal_note: Axis other: dual aim of signature development and failed external replication of prior models.

title: Combined artificial intelligence and radiologist model for predicting rectal cancer treatment response from magnetic resonance imaging: an external validation study.
rationale_c1: MSK development n=114 and Sao Paulo external n=50 consecutive LARC; tertiary centers.
rationale_c2: Restaging MRI radiomics±radiologist qualitative assessment for pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR reference standard reported for internal and external cohorts.
rationale_c4: RF radiomics with combined reader models; limited clinical confounder modeling.
rationale_c5: nCRT and restaging MRI performed as intended for included patients.
probast_rationale: True geographic external validation; combined radiomics+radiologist improves discrimination; residual analysis uncertainty from texture RF.
appraisal_note: Restaging (post-nCRT) MRI model for pCR—WW decision context.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica de MRI de restadificación más radiólogo para predecir pCR en LARC y elegir 'watchful waiting'; predictores post-tratamiento disponibles en el momento de esa decisión.

title: Predicting pathologic complete response in locally advanced rectal cancer patients after neoadjuvant therapy: a machine learning model using XGBoost.
rationale_c1: Single SYSU LARC NAT series n=962; tertiary referral convenience sample.
rationale_c2: Clinicopathologic/lab features with preoperative pCR prediction fit WW aims.
rationale_c3: pCR labels reported for training and tuning (7:3) sets.
rationale_c4: XGBoost AUROC 0.95 on internal tuning; no independent external cohort.
rationale_c5: NAT and staging workup applied as institutional pathway.
probast_rationale: Single-center; pretreatment clinical predictors; pathology pCR clear; optimistic XGBoost without external lock.
appraisal_note: Large n but single-center clinical XGBoost; SHAP used for interpretability.
applicability_v2_rationale: Variables clínicas, marcadores y MRI de reestadificación predicen pCR para elegir 'watch and wait' vs cirugía; disponibles preoperatoriamente. Sin regla H.

title: MRI-Based Radiomics Features to Predict Treatment Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Single Center, Prospective Study.
rationale_c1: Prospective single-center SYSUCC LARC NAC n=137; not population-sampled.
rationale_c2: Baseline T2 peri-/intratumor radiomics with pathologic good response appropriate.
rationale_c3: Train/validation 91/46 with pathology TRG-based response reported.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics combined models without external site; optimism on validation AUC 0.87.
rationale_c5: NAC then surgery pathway applied as intended for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center NAC (not CRT) cohort; baseline MRI OK for pretreatment selection; pathology response; internal split only.
appraisal_note: Axis neoadj_pcr_ww kept; regimen is NAC rather than CRT—note for synthesis; contributions in supplement.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC T3/4a M0 uniforme (CapeOx neoadyuvante), RM basal T2 con ventana <2 semanas antes del tratamiento; prediccion de buena respuesta (TRG1-2) explicitamente para evitar radioterapia/sobretratamiento. No se cumple ninguna H ni U.

title: Pre-Treatment Computed Tomography Radiomics for Predicting the Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiation in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Retrospective Study.
rationale_c1: Same Chinese tertiary network as related CT radiomics work; convenience cohort.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment contrast CT radiomics plus clinical factors predicting pCR.
rationale_c3: pCR 44/216; train 151 / validation 65 performance reported.
rationale_c4: 340 features LASSO signature plus clinical mining; same-center independent split.
rationale_c5: nCRT then TME as inclusion required.
probast_rationale: Independent validation cohort but not geographic external; high-dim CT radiomics ROB.
appraisal_note: Combined radiomics+clinical (distance, LMR, CEA) preferred over radiomics alone.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC de planificación pretratamiento más clínica predice pCR en LARC; excluye metástasis. Informa respuesta a nCRT/watch and wait; sin H1-H7.

title: Gene-expression profiles of pretreatment biopsies predict complete response of rectal cancer patients to preoperative chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: CAO/ARO/AIO trial biopsies plus independent/public/prospective TransValid cohorts address pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment gene-expression 21-transcript classifier with pathology pCR (FPR=0 constraint) fit WW triage.
rationale_c3: Development n=161 and three independent validations (n=76) fully reported.
rationale_c4: Locked low-FPR classifier held across independent and prospective sets; limited residual confounding.
rationale_c5: Preoperative CRT then TME per trial protocols as intended.
probast_rationale: Strong multi-cohort gene classifier including prospective samples; low sensitivity (~0.31) and modest events leave analysis residual uncertainty.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept; content is pretreatment pCR/WW gene classifier (GSE public components).
applicability_v2_rationale: Clasificador de 21 transcritos en biopsia pretratamiento para pCR y seleccion de W&W, con tres cohortes de validacion. Duda: perfil de expresion en microarray (posible H3), pero el clasificador final es de 21 genes.

title: Endoscopy-Based Deep Convolutional Neural Network Predicts Response to Neoadjuvant Treatment for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Large single-center endoscopy series (1000 LARC); chronological holdout not population sampling.
rationale_c2: Post-NT endoscopic DCNN for TRG0 vs non-TRG0 matches surgery vs WW triage.
rationale_c3: TRG labels and train/validation/independent test metrics fully reported.
rationale_c4: Deep ResNeSt CNN without clinical confounders; single-center independent set only.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant treatment and endoscopy timing per institutional protocol.
probast_rationale: Chronological independent test AUROC 0.77 with high NPV; authors note lack of multi-center external validation.
appraisal_note: Reader study vs endoscopists favors DCNN (AUROC 0.85); post-treatment endoscopy predictor.
applicability_v2_rationale: Imágenes endoscópicas postneoadyuvancia para distinguir TRG0 y 'identifying surgery candidates' frente a W&W; predictor disponible en el momento de decidir.

title: Automated Prediction of the Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Patients Affected by Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center Bologna observational n=39 only.
rationale_c2: Automated MRI segmentation+radiomics predicting TRG response appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG0–1 vs 2–3 labels and AUCs under LOOCV/PCA-LASSO reported.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics on tiny N with LOOCV; clinical confounders not adjusted.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery as institutional standard.
probast_rationale: Automated pipeline AUC up to 0.89 on n=39; analysis ROB dominated by sample size/LOOCV.
appraisal_note: Segmentation code on GitHub img-segm; TRG missing for some patients noted by authors.
applicability_v2_rationale: 43 LARC, MRI T2 de estadificación primaria para predecir respuesta (TRG) a nCRT; predictores disponibles antes del tratamiento. Sin H ni U.

title: MRI-based radiomics to predict response in locally advanced rectal cancer: comparison of manual and automatic segmentation on external validation in a multicentre study.
rationale_c1: Italian two-center LARC n=95; construction vs external split by center.
rationale_c2: Baseline MRI radiomics for response with manual vs automatic segmentation comparison appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response/TRG labels for construction and external sets after exclusions.
rationale_c4: Small n and radiomics classifiers with overfitting controls still limited events.
rationale_c5: nCRT pathways applied as described across centers.
probast_rationale: Multicentre external validation present but tiny cohorts; segmentation sensitivity adds predictor uncertainty.
appraisal_note: Focus includes impact of auto vs manual ROI on external performance.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM multiparamétrica pretratamiento, estadio II/III, con validación externa; predice respuesta (TRG1-2) a quimiorradioterapia "to personalise per-patient treatment".

title: Simulation CT-based radiomics for prediction of response after neoadjuvant chemo-radiotherapy in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Dual-institution LARC simulation-CT cohorts (Tübingen train; Florence external n=75).
rationale_c2: Planning CT radiomics with pathologic good response (TRG) are appropriate.
rationale_c3: Good-response outcomes reported for exploratory n=126 and external n=75.
rationale_c4: RF radiomics with modest external AUC 0.63; limited confounder adjustment.
rationale_c5: Long-course nCRT delivered per institutional standards in both centers.
probast_rationale: Two-center but modest discrimination externally; pretreatment simCT OK; TRG-based GR clear; analysis optimism.
appraisal_note: Genuine geographic external validation with attenuated AUC 0.63.
applicability_v2_rationale: Se autodeclara estudio generador de hipótesis en discusión y conclusión, con AUC 0,63-0,65. H4(a).

title: Machine learning-based multiparametric MRI radiomics for predicting poor responders after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in rectal Cancer patients.
rationale_c1: Single-center Qingdao LARC n=207 temporal split; representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Multiparametric MRI radiomics with poor vs good nCRT response labels appropriate.
rationale_c3: Train/validation temporal cohorts with response labels complete for included.
rationale_c4: Twenty feature-selection×classifier combinations; peak AUC 0.923 likely optimistic.
rationale_c5: nCRT administered per institutional practice for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center temporal holdout; pretreatment MRI; response defined; extensive model shopping without external center.
appraisal_note: ComBat did not improve performance; classic high-dim radiomics ROB pattern.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI descrito solo como "preoperative"; no declara si es pre o post-nCRT, y la decisión alterna entre cirugía extensa ("before surgery") y respuesta temprana a nCRT. No se puede juzgar el momento de decisión.

title: Applicability of a pathological complete response magnetic resonance-based radiomics model for locally advanced rectal cancer in intercontinental cohort.
rationale_c1: Chinese mainland consecutive LARC n=59 validating European model; still referral care.
rationale_c2: Locked MRI radiomic pCR model applied to staging 1.5/3T T2 MRI appropriately.
rationale_c3: pCR labels and AUC 0.83 with accuracy/NPV/PPV reported.
rationale_c4: Prespecified external application of prior model limits new confounding mining.
rationale_c5: nCRT pathways in validating center applied as described.
probast_rationale: True intercontinental external validation of locked radiomics model; residual participant concern.
appraisal_note: Standout validation design; PPV 0.28 at original threshold—calibration/threshold transport issues remain.
applicability_v2_rationale: Validación de modelo radiómico MRI basal (cT, cN, skewness, entropía) para pCR en LARC tras nCRT, orientado a preservación de órgano; predictores pretratamiento; cohorte sin M1.

title: MRI radiomics independent of clinical baseline characteristics and neoadjuvant treatment modalities predicts response to neoadjuvant therapy in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Four-center LARC pretreatment MRI cohort (n=674) addresses complete response prediction.
rationale_c2: MBR signatures independent of clinical/treatment modality vs CR after neoadjuvant (chemo)RT.
rationale_c3: Five-fold CV mean AUCs ~0.78–0.79 for radiomics models reported.
rationale_c4: 30 selected radiomics features with DT/SVM; no fully independent external center lock stated.
rationale_c5: Short- and long-course neoadjuvant regimens across centers as described.
probast_rationale: Large multicenter radiomics with CV only; analysis ROB high despite clinical-independence claim.
appraisal_note: Radiomics outperformed clinical-only models; organ-preservation stratification intent.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC M0 con RM basal; prediccion de respuesta completa para identificar candidatos a preservacion de organo; las modalidades de tratamiento se incluyen como covariable. Desenlace mezcla pCR y cCR sostenida pero en el mismo contexto de decision.

title: Deep Learning-Based Model for Identifying Tumors in Endoscopic Images From Patients With Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Treated With Total Neoadjuvant Therapy.
rationale_c1: MSK single-center TNT endoscopy pilot (109 patients; 82/27 split).
rationale_c2: VGG-19 CNN for tumor vs no-tumor on longitudinal endoscopy supports WW assessment.
rationale_c3: Image labels and AUROC 0.83 reported for train folds and testing set.
rationale_c4: Small DL pilot without external site or clinical confounder model.
rationale_c5: Institutional TNT and endoscopic surveillance pathway as described.
probast_rationale: Image-level tumor detection (not pathology-locked pCR model); single-center pilot with small test n=27.
appraisal_note: Pilot feasibility study; authors explicitly call for larger multi-center validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Imágenes endoscópicas antes, durante y después de TNT en una sola AUROC 0,83; la decisión de watch and wait solo aplica tras TNT y no se reporta desempeño separado por momento. | NOTA: H4 secundaria por autodeclaración

title: Local tuning of radiomics-based model for predicting pathological response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center training n=162 with intercontinental external sets (34/25 and 59).
rationale_c2: MRI radiomics GLM for pCR after nCRT with local-tuning concept appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes and AUCs reported for original and new validation cohorts.
rationale_c4: LASSO over 1643 LoG features; local retuning admits transportability issues.
rationale_c5: nCRT regimens per collaborating centers as described.
probast_rationale: External AUCs after local tuning (~0.73–0.83); feature mining and retuning keep analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Local tuning improves external fit but undermines a locked portable model.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC con RM T2 una semana antes de CRT; pCR para considerar resecciones parciales/omision de cirugia. Mezcla de curso corto (11%) y largo pero la decision es la misma; n=88 con 12 eventos y re-ajuste local van a analisis.

title: External Validation of a Radiomics Model for the Prediction of Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: French two-institution external validation of prior radiomics pCR model; specialty centers.
rationale_c2: MRI±CT radiomics for pathology complete response after CRT appropriate.
rationale_c3: Very few pCR events in testing (authors note only 5 pCR in a split) threaten completeness/stability.
rationale_c4: Imbalance correction and ComBat help but train–test performance gap and overfitting remain.
rationale_c5: CRT delivered per institutional standards for screened patients.
probast_rationale: External validation attempt valuable; sparse events and optimism gap keep overall ROB high.
appraisal_note: Authors acknowledge overfitting correction still needed given low event rate.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica RM/TC pretratamiento para pCR tras CRT en LARC; selección para preservación de órgano, validación externa. Contexto único y momento coherente; sin H1-H7.

title: MRI Radiomics Model Predicts Pathologic Complete Response of Rectal Cancer Following Chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Large single-center consecutive post-nCRT MRI LARC n=898; population transportability unclear.
rationale_c2: T2/DWI radiomics vs radiologist mrTRG with pathology pCR are appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes complete for temporal training n=592 and test n=306.
rationale_c4: LASSO signature locked on large temporal holdout; outperforms visual mrTRG.
rationale_c5: nCRT and MRI/pathology workflow applied uniformly as described.
probast_rationale: Single-center temporal split; post-nCRT MRI (restaging/WW) not pretreatment-only; pathology pCR clear; residual single-site analysis uncertainty.
appraisal_note: Radiology 2022; code at github.com/Sev-RAD/Rectal-Radiomics; post-nCRT imaging for organ-preservation triage.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM post-nCRT radiómica frente a radiólogos para diagnosticar pCR y seleccionar preservación de órgano; predictores disponibles al decidir; sin autodeclaración exploratoria.

title: Fractal-Based Radiomic Approach to Tailor the Chemotherapy Treatment in Rectal Cancer: A Generating Hypothesis Study.
rationale_c1: Single-institution Gemelli/Mater Olbia LARC radiomics n≈188; hypothesis-generating sample.
rationale_c2: Baseline T2 fractal radiomics with 5yDFS under OXA vs non-OXA nCRT addresses regimen-tailoring aim.
rationale_c3: Long median FU (~96 mo) with DFS events reported for modeled cohorts.
rationale_c4: Univariate feature screen then separate logistics per arm; no external validation; authors label hypothesis-generating.
rationale_c5: OXA assignment observational across historical regimens; fidelity of intended comparative exposure unclear.
probast_rationale: Hypothesis-generating OXA-tailoring via 5yDFS not direct pCR/WW; baseline MRI OK; DFS outcome; no external lock.
appraisal_note: Axis other; fractal FD models AUC 0.67/0.75 by OXA stratum; not a locked therapeutic DSS.
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelo radiomico de 5yDFS para elegir oxaliplatino, autodeclarado generador de hipotesis en titulo y conclusion; asignacion de regimen no aleatoria y sin validacion externa.

title: Complete Pathologic Response Prediction by Radiomics Wavelets Features of Unenhanced CT Simulation Images in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Patients after Neoadjuvant Chemoradiation.
rationale_c1: Single Rambam radiation oncology referral series; size/representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Unenhanced CT-simulation texture/wavelets targeting pathologic complete response.
rationale_c3: Test error rates given but cohort size and missingness thinly reported.
rationale_c4: 70/30 split neural net on texture features without external validation.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant RT course as referred for simulation CT.
probast_rationale: Brief single-center CT-sim radiomics; limited methods transparency and no external test.
appraisal_note: Short IMAJ methods paper; English text sufficient for appraisal.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC IIA-IIIC sin metástasis, TC de simulación pretratamiento de rutina para predecir pCR; decisión de W&W/cirugía. Sin H ni U.

title: Development and validation of a radiopathomics model to predict pathological complete response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: a multicentre observational study.
rationale_c1: Large multicenter LARC nCRT+TME series directly address pretreatment pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI radiomics plus biopsy pathomics and pathology-defined pCR are appropriate.
rationale_c3: Two external retrospective cohorts (n=480, 150) plus prospective multicenter validation (n=100).
rationale_c4: SVM signatures with feature selection; overfitting checked (AIC) and performance held externally/prospectively.
rationale_c5: Pathology pCR after TME used as gold standard; exclusions for incomplete images documented.
criteria_note: MMAT v2018 quantitative non-randomized (multicentre radiopathomics development+validation).
probast_rationale: Clear LARC eligibility; pretreatment MRI+biopsy predictors; masked prospective outcome; external+prospective AUCs ~0.81–0.87.
appraisal_note: Strongest pilot neoadj design (RAPIDS); GitHub StandWisdom/Radiopathomics-pCR-nCRT and data-sharing statement support transparency.

title: Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy Response in Rectal Cancer with Metric Learning Using Pretreatment 18F-Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography.
rationale_c1: Single-pathway PET/CT LARC series (train 202/val 34); external transportability unknown.
rationale_c2: Baseline 18F-FDG PET/CT metric learning vs Dworak TRG3–4 favorable response.
rationale_c3: Very high train/val accuracy reported; outcome labels complete for included patients.
rationale_c4: Metric learning+UMAP with tiny internal validation and near-perfect AUC (~0.96) suggest optimism.
rationale_c5: NCRT then surgery after pretreatment PET/CT as described.
probast_rationale: Authors themselves require external validation; extreme internal metrics inflate analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg; content is pretreatment PET metric learning for nCRT response.
applicability_v2_rationale: PET/CT basal para predecir respuesta a NCRT; el paper declara que informa la decisión entre NCRT y quimioterapia neoadyuvante, antes de iniciar tratamiento.

title: A Novel Scoring System for Response of Preoperative Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Using Early-Treatment Blood Features Derived From Machine Learning.
rationale_c1: Single-center LARC CRT+TME with AJCC TRG addresses early-treatment response scoring.
rationale_c2: Routine blood labs and pathologic TRG (good vs poor) are measurable and clinically relevant.
rationale_c3: Retrospective single-center series (~272); no independent external cohort.
rationale_c4: Thirty model types over 1000 splits; RPS derived then tested on full sample; modest AUROC (~0.63–0.67).
rationale_c5: Pathologic response after TME available for included patients.
criteria_note: MMAT v2018 quantitative non-randomized (retrospective blood-feature ML cohort).
probast_rationale: Single-center convenience sample; early-CRT blood timing supports mid-CRT continue/stop use but analysis overfits without external validation.
appraisal_note: Uses early-on-treatment labs (week 1–2), not pretreatment-only; intended for mid-CRT therapeutic triage rather than WW selection before CRT.

title: The use of deep learning on endoscopic images to assess the response of rectal cancer after chemoradiation.
rationale_c1: Single-institute 2012–2015 endoscopy response series (n=226) including W&W follow-up.
rationale_c2: Open deep networks on endoscopy vs histology/long-term CR reference fit organ-preservation assessment.
rationale_c3: CR/non-CR labels complete; mixed surgery histology and ≥2y W&W follow-up.
rationale_c4: Off-the-shelf DL without strong confounder control; internal 70/30 split only.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant therapy and flexible endoscopy response evaluation as protocol.
probast_rationale: Modest AUCs 0.76–0.83 below experienced endoscopists; composite CR reference (surgery or long FU) and single-center design.
appraisal_note: Authors conclude not accurate enough for clinical decision-making; useful negative/calibration signal.
applicability_v2_rationale: El propio paper se declara estudio piloto y concluye que la exactitud 'no es suficientemente precisa para la toma de decisiones clinicas' y menor a la del endoscopista experto. BORDERLINE: la senal es de desempeño y no una declaracion generica de trabajo futuro; el contexto (W&W post-CRT) y los predictores si son los correctos.

title: A Pipeline for Predicting the Treatment Response of Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Using Single MRI Modality: Combining Deep Segmentation Network and Radiomics Analysis Based on "Suspicious Region".
rationale_c1: Two-hospital Chinese pipeline n=275; convenience tertiary cohorts.
rationale_c2: Single-modality MRI deep segmentation+radiomics on suspicious region for pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR AUCs on In-V (0.83) and Ex-V n=34 (0.82) reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO radiomics after DL segmentation; high-dim selection without full confounder model.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery pathway applied as stated.
probast_rationale: Suspicious-region pipeline with small external n=34; analysis ROB from radiomics mining.
appraisal_note: Automation of ROI is a methods contribution alongside predictive AUCs.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM T2 post-nCRT, antes de la cirugía, para predecir pCR y planificar tratamiento/preservación de órgano; predictor disponible al decidir; LARC T3-4/N+. Segmentación profunda más radiómica.

title: MRI radiomics features of mesorectal fat can predict response to neoadjuvant chemoradiation therapy and tumor recurrence in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-institution MSK LARC n=236 mesorectal-fat radiomics series.
rationale_c2: Baseline T2 mesorectal fat radiomics for pCR and recurrence endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Outcome labels for pCR/local/distant recurrence complete for analyzed cohort.
rationale_c4: Elastic-net/SVM with 5-fold CV only; high-dim fat radiomics without external site.
rationale_c5: nCRT and surveillance applied as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Single-center CV AUCs up to ~0.89 for pCR; no external validation.
appraisal_note: Also predicts recurrence/T category; primary therapeutic relevance is nCRT response.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiomics de grasa mesorrectal basal en cohorte TNT predice pCR, recurrencia, cT, ypN, ypT; no declara qué decisión informa ("predict clinical outcomes"); mezcla desenlaces no pronósticos y pronósticos.

title: Machine learning-based random forest predicts anastomotic leakage after anterior resection for rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Very large Chinese AR series n=5220 plus external n=836; still referral-center case-mix.
rationale_c2: Clinical predictors with anastomotic leak after anterior resection are appropriate.
rationale_c3: AL grades reported for development and external test cohorts.
rationale_c4: RF on clinical factors with external AUC 0.87 outperforming nomogram.
rationale_c5: Anterior resection and leak definitions applied as institutional/ISREC standards.
probast_rationale: Large development+external institution; perioperative predictors; AL definition clear; analysis comparatively strong for clinical RF.
appraisal_note: Standout tox_surg clinical RF with true external n=836; PROBAST unclear due to participants not analysis.
applicability_v2_rationale: Random forest con 8 factores (sexo, distancia, estenosis, Hb, volumen del cirujano, diabetes, nCRT, abordaje) para predecir fuga anastomótica y decidir estoma temporal; disponibles intraoperatoriamente.

title: Radiomic signature of the FOWARC trial predicts pathological response to neoadjuvant treatment in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Secondary analysis of FOWARC multicenter RCT rectal cohort n=177 addresses neoadjuvant pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT radiomics (±MRI rad-score) with pathology pCR appropriate for WW triage.
rationale_c3: Primary/validation random split with pCR labels complete; combined CT+MRI signatures reported.
rationale_c4: GBM train AUC 0.997 signals severe overfitting despite validation AUC 0.822; high-dim LASSO+GBM.
rationale_c5: Trial-protocol neoadjuvant arms and surgery/pathology as per FOWARC.
probast_rationale: RCT-derived eligibility strong; pretreatment CT predictors; pathology pCR; internal split with extreme train optimism.
appraisal_note: FOWARC secondary imaging analysis; train AUC 0.997 is a red flag despite decent validation AUC.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC pretratamiento de ensayo FOWARC predice pCR para identificar candidatos a watch and wait; LARC homogéneo. Sin regla H.

title: Radiomics signature as a new biomarker for preoperative prediction of neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy response in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center LARC n=189; specialty oncology imaging cohort.
rationale_c2: Multi-sequence MRI radiomics predicting TRG-based nCRT sensitivity.
rationale_c3: Sensitive vs resistant groups with validation-group AUC 0.83 reported.
rationale_c4: 30-feature signature after mRMR/ML ensemble; internal validation only.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery with Mandard-style TRG as described.
probast_rationale: Internal validation with high-dim MRI radiomics and ensemble classifiers.
appraisal_note: Nomogram with clinical parameters; train AUCs up to ~0.95 signal optimism.
applicability_v2_rationale: Lectura low: inclusión "cT3-4 or N+, no distant metastasis". Lectura high: Tabla 1 reporta M1 en 15/189 (p. ej. 10 M1 en resistentes) sin análisis separado. Contradicción interna sobre el contexto metastásico.

title: Pretreatment CT and PET radiomics predicting rectal cancer patients in response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Exploratory single-cohort n=66 with TRG/NAR endpoints; representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment non-contrast CT+PET radiomics for TRG and NAR score are appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG distribution and model accuracies reported for composite signatures.
rationale_c4: Composite CT+PET feature mining on small n without external validation.
rationale_c5: NacRT pathway applied for included rectal cancer patients.
probast_rationale: Small exploratory CT/PET radiomics; authors call for larger validation.
appraisal_note: Brief methods; limited reporting detail for TRIPOD-AI data/model elements.
applicability_v2_rationale: Se autodeclara análisis exploratorio y prueba de concepto en resumen y discusión. H4(a). El desenlace NAR es sustituto pronóstico secundario.

title: The Heterogeneity of Skewness in T2W-Based Radiomics Predicts the Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center discrimination study n=40 after exclusions from 85; highly selected.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment T2W skewness radiomics with AJCC TRG0-1 vs 2-3 appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG labels available for analyzed 40 patients.
rationale_c4: Single selected feature on training-only set; no validation split; extreme overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: Long-course nCRT and TME applied per inclusion.
probast_rationale: Authors state only a training discrimination set was considered; AUC 0.90 is exploratory.
appraisal_note: Smallest neoadj radiomics sample in batch; inadequate validation reporting.
applicability_v2_rationale: Un único rasgo radiómico basal para predecir respuesta a nCRT en la decisión de intensificar o W&W; "preliminar" y "prometedor" no cumplen H4; validación futura genérica.

title: Development of a Joint Prediction Model Based on Both the Radiomics and Clinical Factors for Predicting the Tumor Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Patients with Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Development n=82 plus external 107; still specialty-center convenience.
rationale_c2: Joint radiomics+clinical model for tumor response to nCRT appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response outcomes and AUCs (~0.89) with external validation reported.
rationale_c4: Clinical factors combined with radiomics; joint model partially addresses confounding.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery as collaborating-center practice.
probast_rationale: External joint model AUCs strong; residual ROB from radiomics feature selection on modest train n.
appraisal_note: Pre- and post-CRT MRI models both reported; pretreatment joint model is primary for decision timing.

title: Predicting treatment response from longitudinal images using multi-task deep learning.
rationale_c1: Multi-institution Chinese rectal nCRT cohorts with prospective additional collection; still tertiary.
rationale_c2: Longitudinal pre/post MRI multi-task DL for pCR with external cohorts appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR labeled in train and two independent validation cohorts (160 and 141).
rationale_c4: Strong external AUCs 0.92–0.95; multitask design and multi-site testing limit confounding/optimism.
rationale_c5: nCRT then surgery pathways applied as described across institutions.
probast_rationale: Strong multi-institution/prospective validation; predictors need post-nCRT MRI (restaging/WW), not pretreatment-only selection.
appraisal_note: GitHub Heng14/3D_RP-Net; among stronger longitudinal DL response models.
applicability_v2_rationale: Imágenes pre y postnCRT (previas a cirugía) para predecir pCR y seleccionar watchful waiting; momento de decisión compatible. Sin H ni U.

title: MRI-based clinical-radiomics model predicts tumor response before treatment in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-institution LARC n=72; small convenience sample.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI clinical-radiomics (TC+TB) with pathologic response fit aims.
rationale_c3: Response labels reported for all 72 included patients under nested CV.
rationale_c4: 1405 features with nested CV only; no external validation (AUC 0.793).
rationale_c5: nCRT and MRI protocols applied as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Small single-center; pretreatment MRI OK; pathology response clear; high-dim nCV without external lock.
appraisal_note: Axis other; tumor+tumor-bed synergy claimed; data not publicly available.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM pretratamiento, clínico-radiómico, predice respuesta en LARC; objetivo de adaptar neoadyuvancia y preservar órgano. Sin regla H ni U.

title: Evaluating treatment response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in rectal cancer using various MRI-based radiomics models.
rationale_c1: Single-center Changhai LARC n=80 retrospective; not population-representative.
rationale_c2: Pre/post T2 radiomics with TRG and pCR endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Pathology response available; LOOCV performance fully reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO/PCA with four classifiers and LOOCV on n=80; AUCs ~0.94 likely optimistic.
rationale_c5: nCRT then resection administered as intended for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center; MRI radiomics; pathology TRG/pCR; LOOCV only without external cohort.
appraisal_note: Authors prefer LASSO over PCA clinically; classic small-n radiomics pattern.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica de RM T2 pre y post-nCRT para predecir pCR/TRG antes de la cirugía en LARC (cT3 o N+), en relación con observación y espera; predictores disponibles antes de la resección.

title: MRI Radiomics for Prediction of Tumor Response and Downstaging in Rectal Cancer Patients after Preoperative Chemoradiation.
rationale_c1: Very small LARC n=39 single-series; not representative.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-CRT MRI radiomics and delta features for TRG/pCR/downstaging.
rationale_c3: TRG/pCR/T-downstaging labels reported for all included patients.
rationale_c4: 294 features with univariate/SVM selection on n=39—severe EPV violation.
rationale_c5: nCRT completed before post-CRT MRI and surgery as scheduled.
probast_rationale: n=39 with pre/post/delta radiomics; post-CRT predictors not pretreatment-only.
appraisal_note: Pilot-scale sample; high ROB expected.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pre/post-CRT (n=39) predice pCR, respuesta buena y T-downstaging en LARC sin metástasis; intro vincula a preservación de órgano e intensificación. Muestra pequeña es H5.

title: A Deep Learning Model to Predict the Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy by the Pretreatment Apparent Diffusion Coefficient Images of Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Large single-institution ADC DL series (700 chronological train/test); external sites absent.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment ADC CNN for good vs non-good NCRT responders fits intensification/WW aims.
rationale_c3: Chronological test n=200 with response labels complete for included patients.
rationale_c4: Deep CNN across scanners without independent external cohort; optimism risk remains.
rationale_c5: NCRT and MRI protocols applied as described for GR prediction.
probast_rationale: Large temporal holdout ADC DL; multi-scanner design helps but no true external site validation.
appraisal_note: GitHub radiologypkucancer/rectal_ code available; temporal rather than geographic external.
applicability_v2_rationale: DL sobre ADC pretratamiento en LARC para predecir buenos respondedores a NCRT y decidir intensificación o preservación de órgano; predictor basal; cohorte cT3-4/cN+ homogénea.

title: Combining Radiomics and Blood Test Biomarkers to Predict the Response of Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer to Chemoradiation.
rationale_c1: LARC nCRT+TME with Dworak TRG good-response endpoint matches noninvasive prediction aim.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment T2 MRI radiomics, routine blood markers, and pathology TRG are appropriate.
rationale_c3: Single-center n=135 with random 2:1 internal split only; limited representativeness.
rationale_c4: Elastic-net on high-dimensional radiomics in train n=90; combined models not clearly better than radiomics alone.
rationale_c5: Pathologic TRG available for all included; no TRG0 cases noted.
criteria_note: MMAT v2018 quantitative non-randomized (single-center radiomics+blood model).
probast_rationale: Retrospective single-center selection; pretreatment predictors OK; internal validation only with small events and likely optimism.
appraisal_note: Good-response defined as Dworak TRG 3–4 (not pCR-only); single-observer ROI with translation-based ICC stability.

title: A field strength independent MR radiomics model to predict pathological complete response in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Two institutions (1.5T/3T; n=195) but pooled CV without independent holdout site.
rationale_c2: Pre-CRT T2 radiomics for pathology pCR with field-strength awareness is appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes available for included patients across scanners.
rationale_c4: 496 features filtered then logistic models with repeated CV only; no locked external set.
rationale_c5: nCRT and imaging protocols described for both institutions.
probast_rationale: Field-strength-aware model AUC 0.72 after CV; authors note absence of independent external dataset.
appraisal_note: Useful for scanner-heterogeneity discussion; still internal validation design.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica T2 pre-CRT en LARC predice pCR; contexto neoadyuvante claro y predictores pretratamiento. Sin regla H.

title: Multiparametric MRI and Whole Slide Image-Based Pretreatment Prediction of Pathological Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Rectal Cancer: A Multicenter Radiopathomic Study.
rationale_c1: Four Chinese hospitals total ~981 LARC; consecutive tertiary recruitment.
rationale_c2: mpMRI+WSI radiopathomics predicting TRG/pCR before nCRT appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG-stratified outcomes and multicentre validation AUCs reported.
rationale_c4: Very high RPS AUCs (0.95–0.99) with high-dim mpMRI+path features suggest overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: nCRT then TME with AJCC/CAP TRG grading as specified.
probast_rationale: Multicenter radiopathomic RPS with near-perfect AUCs; analysis ROB from extreme discrimination and feature mining.
appraisal_note: Abstract says prospective framing but methods describe retrospective recruitment from four hospitals.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC cT3-4 M0 con RM mp y WSI de biopsia diagnostica, ambos disponibles antes de la nCRT; el paper nombra la decision (watch-and-wait, escision local, balance beneficio/toxicidad de nCRT) y valida en 3 cohortes externas. Nota: el subgrupo pCR usa ypT0N0.

title: Machine learning for predicting pathological complete response in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
rationale_c1: Kaohsiung Medical University LARC CRT series with small validation cohort.
rationale_c2: Clinicopathologic inputs to ANN/KNN/SVM/NBC/MLR for pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR available for ~248–270 included patients across train/validation.
rationale_c4: Internal validation emphasis; multiple algorithms without clear external lock or EPV safeguards.
rationale_c5: Fluoropyrimidine±FOLFOX CRT and TME delivered as stated.
probast_rationale: Single-system Taiwanese cohorts; ANN favored but analysis ROB high without robust external validation.
appraisal_note: Compares five ML families for pCR prediction.
applicability_v2_rationale: ML con predictores clínicos y post-CRT CEA para pCR en LARC estadio II-III; propone identificar candidatos a watch and wait. Predictores disponibles tras CRT; sin H1-H7.

title: Pre-Treatment T2-WI Based Radiomics Features for Prediction of Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Non-Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy: A Preliminary Study.
rationale_c1: Single-institution preliminary LARC n=67 (train 44/val 23).
rationale_c2: Pretreatment T2 radiomics with Ryan TRG non-response endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG non-responder labels reported in train and validation groups.
rationale_c4: 960→7 LASSO features on tiny samples; internal validation only.
rationale_c5: nCRT and TME pathway applied as described.
probast_rationale: Small single-center preliminary study; pretreatment T2 OK; TRG3 non-response clear; analysis high ROB.
appraisal_note: Authors label preliminary; PyRadiomics config in supplement.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiomica basal para no respuesta en LARC, n=67; se autodeclara 'Preliminary Study' en el titulo como naturaleza del trabajo. Duda: 'preliminary' no es literal de H4 y el cuerpo no repite el rotulo.

title: Predicting treatment response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in local advanced rectal cancer by biopsy digital pathology image features.
rationale_c1: Single-center Guangdong Provincial People’s Hospital LARC biopsy pathomics n=151; transportability unclear.
rationale_c2: H&E WSI tile features with nCRT response labels fit digital-pathology prediction aim.
rationale_c3: Primary/validation splits with AUCs 0.930/0.877 and classification metrics reported.
rationale_c4: SVM tile classifier then logistic signature on high-dim histology features; short-report detail limited.
rationale_c5: nCRT and pathology workflow applied as described for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center short communication; pretreatment biopsy WSIs available; response defined; internal validation only.
appraisal_note: Clin Transl Med short communication; methods largely in appendices; still appraiseable from English main text.
applicability_v2_rationale: Patología digital de biopsia pretratamiento en LARC para identificar a quienes 'will not benefit' de nCRT; predictor disponible antes de decidir. Ninguna H cumplida.

title: Predicting pathological complete response in rectal cancer after chemoradiotherapy with a random forest using <sup>18</sup>F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography and computed tomography radiomics.
rationale_c1: Single-institution rectal cancer PET/CT series n=169; referral bias.
rationale_c2: Baseline FDG-PET/CT radiomics RF predicting pathology pCR after NCRT.
rationale_c3: pCR in 22/169 with accuracy/sensitivity/specificity reported.
rationale_c4: 68 MTV radiomics features into RF with internal resampling; no external cohort.
rationale_c5: NCRT then surgery completed for included patients as stated.
probast_rationale: Claimed accuracy 95.3% without external validation—high analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept; content is pCR prediction from PET radiomics.
applicability_v2_rationale: 169 rectales con PET/CT basal de rutina, pCR tras NCRT; predictores pretratamiento. Falta de validación externa va a análisis (H5).

title: Clinical utility of radiomics at baseline rectal MRI to predict complete response of rectal cancer after chemoradiation therapy.
rationale_c1: MSK single-center baseline rectal MRI convenience cohort; external transportability unclear.
rationale_c2: T2 radiomics plus anatomical MRI staging criteria for complete response after CRT.
rationale_c3: CR outcomes and model performance reported for included LARC patients.
rationale_c4: Radiomics ML without external validation; residual clinical confounding possible.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant CRT pathway after baseline MRI as intended.
probast_rationale: MSK baseline MRI radiomics for CR; internal analysis only despite open radiomics code.
appraisal_note: Code via CERR/GitHub; clinical utility framing for WW selection.
applicability_v2_rationale: NOTA: sensibilidad: autodeclaración de piloto/PoC; bajo criterio único sería high H4 (no se cambia: muestra fijada)

title: Radiomic Features of Primary Rectal Cancers on Baseline T<sub>2</sub> -Weighted MRI Are Associated With Pathologic Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiation: A Multisite Study.
rationale_c1: Three-site US cohort with discovery (n=60) and multi-site hold-out (n=44) addresses transportability.
rationale_c2: Baseline T2 MRI radiomics with AJCC pCR after long-course nCRT are appropriate.
rationale_c3: Pathologic response labels complete after stated exclusions (final n=104).
rationale_c4: 764 radiomic descriptors with RF feature ranking on small discovery set risk optimism despite hold-out AUC 0.712.
rationale_c5: Long-course nCRT+TME pathway consistent across sites.
probast_rationale: Genuine multi-site hold-out but small discovery events and high-dim RF selection keep analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Hold-out from Sites 2–3 is independent of Site-1 discovery; modest validation AUC.
applicability_v2_rationale: T2 RM basal predice pCR a quimiorradiación en LARC multisitio; fin explícito de identificar candidatos a no operar ("wait-and-watch").

title: Predicting the Response to FOLFOX-Based Chemotherapy Regimen from Untreated Liver Metastases on Baseline CT: a Deep Neural Network Approach.
rationale_c1: Single-center CRLM CT series (202 patients / 444 lesions).
rationale_c2: Baseline CT DCNN predicting FOLFOX response of untreated liver metastases appropriate.
rationale_c3: Treated/untreated and response labels with AUCs (up to 0.97) reported.
rationale_c4: Deep net on lesions with internal CV only; clinical confounders not fully modeled.
rationale_c5: FOLFOX-based regimens administered as institutional standard.
probast_rationale: High internal AUC 0.97 without external validation; response definition/lesion-level analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: First filters treated vs untreated lesions then predicts FOLFOX response on untreated.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC basal de metástasis hepáticas no tratadas para predecir respuesta a FOLFOX+bevacizumab (TRG) en primera línea; contexto metastásico adecuado, decisión de mantener o cambiar régimen; predictor pre-tratamiento.

title: Radiomics performs comparable to morphologic assessment by expert radiologists for prediction of response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy on baseline staging MRI in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Two-center European baseline MRI series n=133; tertiary radiology centers.
rationale_c2: T2/DWI radiomics vs expert morphologic scores for ypT0/good TRG appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response outcomes complete for train (center1) and validation (center2).
rationale_c4: 2505 features filtered on train center; modest AUCs 0.69–0.79 with known radiomics optimism.
rationale_c5: CRT then assessment pathways applied as intended.
