probast_rationale: Center-based external validation present; high-dim selection still drives analysis ROB; performance similar to experts.
appraisal_note: Radiomics comparable to expert morphologic assessment; not clearly superior.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI basal de estadificación en LARC predice respuesta completa/buena para intensificar o preservar órgano; "exploratory estimation of its potential clinical benefit". Momento coherente.

title: Radiomics Model Based on Non-Contrast CT Shows No Predictive Power for Complete Pathological Response in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center attempt to replicate non-contrast CT radiomics pCR prediction.
rationale_c2: Planning CT radiomics with pathology pCR and RF classifier are appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR/non-pCR labels available; balanced accuracy ~0.50 reported transparently.
rationale_c4: Repeated CV with imbalance correction appropriately shows null predictive value.
rationale_c5: nCRT pathway applied as institutional practice for included LARC.
probast_rationale: Single-center negative replication; predictors/outcome OK; null finding well shown but limited transportability testing.
appraisal_note: Important negative study: non-contrast CT radiomics shows no pCR predictive power after imbalance correction.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica de TC de planificación sin contraste, pretratamiento, para pCR en LARC tras quimiorradiación; resultado negativo pero contexto y momento de decisión adecuados.

title: Predicting pathological complete response by comparing MRI-based radiomics pre- and postneoadjuvant radiotherapy for locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center Xiangya LARC n=131; primary/validation 87/44 only.
rationale_c2: Pre- vs post-nRT T2 radiomics delta signature with pathology pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes reported in primary and independent validation cohorts.
rationale_c4: LASSO over 165 features without external center; residual optimism risk.
rationale_c5: nRT/nCRT and surgery pathway followed for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center; pre/post MRI for post-nRT response prediction; pathology pCR; internal validation cohort only.
appraisal_note: Delta radiomics comparing pre/post nRT; supports post-treatment WW triage more than pretreatment selection.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica MRI pre y post nRT (<1 semana tras nRT, antes de cirugía) predice pCR en LARC; informa watch and wait. Sin regla H.

title: Prediction of Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy by MRI-Based Machine Learning Texture Analysis in Rectal Cancer Patients.
rationale_c1: LARC n=67 single-center pretreatment MRI; small convenience sample.
rationale_c2: T1/T2 texture with LoG filters predicting AJCC/CAP pathologic response grades.
rationale_c3: Grade 0–3 response distribution and classifier AUCs reported.
rationale_c4: Many texture features and nine classifiers without external validation.
rationale_c5: nCRT before resection as standard pathway described.
probast_rationale: n=67 texture ML with LoG preprocessing experiments; internal only.
appraisal_note: Best reported AUC ~0.85 with Naive Bayes + LoG; still exploratory.
applicability_v2_rationale: Textura RM 1 semana antes de nCRT predice respuesta patológica en LARC cT3-4/N+; "selection of treatment approach". Sobreajuste y n=67 son H5; sin H1-H7.

title: Predicting the tumor response to chemoradiotherapy for rectal cancer: Model development and external validation using MRI radiomics.
rationale_c1: Leuven development (n=70) and Utrecht external (n=55); small samples limit representativeness.
rationale_c2: Pre/post T2/DWI/ADC radiomics and semantics for ypT0–1N0 near-complete response.
rationale_c3: Response rates and selected model validation metrics reported in both cohorts.
rationale_c4: Many candidate LASSO models with PCA; residual optimism despite external test.
rationale_c5: CRT then surgery with paired pre/post MRI as described.
probast_rationale: True external cohort but small events; multiphase predictors and extensive model search keep ROB elevated.
appraisal_note: GitHub model code; some models use post-CRT imaging (restaging vs pretreatment selection).
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pre y post-CRT disponible antes de decidir preservación de órgano; cohorte no metastásica con validación externa. El endpoint ypT0-1N0 se justifica por resección local. Sin H1-H7.

title: MRI-Based Radiomics Predicts Tumor Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-institution LARC nCRT series n=134 with internal train/validation only.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment axial T2 radiomics/SVM for pCR, good response, and down-staging fit aims.
rationale_c3: Pathology endpoints reported for all analyzed patients.
rationale_c4: Texture+clinicopathologic feature mining with internal split; high AUCs likely optimistic.
rationale_c5: Standard nCRT then TME as inclusion required.
probast_rationale: Single-center internal validation AUCs ~0.87–0.91 without external lock.
appraisal_note: Authors acknowledge retrospective single-dataset limits and need for multicenter prospective work.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC con RM T2 3-10 dias antes de nCRT mas variables clinicas pretratamiento; la introduccion vincula pCR con watch-and-wait y el uso es 'apoyo a decision clinica'. BORDERLINE: no detalla una accion concreta (U3 considerado).

title: Machine learning for prediction of chemoradiation therapy response in rectal cancer using pre-treatment and mid-radiation multi-parametric MRI.
rationale_c1: Single-center LARC n=51 with incomplete pre/mid-RT MRI availability.
rationale_c2: Pre- and mid-RT multiparametric MRI radiomics/DL for pCR/GR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR and good-response labels with 4-fold CV AUCs (0.80–0.86) reported.
rationale_c4: High-dim radiomics+DL with CV only on small N; confounders limited.
rationale_c5: CRT delivered with mid-RT MRI ~3–4 weeks as protocolized.
probast_rationale: Mid-RT features aid adaptive decisions but no external validation; small N drives high analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: PMC author manuscript version appraised; mid-RT predictors not available at baseline decision.
applicability_v2_rationale: MRI pretratamiento y a 3-4 semanas de CRT: 'patients predicted not to respond well... switching to other drug regimens or going to surgery early'. Predictores disponibles al decidir.

title: Radiomics-Based Pretherapeutic Prediction of Non-response to Neoadjuvant Therapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: LARC with pretherapeutic multiparametric MRI and neoadjuvant therapy addresses non-response prediction.
rationale_c2: T1w/T2w/DWI/CE-T1w radiomics and AJCC TRG non-response (TRG3) are appropriate endpoints.
rationale_c3: Single-center n=425 with random 3:1 split; mixed FOLFOX-only vs CRT regimens limit target-population fit.
rationale_c4: 2424 features filtered to 16 on primary cohort; few non-responders (n=52); CMPR calibration failed in validation.
rationale_c5: Consensus pathology TRG after resection for included patients.
criteria_note: MMAT v2018 quantitative non-randomized (single-center multiparametric radiomics).
probast_rationale: Single-center convenience; pretherapeutic MRI OK; high-dim selection with internal-only validation; nearly 60% chemo-without-RT blurs CRT/WW applicability.
appraisal_note: Predicts AJCC TRG3 non-response (not pCR); appendix holds acquisition/feature details; no public code/data stated.

title: Deep Learning and Radiomics predict complete response after neo-adjuvant chemoradiation for locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Three French academic hospitals referring for nCRT; convenience sample.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT radiomics+clinical DNN for pathology complete response appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR labels for included cohort; 5-fold CV performance reported.
rationale_c4: Limited n with many predictors; DNN/SVM CV only without external cohort.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant chemoradiation delivered as institutional standard.
probast_rationale: Early DL+radiomics pCR model; analysis ROB high from small n and CV-only validation.
appraisal_note: Author Correction version; accuracy ~80% on CV; sample-size limitation acknowledged.
applicability_v2_rationale: El paper se autodeclara prueba de concepto en resumen y conclusión (H4a).

title: Magnetic Resonance, Vendor-independent, Intensity Histogram Analysis Predicting Pathologic Complete Response After Radiochemotherapy of Rectal Cancer.
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
rationale_c1: Three-center MR IBH pCR model (train 162; external VS1/VS2).
rationale_c2: Vendor-independent intensity histogram with pathology pCR is appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR outcomes reported for training and external verification sets.
rationale_c4: Histogram signature with external AUC 0.75; residual feature-selection uncertainty.
rationale_c5: CRT and MR protocols across centers applied as described.
probast_rationale: Multicenter external sets including trial patients; pretreatment MR OK; pCR clear; analysis residual uncertainty.
appraisal_note: Early multicenter IBH model (2018); external AUC 0.75.

title: MR Imaging of Rectal Cancer: Radiomics Analysis to Assess Treatment Response after Neoadjuvant Therapy.
rationale_c1: Single-institution MSK post-CRT MRI series n=114; referral-center case-mix.
rationale_c2: T2 radiomics vs qualitative T2/DWI for clinical complete response with pathology pCR reference appropriate.
rationale_c3: Surgical histopathology reference for all included; RF metrics fully reported.
rationale_c4: Random forest with SMOTE balancing and no external validation; high optimism (AUC 0.93).
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant CRT then surgery/pathology as intended for included patients.
probast_rationale: MSK convenience; post-CRT MRI predictors for cCR/pCR; pathology reference; internal RF+SMOTE only.
appraisal_note: Landmark Radiology radiomics cCR paper; influential but high analysis ROB by modern PROBAST standards.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica T2 post-CRT para diagnosticar respuesta clínica/pCR antes de cirugía; sustenta manejo no quirúrgico, momento de decisión coincide.

title: Rectal Cancer: Assessment of Neoadjuvant Chemoradiation Outcome based on Radiomics of Multiparametric MRI.
rationale_c1: Single-institute consecutive T3/T4 n=48; early small series.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment multiparametric MRI (T1/T2/DWI/DCE) features predicting pCR/GR.
rationale_c3: pCR and good-response labels with ANN performance reported.
rationale_c4: 103 imaging features with ANN on n=48; leave-one-out style internal validation.
rationale_c5: NCCN-style CRT then TME with CapeOx/FOLFOX as described.
probast_rationale: Landmark small multiparametric radiomics; high analysis ROB from EPV and internal only.
appraisal_note: CCR 2016; consecutive enrollment with protocolized CRT.
applicability_v2_rationale: LARC T3-4 M0 con RM mp 1-2 semanas antes de CRT; motivacion explicita: identificar respondedores completos para cirugia alternativa (escision local) o wait-and-see. n=48 con CV (RoB, no aplicabilidad).

title: Multi-omics Signature Predicts Anti-EGFR Therapy Benefit in Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastases: A Multi-center Cohort Study.
rationale_c1: Multi-institutional RAS-wt CRLM cetuximab cohorts with prospective external enrollment 2018.
rationale_c2: CT radiomics (ResNet18) plus genetic Random Forest multi-omics for anti-EGFR benefit.
rationale_c3: Train/test and prospective external response metrics reported for integrated signature.
rationale_c4: Weighted deep/genetic fusion; residual high-dim optimism despite external cohort.
rationale_c5: Anti-EGFR exposure in RAS-wt CRLM as intended for benefit prediction.
probast_rationale: Prospective external multi-omics anti-EGFR model; retrospective development and fusion weighting leave residual analysis uncertainty.
appraisal_note: Actionable RAS-wt CRLM therapy-selection signature; weights 3:7 radiomic:genetic.
applicability_v2_rationale: Firma radiómica+genética (TC y genes) para predecir beneficio de cetuximab en CRLM RAS nativo irresecable, primera línea; contexto metastásico adecuado, cohorte negativa con quimioterapia sola; el paper afirma datos "routinely available".

title: Rectal Cancer Radiotherapy Response Prediction: Retrospective Study of Development of a Deep Learning-Based Radiomics Model.
rationale_c1: Single-center n=2000 pathologically confirmed RC treated with standard RT matches DL radiomics RT-response aim.
rationale_c2: Shanxi Provincial People’s Hospital convenience cohort only; no external site for transportability.
rationale_c3: Pretreatment DCE-MRI (CT for QC/fusion); RECIST 1.1 GR vs poor with dual blinded readers (kappa 0.83).
rationale_c4: 2000 labeled after exclusions; train/val/test 8:1:1 with complete response labels reported.
rationale_c5: Concurrent chemo/surgery allowed per CSCO; DL classifiers largely imaging-only with limited confounder adjustment.
probast_rationale: Single-center selection; pretreatment MRI predictors available pre-RT; RECIST outcome clear; internal hold-out/CV only with architecture competition raises optimism risk.
appraisal_note: Large single-center Transformer AUROC 0.921 on internal test; multicenter external validation explicitly still needed.
applicability_v2_rationale: RT "estándar" en 2000 pacientes con cáncer rectal (T2-T4, N0-N2) sin declarar si es neoadyuvante, definitiva u otra; respuesta por RECIST. Contexto y decisión informada no determinables.

title: A serum metabolite-based machine learning model predicts response to neoadjuvant immunotherapy in mismatch repair-deficient colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Multicenter dMMR CRC immunotherapy cohorts (train n=121; external n=30) from tertiary centers.
rationale_c2: Serum LC-MS/ELISA metabolites with immunotherapy response labels address neoadjuvant IO selection.
rationale_c3: Responder/non-responder labels reported for train and external cohorts.
rationale_c4: RF/RFE metabolite panel with small external n=30 may retain optimism despite AUC 0.88.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy pathways as described for dMMR CRC.
probast_rationale: Actionable dMMR IO response model with external AUC 0.88; small external events and metabolomic mining keep analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: 5-metabolite RF model; SHAP reported; adding metastasis stage did not improve performance.
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelo de metabolitos séricos en dMMR con inmunoterapia neoadyuvante; el momento de toma de suero respecto al tratamiento no se reporta (solo 'serum samples collected between...') y 29 % es pM1. No se puede juzgar H3/H1.

title: Multi-Phasic CECT Peritumoral Radiomics Predict Treatment Response to Bevacizumab-Based Chemotherapy in RAS-Mutated Colorectal Liver Metastases.
rationale_c1: Single-center RAS-mutated CRLM CECT series n=42 / 73 samples.
rationale_c2: Multi-phasic peritumoral radiomics predicting bevacizumab-based response appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response labels and internal CV AUCs for phase/delta feature groups reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO across large radiomics banks on tiny N without external lock.
rationale_c5: Bevacizumab-based chemotherapy administered as stated for RAS-mutated CRLM.
probast_rationale: Peritumoral multiphase model; n=42 and no external validation dominate ROB.
appraisal_note: Data availability statement present; authors call for prospective multicenter validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica TC pretratamiento predice resistencia a quimioterapia con bevacizumab en metástasis hepáticas RAS-mutadas; contexto metastásico y decisión coinciden. Sin regla H. | NOTA: H4 por autodeclaración (criterio único)

title: Radiomic signatures from baseline CT predict chemotherapy response in unresectable colorectal liver metastases.
rationale_c1: MSK unresectable CRLM with pre/post portal-phase CT addresses baseline radiomics chemo-response prediction.
rationale_c2: Single-center MSK 2009–2020 convenience series after large exclusions; external transportability unknown.
rationale_c3: PyRadiomics 107 features from all-tumor and largest-tumor ROIs; volumetric response aligned to RECIST 1.1.
rationale_c4: 355 eligible (156 responders/199 non); undersampled to 312 with train/test labels complete.
rationale_c5: Chemo regimens and clinical confounders not fully modeled; random undersampling before split may distort case-mix.
probast_rationale: Single-center exclusions from 615 to 355; baseline CT predictors available pre-chemo; volumetric RECIST outcome defined; mRMR+stacking on internal 80/20 without external validation.
appraisal_note: Stacking AUC up to 0.77 on internal test; imaging not shareable, extracted features on request.
applicability_v2_rationale: CRLM inicialmente irresecable con TC basal para predecir respuesta a quimioterapia, con la accion declarada (evitar quimio toxica o cambiar de terapia antes). BORDERLINE: el esquema de quimioterapia no se reporta ni se estratifica (U1 considerado) y hay claims de 'biomarcadores mecanisticos'.

title: MRI-based radiomics predicts the pathologic response of colorectal liver metastases to systemic therapy: A multicenter study.
rationale_c1: Bi-institutional Italian CRLM resection-after-chemo series 2018–2021.
rationale_c2: Post-chemo gadoxetic MRI radiomics for pathologic response of CRLM appropriate.
rationale_c3: Pathologic response available for 162 evaluated patients.
rationale_c4: Radiomics models with internal stratified CV only; no fully external site.
rationale_c5: Systemic therapy then resection pathways as consecutive practice.
probast_rationale: Post-chemotherapy MRI predictors (not pure baseline selection); internal validation AUC ~0.86; GitHub code helps transparency.
appraisal_note: Code https://github.com/rikhy967/TRG_MetHep; metastatic_systemic axis.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM post-quimio predice TRG de MHCRC ya seleccionadas para resección; dice permitiría "treatment planning according to ... effectiveness of systemic therapies" sin precisar qué decisión informa; no es solo pronóstico con claridad.

title: A PET-CT radiomics model for immunotherapy response and prognosis prediction in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Multi-cohort mCRC with PET/CT plus TME/immunotherapy cohorts matches radiomics immunotherapy-response aim.
rationale_c2: Three Chinese hospitals; requires PET/CT and RNA-seq/tissue, so selected vs typical immunotherapy candidates.
rationale_c3: FDG PET/CT radiomics, CD3/CD8 immunoscore, and RECIST/OS/PFS endpoints appropriate for TME and IO response.
rationale_c4: Train n=105, internal n=60, external TME n=42 and IO n=99 with response and survival reported.
rationale_c5: LASSO clinical factors plus immunoscore combined with Rad-Score in nomograms; multivariable Cox for OS/PFS.
probast_rationale: Tissue/PET selection bias acknowledged; pretreatment PET/CT Rad-Score available for IO decision; RECIST/survival defined; multi-algorithm RF selection and limited DNN detail raise analysis risk despite external cohorts.
appraisal_note: External IO AUC 0.784 and TME AUC 0.814; DNN architecture under-specified; datasets said to be in online repositories.

title: Prediction of the Therapeutic Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy for Rectal Cancer Using a Deep Learning Model.
rationale_c1: Small multicenter-database NAC rectal series (~49–57) for DL development.
rationale_c2: Prechemo CT deep learning with pathologic non-response endpoint fit aims.
rationale_c3: Response labels reported across CV folds for included patients.
rationale_c4: Patch-level DL with fold AUC up to 0.999; extreme overfitting risk on tiny n.
rationale_c5: NAC and surgery timing applied per prior multicenter protocol.
probast_rationale: Very small n; pretreatment CT OK; pathology response clear; near-perfect CV AUC signals high analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Data may be shared on request; PyTorch/ResNet cited; treat AUCs with caution.
applicability_v2_rationale: Aprendizaje profundo en TC pre-quimioterapia (SOX) para respuesta, cohorte homogenea y decision explicita (optimizar NAC). El rotulo 'pilot' aparece solo en limitaciones; se lee como salvedad de tamano, no como naturaleza del trabajo. | NOTA: H4 por autodeclaración (criterio único)

title: Delta Radiomics and Tumor Size: A New Predictive Radiomics Model for Chemotherapy Response in Liver Metastases from Breast and Colorectal Cancer.
rationale_c1: CRC liver-metastasis subset (37 patients/109 lesions) with pre/post CT addresses chemo-response delta radiomics.
rationale_c2: Single Northwestern multi-site enterprise; mixed BC+CRC design and small CRC n limit representativeness.
rationale_c3: IBSI/LIFEx CT radiomics with LME harmonization; per-lesion RECIST 1.1 PD/SD/PR labeling.
rationale_c4: Response labels complete for included CRC and BC lesions after eligibility filters.
rationale_c5: Heterogeneous chemo (±bevacizumab) regimens; limited multivariable clinical confounder control in RF classifiers.
probast_rationale: BC+CRC mix with CRC results separable; Delta/baseline-referenced features need post-treatment CT so not pure pretreatment selection; RECIST clear; 75/25+bootstrap only, no external CRC validation.
appraisal_note: CRC-separable AUCs 0.82 (delta) and 0.93 (baseline-referenced); appraised on CRC subset; mixed primary cancers noted for applicability.
applicability_v2_rationale: Metástasis hepáticas de CCR (resultados CRC separados de mama); respuesta RECIST a quimioterapia sistémica; 'switching to an alternative therapy'. Circularidad predictor/desenlace es RoB, no aplicabilidad.

title: Radiomics-based Machine Learning Approach to Predict Chemotherapy Responses in Colorectal Liver Metastases.
rationale_c1: Single-center Kumamoto CRLM first-line doublet chemo n=150; transportability unclear.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment portal-phase CT radiomics with RECIST responder/non-responder labels appropriate.
rationale_c3: Train/test 112/38 with best overall response labels complete.
rationale_c4: 107 features with Boruta/RF on modest events; no external center validation.
rationale_c5: First-line doublet chemotherapy delivered as recorded for included patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center CRLM; baseline CT available pre-chemo; RECIST clear; internal 5-fold+holdout only.
appraisal_note: Axis metastatic_systemic; largest-lesion VOI may miss multi-lesion heterogeneity.

title: The Use of Artificial Intelligence in Predicting Chemotherapy-Induced Toxicities in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: A Data-Driven Approach for Personalized Oncology.
rationale_c1: Single-center mCRC n=74 before first chemo; not population-representative.
rationale_c2: 95 pre-chemo characteristics predicting chemotherapy-induced toxicity.
rationale_c3: Toxicity predictor constructed but completeness of AE ascertainment unclear.
rationale_c4: Random Forest on many features with small n; limited validation detail.
rationale_c5: First-line metastatic chemotherapy delivered in routine care as stated.
probast_rationale: Small n=74 toxicity RF; feature definitions and outcome grading thinly reported.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg; metastatic systemic toxicity prediction.
applicability_v2_rationale: Título mCRC pero cohorte estadios II-IV, adyuvante y metastásico mezclados; laboratorios tras el primer ciclo y 'dose reduction' como predictor, no disponibles antes de quimioterapia. | NOTA: H4 secundaria por autodeclaración

title: Non-invasive CT radiomic biomarkers predict microsatellite stability status in colorectal cancer: a multicenter validation study.
rationale_c1: Three-hospital CRC CT cohort (SNUH train; NKI/INT external) for MSI radiomics.
rationale_c2: Preoperative CT radiomics vs IHC/PCR MSI status appropriate for immunotherapy triage.
rationale_c3: External AUROC 0.69 radiomics and 0.78 combined clinical-radiomic reported.
rationale_c4: Seven-feature radiomic signature with modest discrimination; residual analysis uncertainty.
rationale_c5: Preoperative CT acquisition and MSI testing applied as described.
probast_rationale: Genuine multicenter external MSI validation but modest AUROC and radiomics selection keep analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Clinical+radiomic algorithm improved external AUROC to 0.78.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice MSI vs MSS a partir de TC preoperatoria en CCR resecado de tres centros sin estadio ni contexto metastasico; la accion que da sentido al biomarcador (inmunoterapia en MSI-H metastasico/neoadyuvante) exige un contexto que la cohorte no garantiza, y no hay resultados por contexto.

title: Baseline hepatobiliary MRI for predicting chemotherapeutic response and prognosis in initially unresectable colorectal cancer liver metastases.
rationale_c1: Two-hospital unresectable CRLM series n=85 pooled with 5-fold CV; no locked external hospital test.
rationale_c2: Baseline hepatobiliary MRI SI/radiomics with RECIST chemo response and PFS appropriate.
rationale_c3: RECIST response and PFS available for included patients.
rationale_c4: Radiomics feature selection plus combined model on CV only; limited regimen confounder modeling.
rationale_c5: First-line systemic therapy after baseline MRI as described.
probast_rationale: Combined MRI model AUC 0.818 on CV; data-availability statement says no datasets generated/analysed—transparency weak.
appraisal_note: Two hospitals enrolled but analysis is pooled CV rather than site-held-out external validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: CRLM irresecable con RM hepatobiliar basal; accion declarada: identificar no respondedores para cambiar de esquema. Esquemas (XELOX/FOLFOX/FOLFIRI) y terapia dirigida estan reportados y se hacen analisis de subgrupo (Tabla 5); PFS es secundario.

title: Predicting response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy for colorectal liver metastasis using deep learning on prechemotherapy cross-sectional imaging.
rationale_c1: Single-center CRLM NAC imaging cohort (~95 with RECIST labels).
rationale_c2: Prechemotherapy cross-sectional DL predicting NAC RECIST response appropriate.
rationale_c3: Responders 57 vs non-responders 38; DLM AUC 0.77 vs clinical 0.41 reported.
rationale_c4: DL without locked clinical confounders; train/test split only, no external site.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (±biologics) delivered as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Pre-NAC DLM AUC 0.77; single-center and no external validation keep analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Data available on request per statement; clinical risk model AUC 0.41 underscores imaging value.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC pre-quimioterapia y aprendizaje profundo para identificar mala respuesta a quimioterapia neoadyuvante en metástasis hepáticas; informa decisión quirúrgica y discusión riesgo-beneficio. | NOTA: H4 por autodeclaración (criterio único)

title: Machine Learning Predicts Oxaliplatin Benefit in Early Colon Cancer.
rationale_c1: NSABP C-07/C-08 phase III transcriptomic cohorts; highly relevant early CC adjuvant population.
rationale_c2: COLOXIS ML signature with randomized oxaliplatin benefit (interaction on RFS) fit-for-purpose.
rationale_c3: RFS/OS endpoints complete for 1065 analyzed patients with usable arrays.
rationale_c4: Predictive interaction tested across pooled trial arms; treatment randomized within signature strata.
rationale_c5: Adjuvant FULV vs FOLFOX delivered under trial protocols.
criteria_note: MMAT non-randomized (Hong 2018); predictive biomarker analysis of RCTs.
probast_rationale: Strong RCT-based predictive interaction (int P=0.024); residual analysis uncertainty from signature development on overlapping trial transcriptomes and need for further independent evaluation.
appraisal_note: Standout adjuvant oxaliplatin-sparing DSS candidate; authors still warrant further evaluation.
applicability_v2_rationale: COLOXIS usa perfil de expresión génica del tumor (arrays DASL de >24 000 genes en FFPE) para predecir beneficio de oxaliplatino adyuvante; transcriptoma completo no obtenible en práctica rutinaria al decidir.

title: A multiomics analysis-assisted deep learning model identifies a macrophage-oriented module as a potential therapeutic target in colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Multiomics CRC cohorts with mIHC train/test (181/45) plus public sets; selected tertiary samples.
rationale_c2: CCIM macrophage module DL with chemo response and survival endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Chemo response and prognosis labels reported across training/testing/external sets.
rationale_c4: Deep CCIM-Net AUC 0.99 and multiomics mining inflate overfitting concern.
rationale_c5: Chemotherapy and tissue assays applied as cohort protocols describe.
probast_rationale: Complex multiomics selection; module needs tissue/mIHC; chemo response clear; analysis high ROB despite external testing.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept; content is macrophage-oriented chemo stratification plus therapeutic target biology.
applicability_v2_rationale: Núcleo es descubrimiento de módulo celular FOLR2+ con scRNA-seq, mIHC y ratón; nexo terapéutico en modelo murino e in silico. H4(b) y (c).

title: An automated deep learning pipeline for EMVI classification and response prediction of rectal cancer using baseline MRI: a multi-centre study.
rationale_c1: Nine-centre rectal MRI cohort n=509 with external validation addresses EMVI/CR prediction population.
rationale_c2: Baseline DWI/T2 nnUNet features with EMVI status and complete-response endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Internal CV and external validation AUCs reported for both EMVI and CR tasks.
rationale_c4: Automated multi-level MLNet with external generalization similar to internal; outperforms baselines.
rationale_c5: CRT pathways and MRI staging protocols applied across centres as described.
probast_rationale: Multi-centre with genuine external; baseline MRI predictors; EMVI/CR defined; residual DL analysis uncertainty despite stable external AUCs.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept; content is baseline MRI EMVI classification plus CR prediction. Code github.com/Liiiii2101/MLNet; private imaging on request.
applicability_v2_rationale: Lectura low: RM basal en LARC con CRT larga uniforme, CR (pCR o cCR >2 anos) 'ayuda a determinar planes de tratamiento' y el resumen dice que el pipeline 'tiene potencial para uso clinico'. Lectura high: la tarea principal EMVI es solo pronostica (H6) y los autores admiten que sensibilidad 0.61/VPP 0.44 en CR 'impide la implementacion en el flujo clinico' (H4). GAP: paper de dos tareas con aplicabilidad distinta. BORDERLINE.

title: Deep radiomics-based fusion model for prediction of bevacizumab treatment response and outcome in patients with colorectal cancer liver metastases: a multicentre cohort study.
rationale_c1: BECOME-derived plus independent Chinese MDT cohorts of unresectable CRLM on FOLFOX±bevacizumab match deep radiomics response aim.
rationale_c2: Multicentre training/internal/external sites with negative chemo-alone control; target RAS-mutant conversion population.
rationale_c3: Baseline PET/CT DNN features, LASSO clinical factors, biopsy IHC; RECIST ORR by MDT plus PFS/OS.
rationale_c4: 307 patients across cohorts with efficacy and survival endpoints reported including external n=102.
rationale_c5: Negative validation arm (chemo alone) and clinical covariates support specificity to bevacizumab exposure.
probast_rationale: PET/colonoscopy and RAS-mutant enrichment; baseline multimodal predictors available pre-bevacizumab; RECIST/MDT outcome clear; genuine external validation but high-dim DNN with train–external AUC gap leaves analysis residual uncertainty.
appraisal_note: DERBY+ external AUC 0.83 with chemo-alone negative control AUC ~0.53–0.58; datasets from corresponding author on request.
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelo PET/CT basal, clínica e IHQ de biopsia para predecir respuesta a bevacizumab en CRLM irresecable RAS-mutado (FOLFOX); decisión explícita, predictores pretratamiento, contexto metastásico correcto.

title: PAIP 2020: Microsatellite instability prediction in colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: PAIP2020 multi-institutional WSI challenge cohort; case-mix vs routine CRC unclear.
rationale_c2: Pathology WSIs with MSI labels for challenge Task prediction appropriate.
rationale_c3: Challenge test WSIs scored with aggregated F1 and expert review.
rationale_c4: Many competing DL pipelines; challenge ranking ≠ clinical confounder control.
rationale_c5: Pathologic MSI reference standards applied as challenge protocol.
probast_rationale: Challenge held-out evaluation stronger than typical radiomics; still not a locked clinical DSS study.
appraisal_note: MSI prediction actionable for immunotherapy selection; challenge methods paper.
applicability_v2_rationale: Desafío PAIP 2020: clasificación MSI-H/MSS en láminas; MSI 'important for identifying the appropriate treatment protocol'; prueba aplicable a todos los estadios. Sin regla H.

title: Association of collagen deep learning classifier with prognosis and chemotherapy benefits in stage II-III colon cancer.
rationale_c1: Dual-center stage II-III CC cohort (n=882) with clear inclusion/exclusion after R0 resection.
rationale_c2: Multiphoton collagen imaging with ResNet50 and Cox/nomogram survival metrics match prognostic and chemo-benefit aims.
rationale_c3: Complete clinicopathologic and follow-up data required for inclusion; median DFS/OS reported across cohorts.
rationale_c4: Multivariable Cox for prognosis; adjuvant chemo benefit is observational interaction without formal confounding control.
rationale_c5: Fixed ResNet50 cut-off from training applied uniformly to internal and external validation cohorts.
criteria_note: MMAT non_randomized (retrospective dual-center prognostic DL cohort).
probast_rationale: External validation present; outcome blinding to DL score not stated; chemo-benefit analysis exploratory.
appraisal_note: CollagenDL informs adjuvant chemo selection in stage II-III CC; multiphoton imaging may limit routine deployability.
applicability_v2_rationale: Beneficio de quimio adyuvante en estadio II-III sin medir MSI/MMR: "MSI is very important for the chemotherapy response; this study did not test MSI". Predictor por imagen multifotónica en corte seriado, no rutinario.

title: Tumor-infiltrating immune cells based TMEscore and related gene signature is associated with the survival of CRC patients and response to fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy.
rationale_c1: Public CRC gene cohorts on fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy; sampling beyond repositories unclear.
rationale_c2: TIIC-based TMEscore and related gene signature vs chemo response/survival.
rationale_c3: Associations reported but cohort completeness/missingness incompletely detailed in text.
rationale_c4: Clustered TIIC fractions then ML gene signature without locked external clinical confounders.
rationale_c5: Fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy exposure in source cohorts as described.
probast_rationale: TMEscore gene signature for chemo response/survival; public-data analysis ROB high with unclear outcome ascertainment.
appraisal_note: Axis other; prognostic/chemo-response TMEscore rather than imaging radiomics.
applicability_v2_rationale: Analisis bioinformatico de bases GEO/TCGA (CIBERSORT, DEG, GSVA, IC50 pRRophetic in silico); el nucleo es descubrimiento/mecanismo y la evidencia terapeutica es in silico; el paper dice que el valor clinico 'esta por determinar'. Ademas mezcla estadios fuera del conjunto metastasico.

title: Gene-Mutation-Based Algorithm for Prediction of Treatment Response in Colorectal Cancer Patients.
rationale_c1: MSK training (n=471) and TCGA validation (n=221) public genomic cohorts address treatment-response prediction.
rationale_c2: 7-gene mutation algorithm vs progression after treatment and PFS is clinically relevant for systemic therapy.
rationale_c3: Progression/PFS endpoints reported in MSK and TCGA cohorts.
rationale_c4: Random-forest gene search with very high AUCs (0.97–0.98) raises residual overfitting/case-mix concerns despite TCGA check.
rationale_c5: Treatments as recorded in MSK/TCGA metadata; exposure not experimentally controlled.
probast_rationale: Mutation-based progression classifier on public cohorts; outcome ascertainment and treatment heterogeneity across MSK/TCGA unclear; near-perfect AUCs inflate analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Axis other; gene-mutation algorithm for mCRC treatment response/progression rather than imaging radiomics.
applicability_v2_rationale: Cohorte MSK (irresecable, quimioterapia de primera línea) mezclada con TCGA (89% sin metástasis, 1% adyuvancia); la respuesta es progresión sin tratamiento específico ni interacción terapéutica (H6) y contextos no equivalentes (H1).

title: Comprehensive Analysis of Microsatellite-Related Transcriptomic Signature and Identify Its Clinical Value in Colon Cancer.
rationale_c1: Public transcriptomic colon cohorts (TCGA-linked); not clinical population sample.
rationale_c2: MSRS from DEGs with MSI/immuno/cisplatin-response associations appropriate to aims.
rationale_c3: Survival and response-related metrics reported for training/testing partitions.
rationale_c4: LASSO Cox on high-dim DEGs; cisplatin/immuno AUCs modest with residual confounding.
rationale_c5: Treatment exposures inferred from public clinical annotations as available.
probast_rationale: MSRS mainly MSI/prognosis signature; therapy-response AUCs weak (e.g. cisplatin AUC~0.55).
appraisal_note: Kept applies_prediction=yes per corpus rule; applicability unclear given weak therapeutic metrics.
applicability_v2_rationale: Nucleo bioinformatico de descubrimiento; el nexo terapeutico (inmunoterapia, cisplatino) es in silico (TIDE, pRRophetic) y el desenlace principal es la supervivencia global (pronostico).

title: Histopathologic and Molecular Biomarkers of PD-1/PD-L1 Inhibitor Treatment Response among Patients with Microsatellite Instability‒High Colon Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center MSI-H CRC immunotherapy n=27 responders/non-responders; not representative.
rationale_c2: Histopathologic/molecular features with PD-1/PD-L1 response appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response labels for 27 patients; LOOCV probabilities reported.
rationale_c4: RF on tiny n with LOOCV; extreme overfitting/EPV failure.
rationale_c5: PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor treatment delivered as clinical practice for included patients.
probast_rationale: Actionable MSI-H IO response prediction but tiny sample and LOOCV make ROB high.
appraisal_note: biomarker_actionable axis; exploratory multipanel biomarkers including PRAME.

title: Identifying Cell Type-Specific Chemokine Correlates with Hierarchical Signal Extraction from Single-Cell Transcriptomes.
rationale_c1: Public single-cell CRC datasets for method development; not a clinical decision cohort.
rationale_c2: SCIONN chemokine signal extraction with cell-type association metrics fit methods aims.
rationale_c3: Held-out/external scRNA metrics reported but no clinical therapeutic outcome cohort.
rationale_c4: Neural method comparison without clinical confounder framework.
rationale_c5: No clinical intervention exposure pathway for CRC treatment decisions.
probast_rationale: Methods paper; no therapeutic-decision outcome model; single-cell correlates only.
appraisal_note: Applies prediction per corpus default with high applicability concern; github.com/chsher/SCIONN; not a bedside CRC therapy model.
applicability_v2_rationale: Desarrollo de método y descubrimiento de correlatos de quimiocinas, generando hipótesis; respuesta a ICI en múltiples tejidos sin resultados de CCR separables (H7).

title: Magnetic resonance imaging-radiomics evaluation of response to chemotherapy for synchronous liver metastasis of colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center Zhejiang SLM CRC n=102 patients/223 lesions; not population-sampled.
rationale_c2: MRI radiomics (±CA19-9/cN nomogram) with chemo DR vs non-DR labels appropriate.
rationale_c3: Lesion-level train/validation AUCs 0.733/0.753 and nomogram AUC 0.809 reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO radiomics with lesion-level splitting; limited patient-level external lock and EPV concerns.
rationale_c5: Chemotherapy regimens administered as recorded for included SLM patients.
probast_rationale: Single-center SLM; baseline MRI predictors; RECIST-like DR definition; internal lesion split only.
appraisal_note: Axis metastatic_systemic; radiomics-clinical nomogram claimed superior; data/code from corresponding author.
applicability_v2_rationale: RM basal (más CA19-9 y N clínico) para predecir respuesta a mFOLFOX7 en metástasis hepáticas sincrónicas; sirve para seleccionar pacientes que reciben quimioterapia. Delta-radiómica es solo exploratoria.

title: Treatment response prediction using MRI-based pre-, post-, and delta-radiomic features and machine learning algorithms in colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Two-center LARC n=53 (36+17); small and selected.
rationale_c2: Pre/post/delta T2 radiomics predicting nCRT treatment response.
rationale_c3: Response labels with train and external AUC metrics reported.
rationale_c4: 96 features with MRMR and multiple classifiers on tiny samples.
rationale_c5: nCRT completed with pre/post MRI timing as specified.
probast_rationale: External n=17 helpful but underpowered; delta features require post-nCRT MRI.
appraisal_note: ComBat harmonization used across centers; still high analysis ROB.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predicción de respuesta (TRG) con radiómica RM pre, post y delta en LARC; el paper solo dice que sirve para "personalizing cancer treatments" sin precisar qué decisión informa; uso terapéutico solo implícito.

title: Development and validation of magnetic resonance imaging-based radiomics models for preoperative prediction of microsatellite instability in rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-pathway rectal cancer MRI MSI series (n=491; MSI 10.4%); external sites absent.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment MRI radiomics+clinical XGBoost for pathologically confirmed MSI.
rationale_c3: Random 327/164 split with combined-model validation AUC 0.895 reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO then XGBoost on imbalanced MSI; internal split only with optimism risk.
rationale_c5: Preoperative MRI and MSI testing applied uniformly as described.
probast_rationale: Internal-only MRI MSI model with class imbalance; high analysis ROB despite strong validation AUC.
appraisal_note: Combined clinical-radiomics outperformed radiomics-only; actionable MSI triage intent.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiomics de MRI para MSI en recto, "personalized therapy selection"; cohorte T1-T4 sin estadio ni M. MSI informa adyuvancia en estadio II o inmunoterapia, contextos distintos no separados.

title: Multi-modal radiomics model to predict treatment response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy for locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center West China LARC series n=118 with random 70/48 split only.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment multimodal CT+MRI radiomics with pathologic response after neoadjuvant chemotherapy appropriate.
rationale_c3: Pathologic response labels complete for train/validation sets.
rationale_c4: Hundreds of radiomic features with LASSO/mRMR and internal split; optimism likely.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy and imaging protocols as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Clinical-radiomics nomogram validation AUC 0.93 on internal split without external site; high-dim multimodal mining.
appraisal_note: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (not CRT) setting; still therapeutic-response prediction for LARC.

title: Deep learning-based radiomic features for improving neoadjuvant chemoradiation response prediction in locally advanced rectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-institution LARC DWI series n=43.
rationale_c2: DL-based radiomic features from pre-nCRT DWI predicting pCR appropriate.
rationale_c3: pCR labels with repeated stratified 4-fold CV AUCs (mean 0.73) reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO-logistic on DL features with CV only; small N overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: Concurrent capecitabine CRT then TME as institutional standard.
probast_rationale: DL-radiomic mean AUC 0.73 under CV; no external validation.
appraisal_note: DL features outperformed handcrafted radiomics on same small cohort.
applicability_v2_rationale: Estudio 'preliminar' de 43 pacientes cuyo objetivo es comparar caracteristicas radiomicas clasicas vs de aprendizaje profundo (VGG19 preentrenada), no ofrecer una herramienta aplicable; desenlace GR evaluado por patologia, RM o colonoscopia segun el caso. BORDERLINE: se declara preliminar, no desplegable explicitamente.

title: FOLFOX treatment response prediction in metastatic or recurrent colorectal cancer patients via machine learning algorithms.
rationale_c1: Microarray meta-analysis of metastatic/recurrent CRC FOLFOX sensitivity; public-array case-mix unclear.
rationale_c2: Gene-expression ML classifiers for FOLFOX response appropriate to systemic selection.
rationale_c3: Response definitions pooled across heterogeneous GEO-like datasets; completeness uneven.
rationale_c4: Cross-validated SVM/RF/NN on meta-DE genes; AUC ~0.68 and no prospective clinical lock.
rationale_c5: FOLFOX exposure inferred from source studies as labeled.
probast_rationale: In-silico/meta-array FOLFOX response ML; high ROB from dataset heterogeneity and weak discrimination.
appraisal_note: metastatic_systemic axis; early identification of FOLFOX-sensitive mCRC.

title: Predicting Clinical Outcomes in Colorectal Cancer Using Machine Learning.
rationale_c1: CRC gene+clinical feature set from prior prospective study; cohort sampling unclear in short report.
rationale_c2: ML models for survival/DFS/relapse with gene and clinical inputs match aims.
rationale_c3: C-index/accuracy on test splits reported but outcome ascertainment thinly described.
rationale_c4: Multiple learners compared without clear external clinical validation or confounder lock.
rationale_c5: Treatment pathways underlying outcomes incompletely specified in brief format.
probast_rationale: Short conference paper; prognosis models may inform adjuvant decisions but reporting thin.
appraisal_note: Stud Health Technol Inform short format limits TRIPOD completeness; C-index up to ~0.86–0.87 on test.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice respuesta a RT-QT con expresión génica RT-qPCR de tumores ya resecados: 'patients who had a tumor resection', predictor posterior al momento de decidir neoadyuvancia. Mezcla colon/recto y estadios I-IV.

title: Urine metabolomics as a predictor of patient tolerance and response to adjuvant chemotherapy in colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Alberta multi-hospital stage III–IV CRC urine bank n=91 chart review; selected tissue-bank survivors.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment urine metabolomics with chemo adverse events/response/survival endpoints match aims.
rationale_c3: Chart-derived AE and survival completeness uneven; short report limits ascertainment detail.
rationale_c4: Multiple ML algorithms×preprocessing on small n via 10-fold CV; AUCs often near chance.
rationale_c5: Heterogeneous adjuvant regimens; exposure-as-intended hard to verify from brief methods.
probast_rationale: Small retrospective metabolomics; urine pretreatment OK in principle; AE/response definitions thin; CV-only weak performance.
appraisal_note: Axis adjuvant_risk; early metabolomics pilot with limited discrimination—still prediction-framed.
applicability_v2_rationale: Estadios III y IV mezclados, incluye 17 sin quimioterapia, resultados no separados; supervivencia/recurrencia sin nexo; metabolómica urinaria RMN 600 MHz no rutinaria.

title: Development and validation of a multivariable CT-based Delta-radiomics model for predicting efficacy to bevacizumab therapy in patients with colorectal liver metastases.
rationale_c1: Three-institution CRLM bevacizumab series n=90; metastatic referral mix.
rationale_c2: Baseline and 2-month CT delta-radiomics predicting 6-month RECIST response.
rationale_c3: Lesion- and patient-level response plus OS analyses reported.
rationale_c4: High-dim temporal texture features with multiple LR models; overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: Bevacizumab-combined chemotherapy delivered across sites as described.
probast_rationale: Multicenter delta-radiomics; predictors need 2-month on-treatment CT (early mid-course use).
appraisal_note: Ratio/Delta/COMB models AUCs high in training; external performance mixed.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica delta basal y 2 meses para predecir eficacia a 6 meses de bevacizumab en CRLM metastásico y refinar tratamiento; predictores disponibles en el punto de decisión; sin autodeclaración exploratoria.

title: Assessment of Large Language Models in Colorectal Cancer Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Decision-Making: A Retrospective Single-Center Comparison of Guideline-Integrated General-Purpose vs. Domain-Specialized Models.
rationale_c1: 300 consecutive adult CRC cases from a tertiary MTB (2022–2025) with standardized case packages.
rationale_c2: Paired LLM vs MTB concordance (weighted kappa, accuracy, F1) plus blinded three-tier safety adjudication.
rationale_c3: All 300 cases evaluated for both models; concordance and safety fully reported.
rationale_c4: Predefined knowledge asymmetry (Gemini with NCI guidelines vs MedGemma without retrieval) confounds fair model comparison.
rationale_c5: Identical standardized prompts and case inputs; separate sessions; temperatures predefined.
criteria_note: MMAT non_randomized (retrospective comparative LLM vs MTB concordance study).
probast_rationale: Off-the-shelf LLMs as DSS; asymmetric guideline augmentation; single-center MTB reference; no discrimination CIs.
appraisal_note: LLM concordance/DSS appraisal (not classical model development); Gemini guideline-integrated vs MedGemma alone by design.
applicability_v2_rationale: LLM frente a decisiones reales de tumor board en CCR, decision terapeutica explicita. Contextos mixtos (adyuvante, neoadyuvante, metastasico, recurrente) pero resultados por escenario (Tabla 5). Sin H aplicable.

title: Comprehensive machine learning analysis of a radiomics-based model for predicting microsatellite instability in right Colon Cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center right colon cancer CT series (n=247; 43 dMMR); representativeness unclear.
rationale_c2: Preoperative CECT radiomics+clinicopathology for dMMR/MSI-H status.
rationale_c3: 70/30 train/test metrics across multiple ML classifiers reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO plus multi-algorithm ML without external validation.
rationale_c5: Radical resection pathway with preoperative CT as described.
probast_rationale: Right-colon MSI CT radiomics; internal split and multi-model comparison drive high analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: Focus on right colon dMMR enrichment; immunotherapy decision support framing.
applicability_v2_rationale: Se presenta como herramienta 'preoperative decision-making' pero incluye pN, pM, pTNM, tipo histológico y diferenciación (posoperatorios) como predictores; no disponibles al momento de la decisión.

title: dMMR prediction from colorectal cancer histopathology: Leveraging non-tumor and low-magnification regions.
rationale_c1: Large multi-country WSI development with two independent external cohorts (1010 and 457 WSIs).
rationale_c2: Histopathology foundation-model embeddings for dMMR vs pMMR match actionable biomarker prediction.
rationale_c3: dMMR labels and external performance (F1 ~0.92–0.93) reported.
rationale_c4: Multiple DL configurations screened; residual optimism possible despite strong external metrics.
rationale_c5: Routine H&E WSIs as intended clinical input; labels from standard MMR testing.
probast_rationale: Strong multi-cohort external dMMR prediction from H&E including non-tumor/low-mag regions; residual analysis uncertainty from many architecture variants.
appraisal_note: Among stronger biomarker models in batch-02; GitHub tooling referenced (StainTools).
applicability_v2_rationale: dMMR desde H&E en CCR estadios I-IV, 'critical for guiding treatment' (inmunoterapia); H&E disponible al momento del testeo. Sin H ni U.

title: Clinical implementation of an AI-based prediction model for decision support for patients undergoing colorectal cancer surgery.
rationale_c1: Nationwide DCCG development (n=18403), local external validation (RCC n=806), and prospective implementation (PCC n=194).
rationale_c2: LASSO logistic 1-year mortality model with risk-bundled perioperative interventions and CCI/complication outcomes.
rationale_c3: Historical RCC vs prospective PCC may differ in complication ascertainment (chart review vs routine care).
rationale_c4: Nonrandomized before/after design; multivariable adjustment for risk group but residual temporal confounding likely.
rationale_c5: Clinical deployment described; clinician-model risk-group agreement high (kappa 0.926) with few overrides.
criteria_note: MMAT non_randomized (prediction development plus before/after implementation cohort).
probast_rationale: Strong model development/validation (AUROC ~0.79 external); implementation benefit inferred from nonrandomized before/after.
appraisal_note: Axis llm_dss but model is registry LASSO DSS (not LLM); PROBAST RoB low for prediction; MMAT lower due to before/after confounding.
applicability_v2_rationale: Modelo con datos de registro preoperatorios, riesgo de mortalidad a 1 año, que define intensidad de intervenciones perioperatorias; implementado en práctica clínica en cirugía electiva de CCR. | NOTA: H4 por autodeclaración (criterio único)

title: Deepath-MSI: a clinic-ready deep learning model for microsatellite instability detection in colorectal cancer using whole-slide imaging.
rationale_c1: Large multi-center Chinese+TCGA WSI MSI cohorts (N~5070); still referral/pathology archives.
rationale_c2: Deepath-MSI on routine H&E WSI for MSI status (actionable therapy gate) appropriate.
rationale_c3: MSI labels and real-world validation sensitivity/specificity (~95%/91%) reported.
rationale_c4: Clinic-ready locked thresholds with large independent/real-world testing limit confounding.
rationale_c5: Histopathology workflows as clinical standard; MSI assays as reference.
probast_rationale: Strong multicenter MSI detector (AUROC~0.98); residual ROB from retrospective development/site shifts.
appraisal_note: Actionable MSI pathway assay surrogate; not a treatment-response regressor but DSS-relevant.
applicability_v2_rationale: Deepath-MSI detecta MSI en H&E de resecciones de CCR de todo estadio; la acción (inmunoterapia, "MSI is crucial for immunotherapy selection") exige contexto metastásico/neoadyuvante que la cohorte no garantiza ni separa.

title: Utilizing intratumoral and peritumoral ultrasound radiomics for predicting KRAS gene mutation status in rectal cancer patients.
rationale_c1: Single-institution Fujian ultrasound rectal cancer series n=278.
rationale_c2: Intra/peritumoral US radiomics for KRAS mutation status appropriate to targeted therapy triage.
rationale_c3: KRAS labels for random 7:3 train/test split.
rationale_c4: Radiomics+ML with CV on single center; no external validation.
rationale_c5: Ultrasound and pathology genotyping performed as described.
probast_rationale: Single-center KRAS US radiomics; internal test AUC ~0.80 range; analysis ROB high.
appraisal_note: Authors call for multicenter external validation.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiomics ecográfica para KRAS en cáncer rectal resecado (T1-T4, sin estado M) para "clinical targeted therapy selection"; anti-EGFR exige contexto metastásico que la cohorte no garantiza.

title: Leveraging automated machine learning to predict colon cancer prognosis from clinical features and risk groups: a retrospective cohort study.
rationale_c1: Large SNUH colon cancer resection cohort with independent test and multi-set checks.
rationale_c2: AutoML/XGBoost on clinical/path/blood features for recurrence prognosis appropriate.
rationale_c3: Recurrence/prognosis labels reported for train 2426 and test 615.
rationale_c4: AutoML vs manual models; residual optimism though independent test AUC 0.798.
rationale_c5: Curative resection and adjuvant pathways as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Large single-system Korean data; preoperative/clinical predictors; recurrence outcome clear; AutoML analysis residual uncertainty.
appraisal_note: Adjuvant_risk AutoML; PINI and blood indices highlighted; H2O AutoML referenced.
applicability_v2_rationale: AutoML en cáncer de colon resecado con variables clínicas, patológicas y sanguíneas para pronóstico y beneficio de quimioterapia adyuvante (análisis IIA); predictores disponibles al decidir adyuvancia.

title: Single-cell and bulk transcriptome analyses reveal elevated amino acid metabolism promoting tumor-directed immune evasion in colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Public scRNA/bulk CRC cohorts (GSE/TCGA) enriched for IO-annotated subsets; not consecutive clinical sampling.
rationale_c2: AA metabolism score and 6-gene risk score with PD-1 response/prognosis/drug-sensitivity endpoints fit biomarker aims.
rationale_c3: Survival and checkpoint correlations reported across TCGA train/test and GSE39582.
rationale_c4: DEG∩MSigDB then LASSO/Cox multi-cohort mining without locked clinical confounder model.
rationale_c5: PD-1 exposure and treatments heterogeneous across public datasets; fidelity unclear.
probast_rationale: Omics discovery linking AA metabolism to PD-1 resistance plus bulk risk score; prognostic/drug-sensitivity more than locked therapeutic DSS.
appraisal_note: Axis biomarker_actionable; applies_prediction=yes for AA/IO risk score; GEO/TCGA public transparency.
applicability_v2_rationale: Núcleo mecanístico: puntaje de metabolismo de aminoácidos en scRNA-seq y co-cultivo con líneas murinas; evidencia terapéutica in silico y en líneas celulares. H4(b) y (c).

title: CAN-Scan: A multi-omic phenotype-driven precision oncology platform identifies prognostic biomarkers of therapy response for colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: PDC laboratory platform plus clinical cohorts; selection into PDC unclear.
rationale_c2: Multi-omic ML linking PDC drug response to molecular signatures and clinical outcomes.
rationale_c3: Clinical-cohort response/prognosis evaluations across stated cohorts reported.
rationale_c4: Complex multi-modal ML and many candidate biomarkers without single locked model.
rationale_c5: In vitro Cmax screens vs real-world regimen fidelity incompletely mapped.
probast_rationale: Phenotype-driven PDC platform with clinical translation; applicability to bedside CRC therapy decisions unclear.
appraisal_note: GEO GSE287956 deposited; strong transparency relative to typical radiomics papers.
applicability_v2_rationale: Plataforma de descubrimiento de biomarcadores y firmas con evidencia terapéutica principal en células primarias derivadas de pacientes y cribado farmacológico in vitro (H4 b, c); además mezcla OSCC/HCC.

title: Machine learning model predicting factors for incisional infection following right hemicolectomy for colon cancer.
rationale_c1: Single-center right hemicolectomy series (n=322); surgical-population transportability unclear.
rationale_c2: Clinical peri-op factors with ML for postoperative incisional infection are appropriate.
rationale_c3: 7:3 train/test ROC-AUC/F1 for DL/RF/SVM/logistic reported.
rationale_c4: Multiple competing ML/DL models without external validation or strong confounding control.
rationale_c5: Right hemicolectomy operative pathway as described.
probast_rationale: Incisional-infection risk model after colectomy; limited therapy-selection nexus and internal-only ML analysis.
appraisal_note: Axis other; surgical complication DSS rather than oncologic therapy response model.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice infeccion de herida tras hemicolectomia derecha para decisiones preoperatorias, pero los predictores incluyen tiempo operatorio, sutura de cierre y abordaje, intra o posoperatorios. Sin nexo oncologico.

title: Habitat-based radiomics analysis for evaluating immediate response in colorectal cancer lung metastases treated by radiofrequency ablation.
rationale_c1: Single-center CRC lung-metastasis RFA series (515 lesions/233 patients); transportability unknown.
rationale_c2: Intraoperative CT habitat/peritumoral radiomics for immediate complete ablation response fit interventional decision support.
rationale_c3: Immediate response labels for 412/515 complete responses reported in train/test.
rationale_c4: High-dim habitat radiomics LASSO with single-center 4:1 split only.
rationale_c5: RFA procedures and CT acquisition as institutional protocol.
probast_rationale: Immediate post-RFA CT habitat model (test AUC 0.870); predictors/outcome tied to ablation session rather than systemic therapy selection—applicability to core AICRC_TX PCC partial.
appraisal_note: Axis other; interventional RFA response rather than nCRT/systemic decision—flagged for applicability.

title: A computed tomography-based multitask deep learning model for predicting tumour stroma ratio and treatment outcomes in patients with colorectal cancer: a multicentre cohort study.
rationale_c1: Multicentre CRC CT cohorts (train 956 / IVC 240 / EVC1–3); tertiary Chinese centers.
rationale_c2: Multitask DL for TSR plus OS and adjuvant chemotherapy benefit appropriate.
rationale_c3: TSR/OS/chemo-interaction outcomes reported across internal and three external cohorts.
rationale_c4: Large locked external validations and survival models with stage context.
rationale_c5: Surgery±adjuvant chemotherapy delivered per collaborating-center practice.
probast_rationale: MDL4TSR multitask model with multicentre external sets; outcome mixes TSR biomarker and chemo benefit.
appraisal_note: Code on GitHub WuLei-MedIA/MDL4TSR_Survival; axis other (TSR multitask + adjuvant selection).
applicability_v2_rationale: TC preoperatoria en CCR resecado para predecir TSR y SG, y beneficio de quimioterapia adyuvante en estadio II y III por separado (interacción analizada); nexo terapéutico explícito.

title: Identifying Genetic Mutation Status in Patients with Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastases Using Radiomics-Based Machine-Learning Models.
rationale_c1: CAIRO5 trial CRLM CT radiomics discovery n=255 and external n=129; trial-selected unresectable CRLM.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT radiomics for KRAS mutation to guide systemic therapy appropriate.
rationale_c3: KRAS status available in discovery and external validation cohorts.
rationale_c4: Internal AUCs up to 0.86 but external validation performed poorly—optimism/generalizability failure.
rationale_c5: Systemic therapy under CAIRO5 protocols as intended.
probast_rationale: External validation failure is informative; analysis ROB high despite multicenter trial imaging.
appraisal_note: Negative external result for KRAS radiomics on CRLM CT.
applicability_v2_rationale: CRLM (contexto metastásico garantizado); estado KRAS por TC para selección de tratamiento. Fallo en validación externa va a análisis (H5), no aplicabilidad.

title: Investigating the Feasibility of Predicting KRAS Status, Tumor Staging, and Extramural Venous Invasion in Colorectal Cancer Using Inter-Platform Magnetic Resonance Imaging Radiomic Features.
rationale_c1: Single-center Saudi multi-platform MRI CRC n≈60; feasibility sample.
rationale_c2: Inter-platform radiomics for KRAS/stage/EMVI prediction fits biomarker aims.
rationale_c3: KRAS and staging labels reported for train/test scanner groups.
rationale_c4: Small n with scanner-split testing; modest AUC ~0.68 and high overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: MRI acquisition across platforms applied as described for included patients.
probast_rationale: Tiny single-center; pretreatment MRI OK; KRAS/stage/EMVI defined; inter-platform test still underpowered.
appraisal_note: Feasibility inter-platform study; data in article/supplement per authors.

title: CT-based deep learning model for the prediction of DNA mismatch repair deficient colorectal cancer: a diagnostic study.
rationale_c1: Two-institution CRC CT DL for dMMR n=1812 with external validation addresses actionable MMR screening population.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment CT ResNet101+GPR with IHC/PCR MMR labels appropriate for treatment stratification.
rationale_c3: Internal n=482 and external n=206 validation AUCs 0.986/0.915 fully reported with subgroup analyses.
rationale_c4: Very high internal AUC raises optimism concern despite external hold; limited clinical covariate modeling.
rationale_c5: Standard pretreatment CT acquisition and MMR testing applied as described across sites.
probast_rationale: Large dual-institution with external; pretreatment CT available; MMR gold standard; residual analysis uncertainty from near-perfect internal AUC.
appraisal_note: Strong biomarker_actionable CT→dMMR tool; among better-validated batch entries.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC pretratamiento (≤2 semanas antes de cirugía) predice dMMR; el paper liga dMMR a quimioterapia adyuvante e inmunoterapia ("prior to surgery, chemotherapy, or immunotherapy"). Ninguna H clara.

title: Predicting Mismatch-Repair Status in Rectal Cancer Using Multiparametric MRI-Based Radiomics Models: A Preliminary Study.
rationale_c1: Two Shanghai hospitals (train/test + external); still tertiary RC imaging cohorts.
rationale_c2: Pretreatment multiparametric MRI radiomics predicting pathologic MMR status.
rationale_c3: MMR labels with train/test/external AUCs (~0.71–0.77) reported.
rationale_c4: LASSO radiomics mining despite external set; residual overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: Baseline MRI within 2 weeks of resection as eligibility required.
probast_rationale: External validation present but modest AUCs and high-dim MRI radiomics analysis ROB.
appraisal_note: MMR/MSI actionable biomarker axis; preliminary study framing.
applicability_v2_rationale: Se autodeclara estudio preliminar y piloto en título y resumen; además predice MMR, no una decisión terapéutica directa. H4(a).

title: Evaluation of stromal cell infiltration in the tumor microenvironment enable prediction of treatment sensitivity and prognosis in colon cancer.
rationale_c1: Five GEO colon sets (n=990) plus TCGA/SYSUCC/immunotherapy cohorts for SIIS validation.
rationale_c2: 31-gene stromal infiltration score vs adjuvant chemo benefit, recurrence, and drug resistance.
rationale_c3: Multi-cohort survival and chemo-interaction results reported including TCGA-COAD.
rationale_c4: ML-derived signature with multi-omics/CRISPR support; residual confounding in observational chemo-benefit.
rationale_c5: Adjuvant chemotherapy exposure analyzed as in source clinical annotations.
probast_rationale: Broad multi-cohort SIIS for adjuvant sensitivity; observational chemo-benefit and high-dim discovery keep ROB high.
appraisal_note: Axis adjuvant_risk; high-SIIS predicted lack of adjuvant chemo benefit.
applicability_v2_rationale: Firma SIIS de 31 genes para beneficio de quimioterapia adyuvante en colon con evidencia clínica retrospectiva; mecanismos CRISPR secundarios. Duda con H4(b) y H3 (transcriptoma); prevalece el predictor aplicable. | NOTA: lecturas discrepantes: 1ª high H4; 2ª (texto completo) low

title: A multitask dual-stream attention network for the identification of KRAS mutation in colorectal cancer.
rationale_c1: Small local T2 MRI CRC dataset with only 36 clinical cases for identification demonstration.
rationale_c2: Multitask dual-stream attention network for KRAS mutation status is actionable biomarker prediction.
rationale_c3: Mutation labels for development set described; external clinical case reporting limited (n=36).
rationale_c4: Deep multitask model on small labeled set with high reported AUC (~0.96) highly prone to overfitting.
rationale_c5: Pretreatment MRI acquisition as intended noninvasive KRAS surrogate input.
probast_rationale: KRAS identification from MRI is therapeutically relevant; tiny data and DL multitask design drive high ROB.
appraisal_note: Authors acknowledge small-dataset overfitting risk for deep models.

title: Development and validation of a weakly supervised deep learning framework to predict the status of molecular pathways and key mutations in colorectal cancer from routine histology images: a retrospective study.
rationale_c1: TCGA-CRC-DX development plus large international multicentre validation cohorts.
rationale_c2: Weakly supervised DL on routine H&E for MSI/pathways/key mutations appropriate.
rationale_c3: Molecular pathway/mutation labels with AUROCs across external cohorts reported.
rationale_c4: Large multicentre locked evaluation; iterative draw-and-rank training described.
rationale_c5: Routine histology and molecular assays as clinical reference standards.
probast_rationale: Lancet Digit Health multicentre molecular pathway predictor; residual ROB from weakly supervised training choices.
appraisal_note: Code available subject to IP constraints; actionable MSI/mutation DSS for CRC therapy selection.
applicability_v2_rationale: DL en H&E de TCGA (todos los estadios, primarios) para predecir MSI/KRAS/BRAF como alternativa a pruebas moleculares 'targeted therapies'; esos biomarcadores exigen contexto metastásico que la cohorte no garantiza.

title: Quantitative Prediction of Microsatellite Instability in Colorectal Cancer With Preoperative PET/CT-Based Radiomics.
rationale_c1: Single-center PET/CT cohort with only 13 MSI-H among 173 patients; severe class imbalance limits representativeness.
rationale_c2: Preoperative 18F-FDG PET/CT radiomics with IHC MMR (PCR confirmation if needed) appropriate for MSI prediction.
rationale_c3: MSI status available for all included patients; imaging and pathology outcomes reported.
rationale_c4: Random under-sampling and ensemble ML without clear clinical confounding adjustment beyond feature selection.
rationale_c5: Standardized PET/CT acquisition and blinded dual-physician ROI delineation applied across cohort.
probast_rationale: Very few MSI-H events; 2492 features with under-sampling and internal split only; AUC likely optimistic.
appraisal_note: Actionable MSI prediction for treatment selection; tiny MSI-H n is main RoB driver.
applicability_v2_rationale: Radiómica PET/CT preoperatoria predice MSI-H/MSS (IHQ) para apoyar tratamiento (inmunoterapia/adyuvancia); estadios I-IV, prueba estadio-agnóstica. Sin regla H.

title: Prediction of clinically actionable genetic alterations from colorectal cancer histopathology images using deep learning.
rationale_c1: TCGA CRC WSI development plus SMH external n=142; public/academic pathology mix.
rationale_c2: H&E DL classifiers for APC/KRAS/PIK3CA/SMAD4/TP53 actionable genes appropriate.
rationale_c3: Mutation labels for TCGA CV and external cohort reported.
rationale_c4: Patch-level DL with patient CV; modest AUCs and domain shift FFPE vs frozen.
rationale_c5: Resection pathology slides processed as described for included patients.
probast_rationale: External hospital cohort present; analysis ROB from WSI DL optimism and variable gene-wise AUC (concatenated FFPE AUC 0.645).
appraisal_note: biomarker_actionable histopathology DL for treatment-relevant mutations.
applicability_v2_rationale: Mutaciones APC/KRAS/PIK3CA/SMAD4/TP53 desde H&E; solo KRAS/PIK3CA tienen accion (anti-EGFR), que exige contexto metastasico no garantizado en TCGA/resecados. Tambien factibilidad autodeclarada.

title: A data-driven approach to a chemotherapy recommendation model based on deep learning for patients with colorectal cancer in Korea.
rationale_c1: Single Korean institution EMR chemo-recommendation CDSS development.
rationale_c2: DNN C3R recommending chemo regimens from clinical features is fit for CDSS aim.
rationale_c3: Regimen labels and classification metrics reported for train/test splits.
rationale_c4: Oversampling plus AUC 0.98 for matching historical regimens; circular outcome risk.
rationale_c5: Chemotherapy recording in EMR as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Single-center; EMR predictors available; outcome is regimen concordance not clinical benefit; analysis high ROB.
appraisal_note: C3R recommends historical chemo choice; not outcome-optimized effectiveness model.
applicability_v2_rationale: Entre las entradas hay supervivencia y recurrencia, posteriores a la decisión de quimioterapia (H3). Cohorte mezcla colon y recto y M0/M1 sin resultados separados (H1). Evidencia H1 indirecta.

title: Radiomics-based prediction of microsatellite instability in colorectal cancer at initial computed tomography evaluation.
rationale_c1: MSK stage II-III colon cancer resection cohort (n=198; 64 MSI) with stated image-quality exclusions.
rationale_c2: Blinded CT tumor segmentation, intensity radiomics, and IHC MMR labels appropriate for MSI prediction.
rationale_c3: MSI by IHC available for all analyzed patients; train/test performance fully reported.
rationale_c4: Random forest with age/location clinical covariates; limited explicit confounding framework beyond ML inputs.
rationale_c5: Retrospective multi-vendor CT acquisition accepted; segmentation protocol applied to included scans.
criteria_note: MMAT non_randomized (retrospective single-center CT radiomics cohort).
probast_rationale: Heterogeneous multi-vendor CT without harmonization; 40 radiomic features after filtering; internal holdout only.
appraisal_note: Preoperative CT MSI prediction for treatment selection; combined model test AUC 0.79 but low sensitivity.
applicability_v2_rationale: TC preoperatoria + edad/localización para predecir MSI en colon estadio II-III; decisión explícita: estratificar terapia neoadyuvante e inmunoterapia en MSI. Predictores preoperatorios.

title: Explainable, Lightweight Deep Learning for Colorectal Cancer Microsatellite Instability Screening in Low-Resource Settings
rationale_c1: Public histology MSI dataset only; not indigenous clinical consecutive cohort (authors note LMIC gap).
rationale_c2: Histology CNN/attention models with MSI vs MSS labels fit low-resource screening aim.
rationale_c3: Held-out test images with accuracy/AUROC and Grad-CAM explanations reported.
rationale_c4: Lightweight CNNs trained from scratch/pretrained on public tiles without clinical external cohort.
rationale_c5: Labelled public WSIs used as intended for MSI classification experiments.
probast_rationale: Public non-indigenous histology; WSI predictors available for screening; MSI labels; no clinical external validation for claimed LMIC use.
appraisal_note: medRxiv preprint; Zenodo public data; applicability unclear for real-world LMIC deployment despite stated intent.
applicability_v2_rationale: Predice MSI/MSS en parches H&E de TCGA (CCR de todo estadio sin datos clinicos) como cribado en entornos de bajos recursos; la accion terapeutica ligada al biomarcador (inmunoterapia) exige un contexto no garantizado por la cohorte. BORDERLINE: ademas es una comparacion de arquitecturas (H4) y el uso es de cribado diagnostico (U3 considerado).

title: CT4CMS: Preoperative Computed Tomography-Based Consensus Molecular Subtyping Prediction in Colorectal Cancer Using Interpretable Deep Learning
rationale_c1: Multi-cohort Chinese CRC CT series plus public CT datasets; discovery case-mix complex.
rationale_c2: Preoperative CT deep learning predicting CMS subtype with clinical analyses.
rationale_c3: Discovery/internal/external cohorts and AUCs reported for CMS classification.
rationale_c4: Transformer DL trained on transcriptomic CMS labels; overfitting and label-noise risks.
rationale_c5: Surgical/pathology pathways for CMS labeling as cohort protocols describe.
probast_rationale: CMS informs biology/therapy but direct treatment-decision link variable; medRxiv preprint.
appraisal_note: External Liaoning cohort; data available on request only.
applicability_v2_rationale: CMS desde TC preoperatoria; nexo terapéutico analizado: beneficio de quimio adyuvante en CMS4 por estadio II/III (Fig. S7-S12). Sin H ni U.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Triage of Microsatellite Instability Status in Colorectal Cancer from H&E-Stained Whole-Slide Images
rationale_c1: Public-archive train (1492 slides) plus five independent external cohorts (1094 slides) for MSI triage.
rationale_c2: Uncertainty-aware attention MIL on H&E WSI with MSI/MSS labels and reject option.
rationale_c3: External cohort sensitivities >97% on triaged subsets with coverage 59–78% reported.
rationale_c4: Ensemble uncertainty gating and multi-external lock limit residual confounding/optimism.
rationale_c5: Diagnostic H&E slides used as available at pathology workup.
probast_rationale: Strong multi-external uncertainty-aware MSI WSI triage; low ROB across PROBAST domains for this biomarker task.
appraisal_note: medRxiv preprint; public training/evaluation archives; clinically framed MSS triage with deferral of uncertain cases.
applicability_v2_rationale: Triage de MSI en WSI de piezas de resección de CCR sin estadio ni contexto metastasico/neoadyuvante; el biomarcador solo es accionable (inmunoterapia) en un contexto que la cohorte no garantiza y no se reportan resultados por contexto. BORDERLINE: el uso declarado es reducir pruebas confirmatorias (decision diagnostica), no terapeutica directa.

title: Can pre-treatment MRI and CT radiomics improve prediction of complete pathological response in locally advanced rectal cancer following neoadjuvant treatment?
rationale_c1: Single-institute preprint cohort n=150 with held-out validation after internal CV.
rationale_c2: Baseline T2W-MR and planning-CT radiomics plus clinical factors for pCR after neoadjuvant therapy appropriate.
rationale_c3: TRG1 pCR vs incomplete response labels complete for 150 patients.
rationale_c4: Multi-classifier radiomics with SMOTE and feature-selection competition; validation AUCs modest (best merged 0.72) with likely optimism from train metrics.
rationale_c5: Neoadjuvant treatment and imaging as institutional radiotherapy pathway.
probast_rationale: Preprint single-center radiomics; clinical+T2W merged validation AUC 0.72 without multi-center external lock.
appraisal_note: Research Square preprint (empty journal field in input); authors call for larger cohort validation before WW guidance.

title: Gradient Boosting Machine based prediction of chemotherapy response and role of p53 mutational and smoking status for progression free survival in metastatic colorectal cancer
rationale_c1: Single academic Turkish mCRC series n=101; preprint without journal peer review.
rationale_c2: LightGBM on clinical features for first-line chemo response and Cox for PFS appropriate.
rationale_c3: Best response and PFS reported; macro AUC 0.82 after tuning.
rationale_c4: GBM tuning on small single-center data without external validation; residual confounding.
rationale_c5: First-line chemotherapy (±bevacizumab context in PFS analyses) as institutional practice.
probast_rationale: Preprint LightGBM chemo-response model; no external validation and unclear response adjudication.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept per batch; content is metastatic chemo response/PFS (p53/smoking). ResearchSquare preprint.

title: Endoscopic Image-based Radiomics Classifiers for the Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy Response in Rectal Cancer Patients
rationale_c1: Single-center Japanese LARC endoscopy radiomics preprint n=90.
rationale_c2: Pre/post-CRT endoscopic radiomics for pCR/good response appropriate.
rationale_c3: Response labels for 90 patients after exclusions.
rationale_c4: Double CV only without external cohort; radiomics classifiers overfit-prone.
rationale_c5: NA-CRT then surgery completed for included patients.
probast_rationale: ResearchSquare preprint; double CV AUCs without external validation drive high ROB.
appraisal_note: Axis tox_surg kept per batch; content is endoscopic nCRT response prediction.
applicability_v2_rationale: Imágenes endoscópicas pre y post-CRT para predecir pCR/respuesta antes de cirugía; apoya watch-and-wait ("decision-making regarding the management"). Muestra pequeña va a análisis.
